paras.en: It's the most common prostate problem in men older than age 50, and while changes to hormone levels, inflammation, and cellular growth probably play a role, no one really knows why, at a cellular level, BPH occurs.
paras.zh: 这是 50 岁以上男性最常见的前列腺问题，虽然激素水平、炎症和细胞生长的变化可能发挥了一定作用，但没有人真正知道为什么在细胞水平上会发生 BPH。

paras.en: Urologist Charles Welliver at Albany Medical College was not involved in the recent study, but in an interview for the Urology Care Foundation's podcast in August, he explained that BPH isn't due to swelling.
paras.zh: 奥尔巴尼医学院的泌尿科医生 Charles Welliver 没有参与最近的研究，但在 8 月份接受泌尿科护理基金会播客采访时，他解释说 BPH 并不是由肿胀引起的。

paras.en: "Benign prostatic hyperplasia is just an increase in the number of cells within the prostate," said Welliver.
paras.zh: “良性前列腺增生只是前列腺内细胞数量的增加，”韦利弗说。

paras.en: "So, the cells don't get bigger, there's an increase in the number."
paras.zh: “所以，细胞并没有变大，而是数量增加了。”

paras.en: Now, scientists think they have figured out which units might be behind that cellular surge.
paras.zh: 现在，科学家们认为他们已经弄清楚哪些单位可能是细胞激增的幕后黑手。

paras.en: Researchers at Johns Hopkins analyzed noncancerous prostate tissue from 10 men who had prostate cancer.
paras.zh: 约翰·霍普金斯大学的研究人员分析了 10 名患有前列腺癌的男性的非癌性前列腺组织。

paras.en: Samples came from the three major zones of the prostate, and researchers carefully analyzed which genes were turned on or off in nearly 130,000 individual cells.
paras.zh: 样本来自前列腺的三个主要区域，研究人员仔细分析了近 130,000 个单个细胞中哪些基因被打开或关闭。

paras.en: In tissues from the transition zone and in samples from BPH, researchers found a distinct cell population that was rare in other parts of the prostate.
paras.zh: 在移行区组织和前列腺增生症样本中，研究人员发现了前列腺其他部位罕见的独特细胞群。

paras.en: These cells are a subtype of basal cells called WIF1+, and they are transcriptionally and anatomically distinct to the rest of their family members.
paras.zh: 这些细胞是称为 WIF1+ 的基底细胞亚型，它们在转录和解剖学上与其家族其他成员不同。

paras.en: Scientists say they display a unique gene expression profile, and RNA sequencing and staining show that they are markedly enriched in the transition zone of the human prostate.
paras.zh: 科学家表示，它们表现出独特的基因表达谱，RNA测序和染色表明它们在人类前列腺的过渡区显着富集。

paras.en: Some genes associated with WIF1+ cells respond to androgens like testosterone and are involved in signaling pathways that influence prostate growth and development.
paras.zh: 一些与 WIF1+ 细胞相关的基因会对睾酮等雄激素做出反应，并参与影响前列腺生长和发育的信号通路。

paras.en: "Together," the authors write, "the molecular signature, zonal distribution, and pathway enrichment suggest that transition-zone-enriched WIF1+ basal cells may contribute to BPH pathogenesis by promoting epithelial and stromal remodeling."
paras.zh: 作者写道，“总而言之，分子特征、区域分布和通路富集表明，过渡区富集的 WIF1+ 基底细胞可能通过促进上皮和基质重塑而促进 BPH 发病机制。”

paras.en: The researchers also speculate that by dampening inflammation and a growth-signaling pathway called WNT, these cells could help explain why prostate cancer starts less often in the transition zone.
paras.zh: 研究人员还推测，通过抑制炎症和名为 WNT 的生长信号通路，这些细胞可以帮助解释为什么前列腺癌在移行区较少发生。

paras.en: "The analysis revealed that these cells possess molecular features associated with tissue remodeling that could contribute to prostate enlargement as well as an ability to communicate with neighboring cells, suggesting they may help establish the unique biological environment of the transition zone," says first author Rulin Wang.
paras.zh: 第一作者王儒林说：“分析表明，这些细胞具有与组织重塑相关的分子特征，可能有助于前列腺增大，并且具有与邻近细胞沟通的能力，这表明它们可能有助于建立过渡区独特的生物环境。”

paras.en: When Wang and colleagues analyzed publicly available datasets, they found more evidence to support their results.
paras.zh: 当王和同事分析公开数据集时，他们发现了更多证据来支持他们的结果。

paras.en: Enlarged prostate gland tissues were enriched with WIF1+ basal cells.
paras.zh: 增大的前列腺组织富含 WIF1+ 基底细胞。

paras.en: The gene signature of these abundant basal cells was also distinctly altered.
paras.zh: 这些丰富的基底细胞的基因特征也明显改变。

paras.en: Wang says this raises the possibility that these cells "contribute to the regional processes that make the transition zone particularly susceptible to BPH."
paras.zh: 王说，这提出了一种可能性，即这些细胞“有助于使过渡区特别容易受到前列腺增生症影响的区域过程”。

paras.en: For now, that's just a hypothesis, but it's one that Wang and colleagues think deserves further investigation.
paras.zh: 目前，这只是一个假设，但王和同事认为值得进一步研究。

paras.en: Future studies, for instance, could examine the functional roles of WIF1+ basal cells in the development of enlarged prostate glands.
paras.zh: 例如，未来的研究可以检查 WIF1+ 基底细胞在增大的前列腺发育中的功能作用。

paras.en: If these cells really do play a direct role in BPH, they could become future drug targets.
paras.zh: 如果这些细胞确实在良性前列腺增生中发挥直接作用，它们可能成为未来的药物靶点。

paras.en: The research has been published in The Journal of Pathology.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《病理学杂志》上。

articles.title: Uranium Waste From This Aussie Mine Was Safely Locked Away, But Microbes Had Other Plans
articles.author: Jess Cockerill

paras.en: In 1944, rocks from the Mount Painter mine in the heart of Australia were sent to the US for experiments as part of the Manhattan Project.
paras.zh: 1944 年，作为曼哈顿计划的一部分，澳大利亚中部佩因特山矿的岩石被送往美国进行实验。

paras.en: The repercussions of those actions left deep scars across the world.
paras.zh: 这些行动的影响给世界各地留下了深深的伤痕。

paras.en: At Mount Painter, though, scientists believed the mine's uranium and rare earth elements were more or less safely locked away in the dry waste piles (a.k.a. tailings).
paras.zh: 然而，在佩因特山，科学家们相信该矿的铀和稀土元素或多或少被安全地锁在干燥废物堆（又称尾矿）中。

paras.en: The site was eventually closed in 1965 and later incorporated into Arkaroola Wilderness Sanctuary.
paras.zh: 该遗址最终于 1965 年关闭，后来并入阿卡鲁拉荒野保护区。

paras.en: But recent samples taken from the surface of tailings at Mount Painter's Number 6 Workings suggest the site may not be as safe as we thought.
paras.zh: 但最近从佩因特山 6 号矿场尾矿表面采集的样本表明，该地点可能并不像我们想象的那么安全。

paras.en: These tailings have supposedly lain undisturbed for more than 80 years.
paras.zh: 据推测，这些尾矿已经静静地放置了 80 多年。

paras.en: But something has been moving potentially dangerous minerals to the surface of the waste piles, where they have accumulated at unexpectedly high concentrations.
paras.zh: 但有某种东西正在将潜在危险的矿物质转移到废物堆的表面，并在那里以意想不到的高浓度积累。

paras.en: In a study recently published in the Journal of Hazardous Materials, researchers suggest that microbes in the rubble are transporting these toxic substances to the top 10cm of the waste, in the form of polymetallic nanoparticles.
paras.zh: 在最近发表在《危险材料杂志》上的一项研究中，研究人员认为，瓦砾中的微生物正在将这些有毒物质以多金属纳米颗粒的形式输送到废物顶部 10 厘米处。

paras.en: "We have traditionally assumed that these toxic metals were securely locked away by nature in these arid environments, but these tiny organisms are proving us wrong," says geoscientist Joël Brugger.
paras.zh: “我们传统上认为这些有毒金属被大自然安全地锁定在这些干旱的环境中，但这些微小的生物体证明我们错了，”地球科学家乔尔·布鲁格说。

paras.en: "They are essentially acting as microscopic factories, breaking down stable minerals and mobilizing elements like uranium into the surrounding ecosystem."
paras.zh: “它们本质上就像微型工厂，分解稳定的矿物质，并将铀等元素转移到周围的生态系统中。”

paras.en: Further studies will be needed to confirm that the microbes are actually responsible for the changes seen in these tailings.
paras.zh: 需要进一步的研究来确认微生物实际上是造成这些尾矿中所见变化的原因。

paras.en: But for now, it's the scientists' best guess, as there aren't many other good explanations.
paras.zh: 但就目前而言，这是科学家们的最佳猜测，因为没有太多其他好的解释。

paras.en: In other parts of the world, researchers have also documented radiation-resistant microbes interacting with uranium waste.
paras.zh: 在世界其他地区，研究人员还记录了抗辐射微生物与铀废物的相互作用。

paras.en: The biggest concern is that these microbes appear to be converting the minerals from insoluble phosphates into colloidal forms that can easily travel through the environment.
paras.zh: 最令人担忧的是，这些微生物似乎正在将矿物质从不溶性磷酸盐转化为可以轻松在环境中传播的胶体形式。

paras.en: Rain is rare in semi-arid Arkaroola, arriving in the form of sudden summer thunderstorms. Converted into colloids, minerals like uranium are readily suspended in rainwater, which could carry them much further from the mine site, especially during the flash flooding that sometimes occurs in Arkaroola.
paras.zh: 半干旱的阿卡鲁拉很少下雨，以夏季突然的雷暴雨的形式到来。铀等矿物质转化为胶体后，很容易悬浮在雨水中，这可能会将它们带到距离矿区更远的地方，特别是在阿卡鲁拉有时发生山洪期间。

paras.en: Toxic and radioactive minerals like uranium and rare earth elements are not what you want sprinkled throughout the soil and waterways.
paras.zh: 您不希望将铀和稀土元素等有毒和放射性矿物质撒在土壤和水道中。

paras.en: Uranium is highly radioactive, and exposure to it – for instance, by drinking contaminated water or inhaling tiny particles – can cause serious damage to humans and other living things.
paras.zh: 铀具有高放射性，接触它（例如通过饮用受污染的水或吸入微小颗粒）可能会对人类和其他生物造成严重损害。

paras.en: The paper calls for a serious rethink of how we deal with mining waste.
paras.zh: 该文件呼吁认真重新思考我们如何处理采矿废物。

paras.en: While Arkaroola is protected from further mining, its radioactive legacy is clearly not over yet.
paras.zh: 虽然阿卡鲁拉受到保护，免遭进一步开采，但其放射性遗产显然尚未结束。

paras.en: Mount Painter's Number 6 Workings is just one of many mines left abandoned after the proliferation of nuclear weapons during the 20th century.
paras.zh: 佩因特山 6 号矿井只是 20 世纪核武器扩散后被遗弃的众多矿井之一。

paras.en: But uranium production continues across the world. And there's never been such a great demand for metals and minerals.
paras.zh: 但世界各地的铀生产仍在继续。对金属和矿物的需求从未如此之大。

paras.en: "As a result of continuing global development, the transformation of the world's energy infrastructure away from fossil fuels, and the electrification of transport infrastructure, demand for base metals such as copper, critical minerals such as rare earth elements, and energy minerals such as uranium is increasing," Brugger and team write.
paras.zh: 布鲁格和团队写道：“由于全球持续发展、世界能源基础设施摆脱化石燃料的转变以及交通基础设施的电气化，对铜等贱金属、稀土元素等关键矿物以及铀等能源矿物的需求正在增加。”

paras.en: The volume of mining waste is expected to increase rapidly, especially as ore grades decrease. Even when uranium isn't the goal of a mine, many rare earth element deposits are tied up with uranium and thorium that go on to enter the mine's waste stream.
paras.zh: 采矿废物量预计将迅速增加，特别是随着矿石品位下降。即使铀不是矿山的目标，许多稀土元素矿床也与铀和钍结合在一起，然后进入矿山的废物流。

paras.en: "As we rapidly scale up operations to meet the unprecedented demand for critical minerals, the volume of mining waste generated globally is going to rise significantly," says environmental microbiologist Santonu Sanyal.
paras.zh: 环境微生物学家 Santonu Sanyal 表示：“随着我们迅速扩大运营规模，以满足对关键矿物前所未有的需求，全球产生的采矿废物量将大幅增加。”

paras.en: "Understanding exactly how these native microbes interact with waste materials is absolutely vital if we want to prevent unseen, long-term environmental contamination and develop the sustainable mine of the future."
paras.zh: “如果我们想要防止看不见的长期环境污染并开发未来的可持续矿山，那么准确了解这些原生微生物如何与废料相互作用绝对至关重要。”

paras.en: The research has been published in Journal of Hazardous Materials.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《危险材料杂志》上。

articles.title: These tiny snakes roll four times faster than they slither

paras.en: These tiny snakes roll four times faster than they slither
paras.zh: 这些小蛇的滚动速度比滑行速度快四倍

paras.en: Acrobatic body movements allow dwarf reedsnakes to keep their heads stable while much of the body rotates rapidly.
paras.zh: 杂技般的身体动作使矮芦苇蛇能够在身体大部分快速旋转的同时保持头部稳定。

paras.en: - Tiny snakes in Southeast Asia have mastered an extraordinary escape technique: rolling across the ground at speeds up to four times faster than ordinary slithering. Scientists discovered that dwarf reedsnakes accomplish this feat through precisely coordinated body movements that allow their bodies to rotate while their heads remain remarkably stable.
paras.zh: - 东南亚的小蛇掌握了一种非凡的逃跑技术：在地面上滚动的速度比普通蛇行的速度快四倍。科学家发现，矮芦苇蛇通过精确协调的身体运动来完成这一壮举，这些运动使它们的身体能够旋转，同时它们的头部保持非常稳定。

paras.en: Tiny snakes found in Southeast Asia have developed an extraordinary way to escape danger. Instead of relying on the familiar side-to-side motion of slithering, dwarf reedsnakes can rapidly roll across the ground, reaching speeds about four times faster than their usual movement.
paras.zh: 东南亚发现的小蛇已经发展出一种非凡的逃离危险的方法。矮芦苇蛇不再依靠熟悉的侧向滑行运动，而是可以在地面上快速滚动，达到比平常运动快四倍左右的速度。

paras.en: Scientists have now uncovered how these small reptiles accomplish such an unusual feat. By studying video recordings captured from multiple angles, researchers discovered that the snakes coordinate their movements with remarkable precision. While the rear portions of their bodies rotate rapidly, their heads remain relatively steady, facing forward and staying at a nearly constant height.
paras.zh: 科学家们现在已经揭示了这些小型爬行动物是如何完成如此不寻常的壮举的。通过研究从多个角度拍摄的视频记录，研究人员发现蛇以惊人的精确度协调它们的动作。当他们身体的后部快速旋转时，他们的头部保持相对稳定，面向前方并保持在几乎恒定的高度。

paras.en: [See link to video after the end of the article.]
paras.zh: 【视频链接见文章末尾。】

paras.en: The findings reveal how an animal can achieve an unexpected form of movement through specialized behavior and body control, even without the physical structures normally needed for rolling.
paras.zh: 研究结果揭示了动物如何通过专门的行为和身体控制来实现意想不到的运动形式，即使没有滚动通常所需的物理结构。

paras.en: Rolling might seem like an effective way to travel quickly, but it presents a major challenge for living creatures.
paras.zh: 滚动似乎是一种快速旅行的有效方式，但它对生物来说是一个重大挑战。

paras.en: A wheel can spin continuously around a fixed axle, allowing it to rotate without disturbing whatever it supports. Animals, however, have no comparable mechanism separating their rotating bodies from their heads.
paras.zh: 轮子可以绕固定轴连续旋转，使其旋转时不会干扰其支撑的任何物体。然而，动物没有类似的机制将旋转的身体与头部分开。

paras.en: If an animal's entire body spins together, its head and sensory organs must also rotate. This can make it difficult to maintain balance, adjust body position, and steer in the intended direction. As rolling speed increases, these problems become even harder to manage.
paras.zh: 如果动物的整个身体一起旋转，它的头部和感觉器官也必须旋转。这可能会导致难以保持平衡、调整身体位置以及转向预期方向。随着轧制速度的增加，这些问题变得更加难以管理。

paras.en: Yet dwarf reedsnakes belonging to the genus Pseudorabdion have found a way around these limitations.
paras.zh: 然而，属于拟蛇属的矮芦苇蛇已经找到了解决这些限制的方法。

paras.en: These small Southeast Asian snakes are among the few animals known to deliberately roll as a means of escaping potential predators. Their unusual behavior has appeared in field guides and was previously documented during a field observation, but scientists had not fully understood the movements that made it possible.
paras.zh: 这些东南亚小蛇是已知的少数几种故意滚动以逃避潜在捕食者的动物之一。它们不寻常的行为已经出现在野外指南中，并且之前在野外观察期间也有记录，但科学家们尚未完全理解使其成为可能的运动。

paras.en: Tiny Snakes Roll Four Times Faster Than They Slither
paras.zh: 小蛇滚动速度比滑行速度快四倍

paras.en: To investigate this remarkable escape strategy, researchers filmed dwarf reedsnakes from several angles and carefully examined how different parts of their bodies moved during rolling.
paras.zh: 为了研究这种非凡的逃生策略，研究人员从多个角度拍摄了矮芦苇蛇，并仔细检查了它们身体不同部位在滚动过程中如何移动。

paras.en: The results revealed impressive speeds. While rolling, the snakes reached peak forward velocities ranging from 1.72 to 3.69 meters per second, approximately four times their maximum speed when moving through lateral undulation, the familiar side-to-side motion used by most snakes.
paras.zh: 结果显示速度令人印象深刻。在滚动时，蛇达到每秒 1.72 至 3.69 米的峰值前进速度，大约是通过横向波动（大多数蛇所熟悉的左右运动）时的最大速度的四倍。

paras.en: Despite traveling so quickly, the snakes were able to follow a narrow racetrack measuring just 20 centimeters across, demonstrating that their rolling movements are not simply uncontrolled tumbling.
paras.zh: 尽管移动速度如此之快，蛇仍然能够沿着直径仅 20 厘米的狭窄跑道行驶，这表明它们的滚动运动不仅仅是不受控制的翻滚。

paras.en: Closer examination of the recordings revealed a surprisingly intricate sequence of movements.
paras.zh: 对录音的仔细检查揭示了一系列令人惊讶的复杂动作。

paras.en: Rather than spinning their entire bodies together, the snakes alternate between rolling on one side and swinging a curved section of their bodies downward beside their heads. The researchers called this downward sweeping movement a "stroke."
paras.zh: 这些蛇不是将整个身体旋转在一起，而是交替在一侧滚动和在头部旁边向下摆动身体的弯曲部分。研究人员将这种向下扫动的运动称为“中风”。

paras.en: During each successive cycle, the side touching the ground switches, and the stroke changes direction from left to right or right to left. By repeating this carefully timed pattern, the snakes generate continuous forward rolling motion.
paras.zh: 在每个连续的循环中，接触地面的一侧会切换，并且行程方向会从左到右或从右到左改变。通过重复这种精心计时的模式，蛇会产生连续的向前滚动运动。

paras.en: The Remarkable Secret Behind Their High-Speed Escape
paras.zh: 他们高速逃跑背后的惊人秘密

paras.en: One of the most surprising discoveries involved what happens to the snakes' heads during these rapid movements.
paras.zh: 最令人惊讶的发现之一涉及蛇的头部在这些快速运动过程中发生的变化。

paras.en: Although the rear portions of their bodies undergo substantial rotation, the snakes keep their heads pointed in the direction they are traveling. Rather than spinning along with the rest of the body, the head remains comparatively stable.
paras.zh: 尽管它们身体的后部发生大幅旋转，但蛇的头部始终指向它们行进的方向。头部保持相对稳定，而不是与身体的其他部分一起旋转。

paras.en: The researchers also found that the snakes maintain a relatively consistent head height above the ground. This stabilization becomes especially noticeable at higher speeds, when the snakes tend to hold their heads elevated and minimize upward and downward movements.
paras.zh: 研究人员还发现，蛇的头部距地面的高度保持相对一致。这种稳定性在速度较高时变得尤其明显，此时蛇往往会抬起头并尽量减少向上和向下的运动。

paras.en: Keeping the head steady while the rest of the body rotates may help the animals maintain control and navigate effectively during their rapid escapes.
paras.zh: 在身体其他部分旋转时保持头部稳定可能有助于动物在快速逃跑过程中保持控制和有效导航。

paras.en: This ability is particularly remarkable because the snakes accomplish it without a mechanical separation between the rotating and stabilized portions of their bodies.
paras.zh: 这种能力尤其引人注目，因为蛇在其身体的旋转部分和稳定部分之间没有机械分离的情况下实现了这一能力。

paras.en: What Rolling Snakes Reveal About Evolution
paras.zh: 滚动的蛇揭示了进化论

paras.en: The discovery demonstrates how sophisticated coordination can allow animals to overcome physical limitations that might otherwise make certain types of movement impractical.
paras.zh: 这一发现表明，复杂的协调性如何能够让动物克服身体限制，否则某些类型的运动可能变得不切实际。

paras.en: Although dwarf reedsnakes lack anything resembling a wheel's axle, they effectively divide their bodies into regions with different functions. Much of the body performs the powerful rotational movements needed for propulsion, while the head remains stabilized to support controlled travel.
paras.zh: 尽管矮芦苇蛇缺乏类似轮轴的东西，但它们有效地将身体划分为具有不同功能的区域。身体的大部分执行推进所需的强大旋转运动，而头部保持稳定以支持受控行进。

paras.en: This unusual strategy allows the snakes to combine speed, directional control, and rapid body rotation in a way that would be difficult to predict from their anatomy alone.
paras.zh: 这种不寻常的策略使蛇能够将速度、方向控制和快速的身体旋转结合起来，而这种方式仅凭其解剖结构很难预测。

paras.en: More broadly, the findings highlight an important principle of animal evolution: physical structure does not necessarily determine the full range of movements an animal can perform. Innovative behaviors and precise muscular coordination can open up entirely new possibilities, allowing creatures to accomplish feats that their body shapes might initially suggest are impossible.
paras.zh: 更广泛地说，这些发现强调了动物进化的一个重要原则：身体结构不一定决定动物可以执行的全部运动。创新的行为和精确的肌肉协调可以开辟全新的可能性，使生物能够完成其体型最初可能认为不可能的壮举。

paras.en: Materials provided by Toho University. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 资料由东邦大学提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

paras.en: - Yosuke Kojima, Ibuki Fukuyama, Mohamad Yazid Hossman, Clement Het Kaliang, Kanto Nishikawa. Locomotor kinematics and head stabilization in rolling snakes. Current Biology, 2026; 36 (20): R1061 DOI: 10.1016/j.cub.2026.08.057
paras.zh: - 小岛洋介、福山伊吹、穆罕默德·亚齐德·霍斯曼、克莱门特·赫特·卡良、关东·西川。滚动蛇的运动运动学和头部稳定性。现代生物学，2026； 36（20）：R1061 DOI：10.1016/j.cub.2026.08.057

articles.title: Astronomers uncover a mysterious magnetic web above the Sun

paras.en: Astronomers uncover a mysterious magnetic web above the Sun
paras.zh: 天文学家在太阳上方发现了一个神秘的磁网

paras.en: - National Institutes of Natural Sciences
paras.zh: - 国立自然科学研究所

paras.en: - The Sunâs seemingly peaceful regions are hiding a surprisingly complex magnetic world. Using a balloon-borne telescope high above Earth, scientists discovered delicate, thread-like magnetic structures woven through the solar atmosphere, apparently shaped by twisting motions on the Sunâs surface. They also mapped magnetic fields inside towering jets of solar material, revealing how those fields change with height.
paras.zh: - 太阳看似平静的区域隐藏着一个极其复杂的磁场世界。科学家们利用地球上空的气球望远镜发现了太阳大气层中编织的精致的线状磁性结构，这些结构显然是由太阳表面的扭曲运动形成的。他们还绘制了高耸的太阳能材料射流内部的磁场图，揭示了这些磁场如何随高度变化。

paras.en: Scientists have uncovered a surprisingly complex network of magnetic structures hidden above regions of the Sun that appear relatively calm. Using the Sunrise-III solar observatory, which traveled high into Earth's stratosphere aboard a balloon in 2024, an international research team led by the National Astronomical Observatory of Japan (NAOJ) discovered intricate, thread-like magnetic features that had previously been difficult to observe.
paras.zh: 科学家们发现了隐藏在看似相对平静的太阳区域上方的一个令人惊讶的复杂磁结构网络。由日本国家天文台 (NAOJ) 领导的一个国际研究小组利用 2024 年乘坐气球进入地球平流层高空的 Sunrise-III 太阳观测站，发现了以前难以观察到的复杂的线状磁性特征​​。

paras.en: The findings reveal that even the Sun's seemingly quiet regions contain elaborate magnetic structures. They also offer new clues to how energy travels upward through the solar atmosphere and contributes to its heating.
paras.zh: 研究结果表明，即使是太阳看似安静的区域也含有复杂的磁性结构。它们还为能量如何穿过太阳大气层向上传播并促进其加热提供了新的线索。

paras.en: A Hidden Web of Magnetic Threads Above the Sun
paras.zh: 太阳上方隐藏的磁线网

paras.en: Sunrise-III detected numerous thin, elongated magnetic structures woven into a larger network of magnetic fields above a quiet region of the Sun. This network, known as the magnetic canopy, extends through the chromosphere, a layer of the solar atmosphere located above the Sun's visible surface.
paras.zh: Sunrise-III 检测到许多细长的磁性结构，这些结构编织成太阳安静区域上方更大的磁场网络。这个网络被称为磁冠，延伸穿过色球层，色球层是位于太阳可见表面上方的太阳大气层。

paras.en: The canopy develops as magnetic fields concentrated at the solar surface (photosphere) spread outward and arch upward into the chromosphere (chromosphere). Rather than forming a relatively smooth, uniformly expanding structure, however, the new observations reveal that the canopy contains many narrow, thread-like features.
paras.zh: 当集中在太阳表面（光球层）的磁场向外扩散并向上拱入色球层（色球层）时，冠层就会形成。然而，新的观察结果表明，树冠并没有形成相对光滑、均匀膨胀的结构，而是包含许多狭窄的线状特征。

paras.en: To investigate how these structures form, researchers used computer simulations that successfully reproduced the patterns recorded by Sunrise-III. The results suggest that movements on the solar surface twist magnetic field lines, creating the intricate structures observed higher in the atmosphere.
paras.zh: 为了研究这些结构是如何形成的，研究人员使用计算机模拟成功地再现了 Sunrise-III 记录的模式。结果表明，太阳表面的运动扭曲了磁场线，从而形成了在大气层高层观察到的复杂结构。

paras.en: The observatory also examined another quiet region near the solar limb (visible edge of the Sun). There, it measured magnetic fields within spicules, narrow jets of solar material that extend upward from the surface. These observations revealed how the distribution of magnetic fields changes with increasing height above the Sun's visible edge.
paras.zh: 天文台还检查了太阳边缘（太阳可见边缘）附近的另一个安静区域。在那里，它测量了针状体（从表面向上延伸的太阳能材料的狭窄射流）内的磁场。这些观测揭示了磁场分布如何随着太阳可见边缘上方高度的增加而变化。

paras.en: Why the Sun's Quiet Regions Are Difficult to Study
paras.zh: 为什么太阳的安静区域难以研究

paras.en: Although the Sun is constantly active, much of its surface lacks prominent features such as sunspots. Scientists describe these comparatively inactive areas as "quiet." They cover most of the Sun, making them especially important for understanding how our star behaves.
paras.zh: 尽管太阳一直很活跃，但它的大部分表面缺乏诸如太阳黑子之类的显着特征。科学家将这些相对不活跃的区域描述为“安静”。它们覆盖了太阳的大部分区域，这使得它们对于了解我们的恒星的行为尤其重要。

paras.en: However, quiet does not mean magnetically inactive. These regions contain magnetic fields that are generally weaker than those found in more active areas of the Sun. Their subtle structures are difficult to measure, especially with telescopes on the ground, where turbulence in Earth's atmosphere can blur fine details.
paras.zh: 然而，安静并不意味着磁力不活跃。这些区域的磁场通常比太阳更活跃区域的磁场弱。它们微妙的结构很难测量，尤其是使用地面望远镜，地球大气层的湍流会模糊精细的细节。

paras.en: Sunrise-III was designed to overcome this obstacle by carrying a powerful solar telescope far above most of the atmosphere.
paras.zh: Sunrise-III 的设计是为了克服这一障碍，它携带了一个远高于大气层的强大太阳望远镜。

paras.en: A Balloon-Borne Telescope Reveals New Solar Details
paras.zh: 气球望远镜揭示了太阳的新细节

paras.en: Sunrise-III is an international research project built around a 1-meter telescope carried by a high-altitude balloon. During its 2024 mission, the observatory floated approximately 35 kilometers (about 22 miles) above Earth in the stratosphere, where atmospheric interference is greatly reduced.
paras.zh: Sunrise-III 是一个国际研究项目，围绕高空气球携带的 1 米望远镜而建。在 2024 年的任务期间，天文台漂浮在距地球约 35 公里（约 22 英里）的平流层中，大气干扰大大减少。

paras.en: This elevated vantage point allowed the telescope to capture exceptionally detailed measurements of the Sun's magnetic fields.
paras.zh: 这个较高的有利位置使望远镜能够捕获太阳磁场的极其详细的测量结果。

paras.en: The balloon's gondola carried three scientific instruments developed through contributions from different countries. One of these was SCIP (Sunrise Chromospheric Infrared spectroPolarimeter), a near-infrared instrument developed under NAOJ's leadership.
paras.zh: 气球的吊舱载有三台由不同国家贡献开发的科学仪器。其中之一是 SCIP（日出色球红外光谱偏振计），这是一种在 NAOJ 的领导下开发的近红外仪器。

paras.en: SCIP is designed to measure magnetic fields continuously across different layers of the solar atmosphere, from the photosphere to the chromosphere. This capability allowed researchers to examine how magnetic structures extend and change with altitude rather than studying only a single layer.
paras.zh: SCIP 旨在连续测量太阳大气不同层（从光球层到色球层）的磁场。这种能力使研究人员能够检查磁性结构如何随高度延伸和变化，而不是仅研究单层。

paras.en: New Clues to How the Sun's Atmosphere Is Heated
paras.zh: 关于太阳大气如何加热的新线索

paras.en: By observing from the stratosphere, Sunrise-III provided researchers with an unusually detailed picture of magnetic fields above the Sun's quiet regions. Its measurements revealed that the chromosphere contains far more intricate magnetic structures than a simple expanding canopy would suggest.
paras.zh: 通过从平流层进行观测，“日出三号”为研究人员提供了太阳安静区域上方磁场异常详细的图像。它的测量结果表明，色球层包含的磁性结构比简单的膨胀冠层所暗示的要复杂得多。

paras.en: Understanding these structures could help scientists investigate how energy generated by motions near the solar surface is transferred into higher layers of the atmosphere.
paras.zh: 了解这些结构可以帮助科学家研究太阳表面附近运动产生的能量如何转移到大气的高层。

paras.en: The discovery offers an important step toward explaining how magnetic activity contributes to heating the Sun's atmosphere, including in regions that appear calm when viewed from afar.
paras.zh: 这一发现为解释磁活动如何导致太阳大气层加热（包括从远处观察时显得平静的区域）迈出了重要的一步。

articles.title: Scientists propose a way to detect dangerous “mirror life” before it exists

paras.en: Scientists propose a way to detect dangerous âmirror lifeâ before it exists
paras.zh: 科学家提出了一种在危险的“镜像生命”存在之前检测到它的方法

paras.en: - Scientists have proposed a way to detect âmirror life,â a hypothetical form of life that could pose serious risks to humans, animals, and ecosystems if artificially created. Using special fluorescent molecules and a type of polarized light also used in 3D movie technology, researchers believe they could distinguish ordinary organisms from their mirror-image counterparts.
paras.zh: - 科学家提出了一种检测“镜像生命”的方法，这是一种假设的生命形式，如果人工创造，可能会对人类、动物和生态系统造成严重风险。研究人员相信，利用特殊的荧光分子和一种也用于 3D 电影技术的偏振光，他们可以将普通生物体与镜像生物区分开来。

paras.en: Scientists have proposed what they believe is the first way to detect "mirror life," a hypothetical form of life built from molecules that are reversed versions of those found in living organisms on Earth.
paras.zh: 科学家们提出了他们认为是检测“镜像生命”的第一种方法，这是一种由分子构成的假设生命形式，这些分子是地球上生物体中发现的分子的反向版本。

paras.en: Researchers from the University of Strathclyde and Durham University have developed a proposed detection technique that uses molecules capable of emitting light with distinct left and right-handed properties. By analyzing these light signals, scientists may eventually be able to distinguish conventional organisms from their mirror-image counterparts.
paras.zh: 斯特拉斯克莱德大学和杜伦大学的研究人员开发了一种拟议的检测技术，该技术使用能够发射具有明显左旋和右旋特性的光的分子。通过分析这些光信号，科学家最终可能能够区分传统生物和镜像生物。

paras.en: Although mirror life does not currently exist, some experts consider its potential creation a serious biological safety concern. These artificial organisms could behave in unpredictable ways when interacting with Earth's ecosystems and might evade certain natural defenses that protect people, animals, and plants.
paras.zh: 尽管镜像生命目前并不存在，但一些专家认为其潜在的产生会带来严重的生物安全问题。这些人造生物体在与地球生态系统相互作用时可能会以不可预测的方式表现，并可能逃避某些保护人类、动物和植物的自然防御。

paras.en: The likelihood of mirror life emerging is considered low, but its possible consequences could be severe enough to justify developing detection methods in advance.
paras.zh: 镜像生命出现的可能性被认为很低，但其可能的后果可能非常严重，足以证明提前开发检测方法是合理的。

paras.en: Why Mirror Life Could Pose a Biological Threat
paras.zh: 为什么镜像生命可能构成生物威胁

paras.en: Concerns about mirror life have prompted scientists to recommend restrictions on research intended to produce organisms capable of reproducing using mirror-image biological molecules.
paras.zh: 对镜像生命的担忧促使科学家建议限制旨在生产能够利用镜像生物分子繁殖的生物体的研究。

paras.en: The potential dangers have also attracted attention from governments and international organizations, including the UK Government Office for Science and the United Nations Secretary General's Scientific Advisory Board.
paras.zh: 潜在的危险也引起了各国政府和国际组织的关注，包括英国政府科学办公室和联合国秘书长的科学顾问委员会。

paras.en: The underlying science involves a property of molecules known as chirality, often described as molecular "handedness." Just as a person's left and right hands are mirror images that cannot be perfectly aligned, some molecules can exist in two forms that have identical chemical components but different three-dimensional arrangements.
paras.zh: 其基础科学涉及分子的一种称为手性的特性，通常被描述为分子的“手性”。正如人的左右手是镜像一样，无法完美对齐，有些分子可以以化学成分相同但三维排列不同的两种形式存在。

paras.en: These subtle structural differences can have major biological consequences. Two mirror-image versions of a molecule contain the same atoms connected in the same order, yet the human body may respond to them very differently. For example, one form of a medication could successfully treat a disease, while its mirror-image counterpart might be ineffective or even harmful.
paras.zh: 这些微妙的结构差异可能会产生重大的生物学后果。分子的两个镜像版本包含以相同顺序连接的相同原子，但人体对它们的反应可能截然不同。例如，一种药物可以成功治疗某种疾病，而其镜像对应物可能无效甚至有害。

paras.en: Scientists are concerned that organisms assembled from reversed biological building blocks could interact with existing life in unexpected ways.
paras.zh: 科学家担心，由反向生物构件组装而成的生物体可能会以意想不到的方式与现有生命相互作用。

paras.en: Importantly, the researchers emphasize that mirror life remains entirely hypothetical. Their proposed detection method is intended as a precaution, not a response to an existing biological threat.
paras.zh: 重要的是，研究人员强调，镜像生命仍然完全是假设的。他们提出的检测方法旨在作为预防措施，而不是对现有生物威胁的响应。

paras.en: How Light Could Reveal Mirror-Image Life
paras.zh: 光如何揭示镜像生命

paras.en: The proposed approach relies on a phenomenon called circularly polarized luminescence (CPL), which can reveal the molecular handedness, or chirality, of certain substances and biological structures.
paras.zh: 所提出的方法依赖于一种称为圆偏振发光（CPL）的现象，它可以揭示某些物质和生物结构的分子旋向性或手性。

paras.en: Light can exhibit different polarization patterns, including forms that rotate in opposite directions. By studying these patterns, researchers can obtain information about the three-dimensional arrangement of molecules.
paras.zh: 光可以表现出不同的偏振模式，包括沿相反方向旋转的形式。通过研究这些图案，研究人员可以获得有关分子三维排列的信息。

paras.en: The underlying concept has a surprisingly familiar application: the polarized light technology used in modern 3D movie glasses to create the illusion of depth.
paras.zh: 其基本概念有一个令人惊讶的熟悉应用：现代 3D 电影眼镜中使用的偏振光技术，可产生深度幻觉。

paras.en: The research, published in Royal Society Open Science under the title 'Circularly Polarized Luminescence (CPL) as a Contingency Assay for "Mirror Life" Bio-Hazards', was led by Dr. Lewis MacKenzie of the University of Strathclyde's Department of Pure and Applied Chemistry, working with Professor Robert Pal of Durham University.
paras.zh: 这项研究发表在《皇家学会开放科学》上，题为“圆偏振发光（CPL）作为“镜像生命”生物危害的应急分析”，由斯特拉斯克莱德大学纯粹与应用化学系的 Lewis MacKenzie 博士领导，与杜伦大学的 Robert Pal 教授合作。

paras.en: Dr. MacKenzie said: "We don't expect mirror life to appear tomorrow, but if it did arise, the consequences could be severe, and it makes sense to develop detection methods before they are needed. Professor Pal and I had been working on CPL technologies before recent concerns became prominent, and guarding against mirror life was a clear fit for our research."
paras.zh: 麦肯齐博士说：“我们预计镜子生命不会在明天出现，但如果它真的出现，后果可能会很严重，在需要它们之前开发检测方法是有意义的。在最近的担忧变得突出之前，帕尔教授和我一直在研究 CPL 技术，防范镜子生命显然适合我们的研究。”

paras.en: A Molecular Fingerprint for Detecting Mirror Life
paras.zh: 用于检测镜子寿命的分子指纹

paras.en: To identify a possible mirror organism, the researchers suggest using specialized fluorescent probes that attach to particular structures inside cells.
paras.zh: 为了识别可能的镜像生物，研究人员建议使用附着在细胞内特定结构上的专门荧光探针。

paras.en: Once bound to their targets, these probes would generate characteristic CPL signals. Scientists could analyze the resulting patterns to determine whether a biological sample contains the molecular handedness associated with ordinary terrestrial life or its reversed equivalent.
paras.zh: 一旦与目标结合，这些探针就会产生特征性的 CPL 信号。科学家可以分析由此产生的模式，以确定生物样本是否包含与普通陆地生命相关的分子旋向性或其相反的等价物。

paras.en: In effect, the light signals could serve as a molecular fingerprint, revealing differences that might otherwise be difficult to identify.
paras.zh: 实际上，光信号可以充当分子指纹，揭示否则可能难以识别的差异。

paras.en: However, relying on a single fluorescent probe could produce misleading results. To improve reliability and reduce the risk of false readings, the team proposes combining several probes designed to recognize different cellular structures.
paras.zh: 然而，依赖单一荧光探针可能会产生误导性的结果。为了提高可靠性并降低错误读数的风险，该团队建议结合几种旨在识别不同细胞结构的探针。

paras.en: By examining multiple signals together, researchers hope to develop a more dependable way to distinguish conventional organisms from hypothetical mirror life.
paras.zh: 通过同时检查多个信号，研究人员希望开发出一种更可靠的方法来区分传统生物和假设的镜像生命。

paras.en: Testing the Technology Without Creating Mirror Organisms
paras.zh: 在不创建镜像生物的情况下测试技术

paras.en: One important advantage of the proposed technique is that scientists could begin investigating and refining it using ordinary biological samples. There would be no need to manufacture mirror organisms simply to explore whether the underlying detection principles work.
paras.zh: 该技术的一个重要优点是科学家可以使用普通生物样本开始研究和改进它。没有必要仅仅为了探索基本检测原理是否有效而制造镜像生物体。

paras.en: The researchers also believe the method could eventually be incorporated into several types of scientific equipment, potentially allowing mirror-life screening in different environments.
paras.zh: 研究人员还相信，该方法最终可能会被纳入多种类型的科学设备中，从而有可能在不同的环境中进行镜像生命筛选。

paras.en: Professor Pal has already demonstrated laboratory-scale CPL detection technologies involving microscopes, cameras, and biological cell plate readers, which are instruments commonly used to examine large numbers of cell samples.
paras.zh: Pal 教授已经展示了实验室规模的 CPL 检测技术，包括显微镜、相机和生物细胞读板器，这些都是检查大量细胞样本的常用仪器。

paras.en: However, the complete detection method specifically designed to identify mirror life has not yet been experimentally demonstrated. Further research will be necessary to determine whether the proposed approach can reliably distinguish between different forms of molecular handedness in biological samples.
paras.zh: 然而，专门设计用于识别镜子寿命的完整检测方法尚未得到实验证明。需要进一步的研究来确定所提出的方法是否能够可靠地区分生物样本中不同形式的分子惯用手。

paras.en: Professor Pal added: "CPL detection relies on the same fundamental concept that allows modern 3D cinema glasses to create a stereoscopic image.
paras.zh: Pal 教授补充道：“CPL 检测依赖于现代 3D 电影眼镜创建立体图像的相同基本概念。

paras.en: "This CPL detection approach can be adapted to many types of systems for analysis of cells, including biological plate readers, microscopes, and cameras. This means our mirror life assay approach could be generalized to many environments depending on end user needs."
paras.zh: “这种 CPL 检测方法可以适应多种类型的细胞分析系统，包括生物读板机、显微镜和相机。这意味着我们的镜寿命测定方法可以根据最终用户的需求推广到许多环境。”

paras.en: Materials provided by https://www.strath.ac.uk/. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由 https://www.strath.ac.uk/ 提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

articles.title: Rocket Lab launches 3 'Hawk' satellites to orbit to gather signals intelligence
articles.author: Mike Wall

paras.en: Rocket Lab launched a trio of private signals-intelligence satellites to orbit today (Oct. 23).
paras.zh: 今天（10 月 23 日）火箭实验室将三颗私人信号情报卫星发射到轨道。

paras.en: The mission lifted off aboard an Electron rocket from Rocket Lab’s New Zealand launch site today at 3:11 a.m. EDT (0711 GMT; 8:11 p.m. local time in New Zealand).
paras.zh: 今天美国东部时间凌晨 3 点 11 分（格林威治标准时间 0711；新西兰当地时间晚上 8 点 11 分），该任务搭乘电子火箭从火箭实验室新西兰发射场升空。

paras.en: The Electron carried three "Hawk" satellites for the Virginia-based company HawkEye 360, which explains the name Rocket Lab gave to the mission: "We're Not Hawking Around."
paras.zh: Electron 为总部位于弗吉尼亚州的 HawkEye 360​​ 公司携带了三颗“Hawk”卫星，这解释了火箭实验室给该任务起的名字：“我们不是霍金”。

paras.en: If all goes according to plan, the three Hawks will be deployed into low Earth orbit (LEO), at an altitude of 323 miles (520 kilometers). Once up there and commissioned, the satellites will scan the globe for radio frequency (RF) emissions.
paras.zh: 如果一切按计划进行，三架“鹰”将被部署到高度 323 英里（520 公里）的近地轨道 (LEO)。一旦到达那里并投入使用，卫星将扫描全球的射频（RF）辐射。

paras.en: "Operating in clusters of three, HawkEye 360's satellites collect signal data from across the RF spectrum for maritime tracking, GNSS jamming detection, radar monitoring, communications mapping and space defense," Rocket Lab wrote in a mission description.
paras.zh: 火箭实验室在任务描述中写道：“HawkEye 360​​ 卫星以三颗集群的形式运行，从整个射频频谱收集信号数据，用于海上跟踪、GNSS 干扰检测、雷达监控、通信测绘和太空防御。”

paras.en: HawkEye 360 provides this data to the U.S. government and its allies "to enable faster, better decision-making," according to the company. "Our space-based collection, proprietary signal processing and AI-powered analytics transform knowledge of the RF spectrum into a strategic advantage."
paras.zh: 据该公司称，HawkEye 360​​ 向美国政府及其盟友提供这些数据，“以实现更快、更好的决策”。 “我们的天基收集、专有信号处理和人工智能分析将射频频谱知识转化为战略优势。”

paras.en: HawkEye 360's first satellites launched in 2018, and the company has now sent nearly 50 of them to LEO. The most recent Hawk launch before "We're Not Hawking Around" came just two days ago; three of the satellites went up on SpaceX's Bandwagon-5 rideshare mission.
paras.zh: HawkEye 360​​ 的第一颗卫星于 2018 年发射，该公司目前已向近地轨道发射了近 50 颗卫星。在“We're Not Hawking around”之前的最新一次 Hawk 发射就在两天前；其中三颗卫星执行了 SpaceX 的 Bandwagon-5 乘车共享任务。

paras.en: "We're Not Hawking Around "was Rocket Lab's 98th launch to date and its 19th of 2026 so far. Sixteen of this year's flights have been performed by the two-stage, 59-foot-tall (18 meters) Electron. The other three have been conducted by HASTE, a suborbital variant of Electron that allows customers to test technologies in a hypersonic flight environment.
paras.zh: “We're Not Hawking around”是 Rocket Lab 迄今为止的第 98 次发射，也是 2026 年迄今为止的第 19 次发射。今年的 16 次飞行是由 59 英尺高（18 米）的两级 Electron 执行的。另外三项是由 HASTE 进行的，HASTE 是 Electron 的亚轨道变体，允许客户在高超音速飞行环境中测试技术。

paras.en: Michael Wall is the Spaceflight and Tech Editor for Space.com and joined the team in 2010. He primarily covers human and robotic spaceflight, military space, and exoplanets, but has been known to dabble in the space art beat. His book about the search for alien life, "Out There," was published on Nov. 13, 2018. Before becoming a science writer, Michael worked as a herpetologist and wildlife biologist. He has a Ph.D. in evolutionary biology from the University of Sydney, Australia, a bachelor's degree from the University of Arizona, and a graduate certificate in science writing from the University of California, Santa Cruz. To find out what his latest project is, you can follow Michael on Twitter.
paras.zh: Michael Wall 是 Space.com 的太空飞行和技术编辑，于 2010 年加入该团队。他主要报道人类和机器人太空飞行、军事太空和系外行星，但以涉足太空艺术领域而闻名。他关于寻找外星生命的书《Out There》于 2018 年 11 月 13 日出版。在成为科普作家之前，迈克尔曾是一名爬行动物学家和野生动物生物学家。他拥有博士学位。澳大利亚悉尼大学进化生物学博士学位、亚利桑那大学学士学位以及加州大学圣克鲁斯分校科学写作研究生证书。要了解他的最新项目是什么，您可以在 Twitter 上关注 Michael。

articles.title: Halley's Comet dazzles from afar in spectacular astrophoto of Orionid meteor shower
articles.author: Anthony Wood

paras.en: Astrophotographer Tim McCollum captured a spectacular view of Orionid meteors sharing the night sky with a host of deep sky wonders on Oct. 21, as the annual shooting star display ramped up to peak activity.
paras.zh: 10 月 21 日，随着一年一度的流星表演进入高峰期，天体摄影师蒂姆·麦科勒姆 (Tim McCollum) 捕捉到了猎户座流星雨与众多深空奇观共享夜空的壮观景象。

paras.en: Comet 1P/Halley may be over 3 billion miles (4.8 kilometers) from Earth, but that didn't stop it from putting on a breathtaking display earlier this week, as particles cast off by the ancient wanderer carved a fiery path through the autumn sky.
paras.zh: 1P/哈雷彗星距离地球可能超过 30 亿英里（4.8 公里），但这并没有阻止它在本周早些时候上演令人惊叹的表演，因为这位古代流浪者发射的粒子在秋天的天空中划出了一条火热的路径。

paras.en: McCollum was able to capture a trio of vivid Orionid meteors as they streaked through the night sky above the city of Toccoa, Georgia, between 3-4 a.m. on Oct. 21. Each of the shooting stars can be seen racing away from the shower's apparent point of origin — or radiant — which is located close to the red giant star Betelgeuse in the constellation Orion.
paras.zh: 10月21日凌晨3点到4点，麦科勒姆捕捉到了三颗生动的猎户座流星雨，它们划过佐治亚州托科亚市上空的夜空。可以看到每颗流星都从流星雨的明显起源点（或辐射点）飞驰而去，该流星位于猎户座红巨星参宿四附近。

paras.en: Successfully imaging a shooting star takes a combination of skill, luck and patience. McCollum photographed the meteors over the course of multiple 30-second exposures taken with a Canon EOS Ra camera and RF 28-70 f2.0 lens, which was fixed unerringly on the radiant with the aid of a star tracker. The individual exposures were then combined into a single composite image using the astrophoto software PixInsight.
paras.zh: 成功地拍摄流星照片需要技巧、运气和耐心的结合。麦科勒姆使用佳能 EOS Ra 相机和 RF 28-70 f2.0 镜头在多次 30 秒的曝光过程中拍摄了流星，并在星跟踪器的帮助下准确地固定在辐射点上。然后使用天文摄影软件 PixInsight 将各个曝光组合成单个合成图像。

paras.en: The Canon EOS R7 is the best camera for beginners. Despite its crop sensor, the EOS R7 can rival most full-frame cameras. It features a 34.4MP sensor, ISO range up to 32,000 and a video capability of 4K UHD 60p. It has the best tools to help a beginner master photography. Read our full Canon EOS R7 review.
paras.zh: 佳能 EOS R7 是初学者的最佳相机。尽管配备了作物传感器，EOS R7 仍然可以与大多数全画幅相机相媲美。它配备 34.4MP 传感器、ISO 范围高达 32,000 以及 4K UHD 60p 视频功能。它拥有帮助初学者掌握摄影的最佳工具。阅读我们完整的佳能 EOS R7 评论。

paras.en: The familiar stars of Orion's Belt glisten to the right of McCollum's image, close to the glow of the Orion Nebula — one of the nearest major star forming regions to Earth. The Rosette Nebula (Caldwell 49) can also be spotted embedded in the dense starfield and dust lanes of the Milky Way's galactic plane, which runs diagonally through the composite image, as can numerous star clusters.
paras.zh: 猎户座腰带中熟悉的恒星在麦科勒姆图像的右侧闪闪发光，靠近猎户座星云的光芒，猎户座星云是距离地球最近的主要恒星形成区域之一。玫瑰星云（Caldwell 49）也可以被发现嵌入在银河系平面的密集星场和尘埃带中，它与众多星团一样斜穿过合成图像。

paras.en: The Orionid meteor shower is active until Nov. 7, so be sure to head outside over the next few nights for a chance to spot one of Comet 1P/Halley's dazzling shooting stars. If you're lucky, you may even spot a Halloween Fireball belonging to the Taurid meteor shower, as Earth passes through the debris streams cast off by Comet 2P/Encke!
paras.zh: 猎户座流星雨将持续活跃到 11 月 7 日，因此请务必在接下来的几个晚上前往户外，有机会看到 1P/哈雷彗星中一颗耀眼的流星。如果幸运的话，当地球穿过 2P/恩克彗星抛出的碎片流时，您甚至可能会发现属于金牛座流星雨的万圣节火球！

paras.en: Why not read our handy guide to photographing shooting stars? You can also take a look at our picks of the best lenses and cameras for astrophotography available in 2026, including the Canon EOS R8, which delivers the essential interval shooting functionality you need to capture meteors without bursting the bank.
paras.zh: 为什么不阅读我们的拍摄流星的便捷指南呢？您还可以查看我们精选的 2026 年天文摄影最佳镜头和相机，其中包括佳能 EOS R8，它提供了捕捉流星所需的基本间隔拍摄功能，而无需花费太多。

paras.en: Editor's Note: If you would like to share your astrophotography with Space.com's readers, then please send your photo(s), comments, and your name and location to spacephotos@space.com.
paras.zh: 编者注：如果您想与 Space.com 的读者分享您的天文摄影，请将您的照片、评论以及您的姓名和位置发送至 spacephotos@space.com。

articles.title: Medusa's eye, Halloween fireballs and more: 5 skywatching targets to look out for this spooky season
articles.author: Anthony Wood

paras.en: The spooky season is officially here! To celebrate, we've put together a list of five Halloween-themed skywatching targets that you can enjoy with nothing but the naked eye or binoculars and, of course, clear skies.
paras.zh: 幽灵季节正式到来！为了庆祝这一点，我们列出了五个万圣节主题的天空观测目标，您只需肉眼或双筒望远镜，当然还有晴朗的天空，就可以欣赏这些目标。

paras.en: Over millennia, the night sky has helped shape human beliefs. In return, we have imprinted our myths, stories and perceptions upon it, seeing monsters and mythology in the twinkling lights of the stars and assigning sinister aspects to innocent cosmic objects.
paras.zh: 几千年来，夜空帮助塑造了人类的信仰。作为回报，我们在其上印下了我们的神话、故事和看法，在星星闪烁的光芒中看到怪物和神话，并将邪恶的一面赋予无辜的宇宙物体。

paras.en: Many of these ghostly impressions and meanings have survived to the present day. Here are a few of our favorites.
paras.zh: 许多这些幽灵般的印象和意义至今仍然存在。以下是我们最喜欢的一些。

paras.en: Don't be fooled by their beauty; the blue-white stars of the Pleiades are dripping in spooky lore. Ancient Celtic druids would hold the celebration of Samhain — the precursor to Halloween — when the star cluster reached its highest point in the autumn night sky at midnight.
paras.zh: 不要被它们的美丽所迷惑；昴宿星团的蓝白色星星充满了诡异的传说。古代凯尔特德鲁伊会举行萨温节庆祝活动——万圣节的前身——当星团在午夜到达秋季夜空中的最高点时。

paras.en: The veil separating the worlds of the living and the dead was believed to be at its thinnest around this time, granting the departed a brief window to visit the living before the realms separated once again.
paras.zh: 据信，分隔生者和死者世界的面纱在此时最为薄弱，为死者提供了一个短暂的窗口，可以在两个领域再次分离之前拜访生者。

paras.en: The Pleiades appears as a tight collection of six or seven bright twinkling stars to the naked eye, while a pair of binoculars will reveal dozens more of the 1,000-strong star cluster.
paras.zh: 肉眼看来，昴宿星团是由六到七颗明亮闪烁的恒星组成的紧密集合，而双筒望远镜将揭示这个由 1,000 颗恒星组成的星团中的数十颗。

paras.en: Stargazers in the U.S. can find the Pleiades using the three familiar stars of Orion's Belt, which glisten in the eastern sky in the hours preceding midnight. Trace an imaginary line upward through the trio of stars until you find the bright orange star Aldebaran, which represents an eye of the great bull represented in the constellation Taurus. The Pleiades can be found glowing less than 15 degrees above! (Reminder: Your clenched fist held at arm's length covers about 10 degrees of sky.)
paras.zh: 美国的观星者可以利用猎户座腰带上三颗熟悉的恒星找到昴宿​​星团，这些恒星在午夜前的几个小时在东方天空中闪闪发光。沿着一条假想线向上穿过三颗恒星，直到找到明亮的橙色恒星毕宿五，它代表金牛座中巨大公牛的眼睛。昴宿星团可以在上方 15 度以下的地方发光！ （提醒：你握紧的拳头保持一臂距离，覆盖大约10度的天空。）

paras.en: Next we turn our gaze to the "Demon Star" Algol — a beautiful binary system that represents an eye of the monstrous Gorgon Medusa, whose severed head is depicted in the constellation Perseus.
paras.zh: 接下来，我们将目光转向“恶魔之星”大陵五，这是一个美丽的双星系统，代表着可怕的蛇发女妖美杜莎的一只眼睛，英仙座中描绘了美杜莎被砍下的头颅。

paras.en: The demonic eye appears to "wink" at us every 2.867 days, as one of a pair of co-orbiting stars eclipses the other, making Algol appear 3.3 times dimmer than usual at the climax, or "minima," of each 10-hour eclipse. Algol won't be eclipsed on Halloween night in 2026, though you may notice its light dim during the surrounding minima on Oct. 29 and Nov. 1, according to Sky and Telescope.
paras.zh: 恶魔之眼似乎每 2.867 天就会向我们“眨眼”一次，因为一对共轨恒星中的一颗恒星会遮蔽另一颗恒星，使得大陵五在每次 10 小时日食的高潮或“最小值”时显得比平常暗 3.3 倍。据天空和望远镜报道，大陵五不会在 2026 年万圣节之夜出现日食，不过你可能会注意到它的光线在 10 月 29 日和 11 月 1 日周围的极小值期间变暗。

paras.en: The night sky is often described as a sea of stars, so it's only fitting that a monster lurks within its depths. The constellation Cetus — also known as the sea monster, or the whale — can be found shining in the southeastern sky after sunset in late October, with the circlet of stars representing the monster's head glistening to the right of the Pleiades for viewers in the U.S.
paras.zh: 夜空通常被描述为星海，所以在其深处潜伏着怪物也就再合适不过了。鲸鱼座——也被称为海怪或鲸鱼——在十月下旬日落后可以在东南方的天空中看到，代表鲸鱼座的星星圈在昴宿星团的右侧闪闪发光，适合美国观众观看。

paras.en: In Greek mythology, Cetus was a mighty sea beast that terrorized the coast of Aethiopia under the command of the god Poseidon, according to the website for NASA's Chandra X-Ray Observatory. The sea beast was eventually killed by the hero Perseus, who in some tellings used the severed head of medusa to turn Cetus to stone!
paras.zh: 据美国宇航局钱德拉 X 射线天文台网站称，在希腊神话中，鲸鱼座是一种强大的海兽，在海神波塞冬的指挥下，对埃塞俄比亚海岸造成了恐怖。这头海兽最终被英雄珀尔修斯杀死，在某些传说中，珀尔修斯用美杜莎的头颅将鲸鱼座变成了石头！

paras.en: Look to the lunar disk in the week surrounding the full moon on Oct. 26 and you may notice a bright network of spiderweb-like patterns surrounding the Tycho, Copernicus and Kepler craters.
paras.zh: 观察 10 月 26 日满月前后一周的月盘，您可能会注意到第谷、哥白尼和开普勒陨石坑周围有一个明亮的蜘蛛网状图案网络。

paras.en: Thankfully, these aren't the nests of some colossal moon-dwelling arachnids, but streaks of bright material cast across the lunar surface by the violent impacts that created the bright young craters. They're best viewed around the full moon phase, when the lunar disk shines opposite the sun in Earth's sky.
paras.zh: 值得庆幸的是，这些并不是一些巨大的月球蜘蛛的巢穴，而是由于产生明亮的年轻陨石坑的猛烈撞击而在月球表面投射出的明亮物质条纹。最好在满月期间观看它们，此时月盘在地球天空中与太阳相对照耀。

paras.en: Our last pick is going to take a great deal of patience, and a good amount of luck! Look out for bright, slow-moving meteors belonging to the Taurid meteor shower, which appear to streak away from a patch of sky close to the Pleiades in the constellation Taurus (hence the name).
paras.zh: 我们最后的选择需要极大的耐心和运气！留意属于金牛座流星雨的明亮、缓慢移动的流星，它们似乎从靠近金牛座昴宿星团（因此得名）的一片天空中划过。

paras.en: The Taurids are comprised of two separate meteor showers — the Northern Taurids and Southern Taurids — which are active in late October as Earth passes through the debris trails left by the 3-mile-wide (4.8 kilometers) Comet 2P/Encke.
paras.zh: 金牛座流星雨由两个独立的流星雨组成——北金牛座流星雨和南金牛座流星雨——它们在 10 月下旬活跃，当时地球穿过 3 英里宽（4.8 公里）彗星 2P/恩克留下的碎片轨迹。

paras.en: Taurids are known for producing bright "fireball" meteors, which are often called "Halloween fireballs" because they tend to coincide with the annual celebration. They're spectacular and can appear anytime after the constellation Taurus rises above the horizon, which is shortly after sunset in October for stargazers in the U.S.. But they're also very rare, so it's best to treat the fireballs as a bonus if you're lucky enough to spot one, rather than a target to plan your nights around, at least outside of the shower's peaks in early November.
paras.zh: 金牛座流星雨以产生明亮的“火球”流星而闻名，这些流星通常被称为“万圣节火球”，因为它们往往与一年一度的庆祝活动同时发生。它们非常壮观，随时可能在金牛座升出地平线后出现，对于美国的观星者来说，十月日落后不久。但它们也非常罕见，所以如果您有幸发现火球，最好将火球视为一种奖励，而不是计划夜晚的目标，至少在 11 月初的流星雨高峰期之外。

paras.en: Be sure to check out our beginners tips for skywatching if you're a newcomer to exploring the night sky, along with our picks of the best binoculars and telescope deals that'll have you exploring everything from the moon and stars to impressive deep sky objects in no time.
paras.zh: 如果您是探索夜空的新手，请务必查看我们的星空观测初学者技巧，以及我们精选的最佳双筒望远镜和望远镜优惠，让您立即探索从月亮和星星到令人印象深刻的深空天体的一切。

paras.en: Editor's Note: If you would like to share your Halloween astrophotography with Space.com's readers, then please send your photo(s), comments, and your name and location to spacephotos@space.com.
paras.zh: 编者注：如果您想与 Space.com 的读者分享您的万圣节天文摄影，请将您的照片、评论以及您的姓名和位置发送至 spacephotos@space.com。

paras.en: Anthony Wood joined Space.com in April 2025 after contributing articles to outlets including IGN, New Atlas and Gizmodo. He has a passion for the night sky, science, Hideo Kojima, and human space exploration, and can’t wait for the day when astronauts once again set foot on the moon.
paras.zh: 安东尼·伍德 (Anthony Wood) 向 IGN、New Atlas 和 Gizmodo 等媒体投稿后于 2025 年 4 月加入 Space.com。他热爱夜空、科学、小岛秀夫和人类太空探索，迫不及待地等待宇航员再次踏上月球的那一天。

articles.title: Oct. 29: Applying AI/SI to the GEOINT Mission
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: Artificial intelligence is changing how intelligence organizations collect, process and exploit satellite imagery. As the volume of Earth observation data grows, AI is becoming essential for identifying patterns, detecting anomalies and delivering intelligence at operational speed.
paras.zh: 人工智能正在改变情报组织收集、处理和利用卫星图像的方式。随着地球观测数据量的增长，人工智能对于识别模式、检测异常和以运行速度提供情报变得至关重要。

paras.en: Join SpaceNews and Vantor on Oct. 29 for a virtual event that will explore how machine learning is transforming the GEOINT mission across defense, intelligence and commercial markets.
paras.zh: 10 月 29 日与 SpaceNews 和 Vantor 一起参加虚拟活动，探讨机器学习如何改变国防、情报和商业市场的 GEOINT 任务。

paras.en: Speakers will discuss advances in automated target recognition, change detection, multimodal data fusion and large language models, as well as the challenges of validating AI outputs and maintaining analyst trust. The conversation will consider where AI delivers its greatest operational value, where humans remain indispensable and how intelligence organizations can adapt to persistent, data-driven surveillance.
paras.zh: 演讲者将讨论自动目标识别、变化检测、多模式数据融合和大型语言模型方面的进展，以及验证人工智能输出和维持分析师信任的挑战。对话将考虑人工智能在哪些方面发挥最大的运营价值、人类在哪些方面仍然不可或缺，以及情报组织如何适应持续的、数据驱动的监视。

paras.en: - Peter Wilczynski, chief product officer, Vantor
paras.zh: - Peter Wilczynski，Vantor 首席产品官

paras.en: - Joe O’Callaghan, director, Super Intelligence (SI) Mission, National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency
paras.zh: - Joe O’Callaghan，国家地理空间情报局超级情报 (SI) 任务主任

paras.en: - Jackie Barbieri, chief executive officer, Whitespace
paras.zh: - Jackie Barbieri，Whitespace 首席执行官

paras.en: This virtual event will take place via Zoom. You will receive a unique link to join with your registration confirmation. A recording will be posted here shortly after the event concludes.
paras.zh: 该虚拟活动将通过 Zoom 进行。您将收到一个独特的加入链接以及您的注册确认信息。活动结束后不久将在此处发布录音。

paras.en: Vantor is forging the new frontier of spatial intelligence to unlock a more autonomous, interoperable world. We give decision makers and operators the power to build a unified intelligence picture, delivering the clarity they need to navigate what’s happening now and shape what’s coming next. We fuse data from our constellation, which includes the most capable imaging satellites on orbit, with real-time sensor feeds from space, air, and ground to create an AI-ready digital twin of Earth. Our spatial intelligence platform automates every part of the cycle—from tasking to collection to production—to update and analyze this foundation at the pace of change. Our products drive deeper mission-critical insights and connect the next generation of autonomous systems across the defense, intelligence, and commercial landscape. To learn more, visit www.vantor.com
paras.zh: Vantor 正在开拓空间智能的新领域，以解锁一个更加自主、可互操作的世界。我们使决策者和操作员能够构建统一的情报图景，为他们提供所需的清晰度，以引导当前正在发生的事情并塑造接下来的情况。我们将来自我们的星座（包括在轨成像卫星）的数据与来自太空、空中和地面的实时传感器反馈相融合，创建一个支持人工智能的地球数字孪生。我们的空间智能平台可自动化周期的每个部分（从任务分配到收集再到生产），以根据变化的速度更新和分析这一基础。我们的产品推动更深入的关键任务洞察，并连接国防、情报和商业领域的下一代自主系统。要了解更多信息，请访问 www.vantor.com

articles.title: AnySignal to Deliver Space-to-Earth Communications for Three Reflect Orbital Missions
articles.author: AnySignal

paras.en: LOS ANGELES — October 20, 2026 AnySignal, a leading provider of software-defined radios and space-based networking, today announced an agreement with Reflect Orbital to deliver space-to-earth communications for Reflect Orbital’s inaugural satellite and two subsequent missions. The agreement includes the delivery of AnySignal’s USX space transceivers for flight operations and the implementation of the AnyLink software for ground connectivity. This establishes AnySignal as Reflect Orbital’s communications partner, integrating spacecraft radio hardware directly with ground network infrastructure.
paras.zh: 洛杉矶 — 2026 年 10 月 20 日 软件定义无线电和天基网络的领先提供商 AnySignal 今天宣布与 Reflect Orbital 达成协议，为 Reflect Orbital 的首颗卫星和后续的两次任务提供空对地通信。该协议包括交付用于飞行操作的 AnySignal USX 空间收发器以及实施用于地面连接的 AnyLink 软件。这使得 AnySignal 成为 Reflect Orbital 的通信合作伙伴，将航天器无线电硬件直接与地面网络基础设施集成。

paras.en: For these missions, Reflect Orbital satellites will utilize the AnySignal USX transceiver, a multi-band software-defined radio. The USX unit consolidates high-rate payload downlinks and Telemetry, Tracking, and Command (TT&C) functions within a single hardware module. This configuration removes the need for separate radios for different frequency bands, reducing mass and cabling requirements on the satellite bus. The agreement involves the implementation of AnySignal’s AnyLink software for ground operations. AnyLink functions as an interface that aggregates access to multiple ground-station-as-a-service (GSaaS) providers. The technology enables operators at Reflect to access different third-party ground networks through a single architecture.
paras.zh: 对于这些任务，Reflect Orbital 卫星将利用 AnySignal USX 收发器，这是一种多频段软件定义无线电。 USX 单元将高速有效负载下行链路以及遥测、跟踪和命令 (TT&C) 功能整合到单个硬件模块中。这种配置无需针对不同频段使用单独的无线电，从而减少了卫星总线的质量和布线要求。该协议涉及实施 AnySignal 的 AnyLink 软件以进行地面操作。 AnyLink 充当聚合对多个地面站即服务 (GSaaS) 提供商的访问的接口。该技术使 Reflect 的运营商能够通过单一架构访问不同的第三方地面网络。

paras.en: “AnySignal is excited to provide Reflect with full-stack communications for their upcoming missions,” said CEO and Co-Founder John Malsbury. “This agreement reflects the power of AnySignal’s operating system for the electromagnetic spectrum. The AnySignal operating system, including radio hardware and ground networking, solves technical RF problems so that innovative customers like Reflect Orbital can focus on their groundbreaking missions.”
paras.zh: “AnySignal 很高兴能够为 Reflect 即将到来的任务提供全栈通信，”首席执行官兼联合创始人 John Malsbury 说道。 “该协议体现了 AnySignal 操作系统在电磁频谱方面的强大功能。AnySignal 操作系统（包括无线电硬件和地面网络）解决了射频技术问题，使像 Reflect Orbital 这样的创新客户能够专注于他们的开创性任务。”

paras.en: “We selected AnySignal for both our flight radio and ground connectivity software because it delivers a true end-to-end comms solution,” said Ben Nowack, Co-Founder and CEO, Reflect Orbital. “AnySignal has helped us de-risk early operations and let us focus on engineering the novel parts of our spacecraft.”
paras.zh: Reflect Orbital 联合创始人兼首席执行官 Ben Nowack 表示：“我们选择 AnySignal 作为我们的飞行无线电和地面连接软件，因为它提供了真正的端到端通信解决方案。” “AnySignal 帮助我们降低了早期运营的风险，让我们专注于设计航天器的新颖部件。”

paras.en: AnySignal is a U.S.-based aerospace and defense technology company building the operating system for the electromagnetic spectrum. The company designs, builds, integrates, and operates end-to-end radio-frequency (RF) systems for civil, commercial, and national security customers to sense, connect, and defend across land, air, sea, and space—providing the adaptable spectrum capabilities their missions depend on. For more information, visit: anysignal.com
paras.zh: AnySignal 是一家总部位于美国的航空航天和国防技术公司，致力于构建电磁频谱操作系统。该公司为民用、商业和国家安全客户设计、构建、集成和运营端到端射频 (RF) 系统，以跨陆地、空中、海上和太空进行感知、连接和防御，从而提供他们的任务所依赖的适应性频谱功能。欲了解更多信息，请访问：anysignal.com

paras.en: Reflect Orbital is developing space-enabled infrastructure to deliver sunlight to precise locations on Earth. By redirecting sunlight from orbit, we aim to extend electricity generation at solar farms and provide light to help search-and-rescue teams find people at night and construction crews work more safely after dark. We believe reliable access to affordable energy is the foundation of human progress, a healthier planet and economic growth. Our mission is to unlock more of the sun’s potential and deliver energy abundance to a world that urgently needs it. For more information, visit: https://www.reflectorbital.com/
paras.zh: Reflect Orbital 正在开发太空基础设施，将阳光传送到地球上的精确位置。通过重新定向轨道上的阳光，我们的目标是扩大太阳能发电厂的发电量，并提供照明以帮助搜救队在夜间找到人员，并帮助施工人员在天黑后更安全地工作。我们相信可靠地获得负担得起的能源是人类进步、更健康的地球和经济增长的基础。我们的使命是释放更多太阳能潜力，为急需能源的世界提供丰富的能源。欲了解更多信息，请访问：https://www.reflectorbital.com/

paras.en: Reflect Orbital: press@reflectorbital.com
paras.zh: 反射轨道：press@reflectorbital.com

articles.title: Rethinking networks in space with Aalyria’s Brian Barritt
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.zh: 在本集中，SpaceNews 的 Mike Gruss 与 Aalyria 首席执行官 Brian Barritt 讨论了网络如何发展、公司规模扩张意味着什么以及软件互操作性在太空中的作用。
