articles.title: World News in Brief: Iran nuclear inspections, deadly church attack in Jordan, El Fasher – one year on

paras.en: World News in Brief: Iran nuclear inspections, deadly church attack in Jordan, El Fasher – one year on
paras.zh: 世界新闻简讯：伊朗核检查、约旦法希尔致命教堂袭击——一年过去了

paras.en: The head of the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA), Rafael Grossi, called on Friday for a swift return of inspectors to Iran, warning of growing fragility in the global nuclear non-proliferation regime.
paras.zh: 国际原子能机构（IAEA）负责人拉斐尔·格罗西周五呼吁视察员迅速返回伊朗，警告全球核不扩散制度日益脆弱。

paras.en: The technical groundwork has been done and “the bases on which a diplomatic agreement could be concluded exist,” he told the UN General Assembly.
paras.zh: 他在联合国大会上表示，技术基础工作已经完成，“达成外交协议的基础已经存在”。

paras.en: He urged the parties to “redouble efforts”, adding that inspectors’ return “requires a return to the negotiating table”.
paras.zh: 他敦促各方“加倍努力”，并补充说，视察员的返回“需要回到谈判桌”。

paras.en: Iran has sharply restricted access since the June 2025 strikes on its nuclear sites during a 12-day war with Israel.
paras.zh: 自 2025 年 6 月在与以色列长达 12 天的战争期间对其核设施发动袭击以来，伊朗一直严格限制进入。

paras.en: The IAEA estimated in March that just over 200 kilogrammes of uranium enriched to 60 per cent remained at Isfahan, with more at Natanz.
paras.zh: 国际原子能机构 3 月份估计，伊斯法罕还剩下 200 多公斤浓缩至 60% 的铀，纳坦兹还有更多。

paras.en: In September, the agency’s board of governors referred Iran’s non-compliance to the Security Council, which Tehran contests.
paras.zh: 9月，该机构理事会将伊朗不遵守规定的行为提交给安理会，但德黑兰对此提出异议。

paras.en: “The global non-proliferation regime…depends on dialogue,” Mr. Grossi said, pointing to successful efforts in Syria and war-torn Ukraine, where IAEA has brokered eight localised ceasefires to repair power lines at the Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant and deployed 287 missions since Russia launched a full-scale invasion in 2022.
paras.zh: 格罗西先生说：“全球防扩散制度……取决于对话。”他指的是在叙利亚和饱受战争蹂躏的乌克兰所做的成功努力。自俄罗斯 2022 年发动全面入侵以来，原子能机构已在当地斡旋八次局部停火，以修复扎波罗热核电站的电线，并部署了 287 次任务。

paras.en: UN chief condemns deadly church attack in Jordan
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长谴责约旦教堂致命袭击事件

paras.en: The UN chief António Guterres on Friday strongly condemned a deadly attack on a church in Hmoud, Jordan.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯周五强烈谴责约旦哈穆德一座教堂发生的致命袭击事件。

paras.en: The terrorist attack on a funeral service at a church in Hmoud in Jordan left seven people dead and many more injured, UN Spokesperson Stéphane Dujarric said.
paras.zh: 联合国发言人斯特凡·杜雅里克 (Stéphane Dujarric) 表示，约旦哈穆德一座教堂举行的葬礼遭到恐怖袭击，造成七人死亡、多人受伤。

paras.en: “The Secretary-General expresses his deep condolences to the families of the victims and wishes a speedy recovery to all those injured,” he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“秘书长向遇难者家属表示深切哀悼，并祝愿所有伤者早日康复。”

paras.en: “An attack not only on a place of worship but during a funeral procession, is especially heinous.”
paras.zh: “不仅针对礼拜场所，而且在送葬队伍中发生的袭击尤其令人发指。”

paras.en: The Secretary-General also called for all those responsible to be found and to be held accountable, Mr. Dujarric said.
paras.zh: 杜哈里克先生说，秘书长还呼吁找到所有责任人并追究其责任。

paras.en: “Attacks against civilians and places of worship are unacceptable,” he said. “Places of worship must be places of peace and must be safe for all.”
paras.zh: “针对平民和礼拜场所的袭击是不可接受的，”他说。 “礼拜场所必须是和平的场所，并且必须对所有人来说都是安全的。”

paras.en: Sudan’s El Fasher survivors, one year since city fell
paras.zh: 苏丹法希尔幸存者，城市陷落一年后

paras.en: One year since paramilitary forces rampaged through Sudan’s El Fasher, the legacy of fear and trauma continues to haunt thousands of survivors.
paras.zh: 自准军事部队在苏丹法希尔肆虐一年以来，恐惧和创伤的阴影继续困扰着数千名幸存者。

paras.en: That’s the message from gender equality agency UN Women, which reported that nine in 10 Sudanese aid organizations it surveyed had found women or girls in distress who had received no mental health, psychosocial or legal support since fleeing the Darfuri city.
paras.zh: 这是性别平等机构联合国妇女署发出的信息，该机构报告称，在其调查的苏丹援助组织中，十分之九的人发现，自逃离达尔富里市以来，妇女或女孩陷入困境，没有得到任何心理健康、社会心理或法律支持。

paras.en: The war in Sudan erupted in April 2023 between the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF), former allies who had jointly seized power in a 2021 coup.
paras.zh: 苏丹战争于 2023 年 4 月在苏丹武装部队 (SAF) 和准军事快速支援部队 (RSF) 之间爆发，这两家部队曾是盟友，在 2021 年的政变中联合夺取了政权。

paras.en: On Friday, UN Women regional director Anna Mutavati told reporters in Geneva that some people have started to return, “but the fear of violence is constant”.
paras.zh: 周五，联合国妇女署区域主任安娜·穆塔瓦蒂在日内瓦告诉记者，一些人已经开始返回，“但对暴力的恐惧依然存在”。

paras.en: “The scars of the violence in El Fasher have not faded,” she said. “Women and girls continue to live with the trauma of sexual violence, the disappearance of their daughters, their sisters, their mothers, their husbands, and their sons, the killing of family members, and the loss of their homes, property, and livelihoods.”
paras.zh: “法希尔暴力事件的伤痕尚未消退，”她说。 “妇女和女童继续生活在性暴力的创伤之中，她们的女儿、姐妹、母亲、丈夫和儿子失踪，家庭成员被杀，家园、财产和生计丧失。”

paras.en: Reports of deadly strikes on civilians, rape and violence continue, said Ms. Mutavati, emphasising that drone attacks are increasing across Blue Nile, Khartoum, West Kordofan, Gedaref and Kassala.
paras.zh: 穆塔瓦蒂女士说，有关针对平民的致命袭击、强奸和暴力的报道仍在继续，她强调青尼罗河、喀土穆、西科尔多凡州、盖达里夫和卡萨拉的无人机袭击事件正在增加。

paras.en: “Most of those killed or injured are women and children,” she said. “Many had already fled violence, including sexual violence.”
paras.zh: “大多数死伤者是妇女和儿童，”她说。 “许多人已经逃离暴力，包括性暴力。”

articles.title: UN marks 81 years of global cooperation

paras.en: United Nations Day heralds the entry into force of the UN Charter in 1945. The global body officially came into being after the founding document was ratified by a majority of its signatories, including the five permanent members of the Security Council.
paras.zh: 联合国日预示着 1945 年《联合国宪章》的生效。这一全球机构在其创始文件得到大多数签署国（包括安理会五个常任理事国）批准后正式成立。

paras.en: The day has been celebrated annually on 24 October since 1948.
paras.zh: 自 1948 年以来，每年 10 月 24 日都会庆祝这一天。

paras.en: The agenda has remained unchanged: settling disputes through diplomacy, combating poverty and hunger, promoting human rights and delivering lifesaving aid to people affected by conflict, disasters and displacement.
paras.zh: 议程保持不变：通过外交解决争端、消除贫困和饥饿、促进人权以及向受冲突、灾害和流离失所影响的人们提供救生援助。

paras.en: In his last message marking the day in charge of the UN, Secretary-General António Guterres said it stood for the idea that “humanity’s future depends on our ability to work together to advance peace, development and human rights.”
paras.zh: 秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯在纪念联合国这一天的最后致辞中表示，联合国代表的理念是“人类的未来取决于我们共同努力推进和平、发展和人权的能力”。

paras.en: He highlighted the profound challenges facing the world today, including conflict, the climate crisis, rising inequalities and technological advances outpacing the ability to govern them.
paras.zh: 他强调了当今世界面临的深刻挑战，包括冲突、气候危机、不平等加剧以及超出治理能力的技术进步。

paras.en: “The United Nations is an essential part of the fabric of our world,” he said. “And it’s needed more than ever.”
paras.zh: “联合国是我们世界结构的重要组成部分，”他说。 “而且比以往任何时候都更需要它。”

paras.en: As the Second World War raged, a remarkable international effort was already taking shape to help rebuild a shattered world.
paras.zh: 随着第二次世界大战的激烈进行，一项非凡的国际努力已经形成，以帮助重建破碎的世界。

paras.en: Founded in November 1943, the United Nations Relief and Rehabilitation Administration (UNRRA) began its work before the United Nations itself had been constituted.
paras.zh: 联合国善后救济总署 (UNRRA) 成立于 1943 年 11 月，在联合国成立之前就开始了工作。

paras.en: Faced with hunger, disease, mass displacement and devastation, it helped deliver the essentials of survival and offered hope to millions struggling to rebuild their lives.
paras.zh: 面对饥饿、疾病、大规模流离失所和破坏，它帮助提供了生存必需品，并为数百万人努力重建生活带来了希望。

paras.en: Beyond emergency relief, UNRRA became a pioneering experiment in international cooperation.
paras.zh: 除了紧急救援之外，近东救济工程处还成为国际合作的开创性实验。

paras.en: UN Video highlights UNRRA’s extraordinary mission through archival footage and personal testimony.
paras.zh: 联合国视频通过档案录像和个人证词突显了联合国难民救济署的非凡使命。

articles.title: Women ‘first to suffer’ under siege, first to step up as frontline responders in Sudan

paras.en: Women ‘first to suffer’ under siege, first to step up as frontline responders in Sudan
paras.zh: 苏丹妇女“最先遭受围困”，最先挺身而出，成为前线救援人员

paras.en: When Tahani Al-Numeiri heard the first explosions in Khartoum, her hometown, war seemed so remote that she assumed they were celebrations from a nearby wedding. It was the morning of 15 April 2023, and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces had just turned their guns on the army.
paras.zh: 当塔哈尼·努迈里在她的家乡喀土穆听到第一声爆炸声时，战争似乎是如此遥远，以至于她以为这是附近一场婚礼的庆祝活动。那是2023年4月15日早上，准军事快速支援部队刚刚将枪口对准了军队。

paras.en: Large-scale conflict had only ever been either something that happened to others, or the stuff of fiction.
paras.zh: 大规模的冲突要么是发生在别人身上的事情，要么是虚构的故事。

paras.en: “I never imagined my life would turn out just like in the movie,” she says.
paras.zh: “我从未想过我的生活会像电影中一样，”她说。

paras.en: Yet for her and millions of Sudanese people, it came knocking on their front door as the war between rival militaries erupted three and a half years ago, triggering one of the world’s worst humanitarian crises.
paras.zh: 然而，对于她和数百万苏丹人民来说，三年半前敌对军队之间爆发战争，引发了世界上最严重的人道主义危机之一，这一切敲响了他们的前门。

paras.en: In the face of mass displacement, hunger, and psychosocial trauma, some women – spotlighted by gender equality agency, UN Women – rolled up their sleeves and emerged as key frontline responders.
paras.zh: 面对大规模流离失所、饥饿和社会心理创伤，一些受到性别平等机构联合国妇女署关注的女性卷起袖子，成为关键的前线应对者。

paras.en: Ms. Al-Numeiri and her family were one of the many who found themselves trapped in areas taken under siege.
paras.zh: 努迈里女士和她的家人是众多被困在被围困地区的人之一。

paras.en: In their case, they got stuck in Khartoum, which was disputed between the two main combatants – the RSF and the military government’s Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF).
paras.zh: 就他们而言，他们被困在喀土穆，这两个主要战斗方——无国界部队和军政府的苏丹武装部队（SAF）之间存在争议。

paras.en: Ms. Al-Numeiri, a journalist and activist, remembers how communication networks collapsed, banking services became inaccessible and essential supplies disappeared.
paras.zh: 记者兼活动人士努迈里女士还记得通讯网络如何崩溃、银行服务无法使用以及基本物资消失的情况。

paras.en: They were left with nothing to eat except boiled wheat, and they had to burn their furniture to keep themselves warm when fuel ran out.
paras.zh: 除了煮熟的小麦外，他们没有什么可吃的，当燃料耗尽时，他们不得不烧掉家具取暖。

paras.en: Malnutrition, contaminated water and lack of medical care caused her to fall critically ill.
paras.zh: 营养不良、水源污染和缺乏医疗护理导致她病危。

paras.en: “My body was swollen, my skin was peeling, scabs were coming off. I had a severe fever, and there was blood in my eyes. I could not even see anyone next to me. My family had given up. They said I was going to die,” she said.
paras.zh: “我的身体肿胀，皮肤脱皮，痂脱落。我发高烧，眼睛里有血。我什至看不到旁边的人。我的家人已经放弃了。他们说我快要死了，”她说。

paras.en: “Sunset came, then night, and I found myself still alive in my room”, says Ms. Al-Numeiri.
paras.zh: “日落来了，然后是夜晚，我发现自己在房间里还活着”，阿尔-努梅里女士说。

paras.en: After Khartoum was retaken by government troops in March 2025, and as she recovered, she turned to help others in her community who had also lived and suffered under the siege.
paras.zh: 2025 年 3 月喀土穆被政府军夺回后，当她康复后，她转而帮助社区中同样在围困下生活和遭受苦难的其他人。

paras.en: As she was collecting food for her family from a communal kitchen – a meagre two spoons of lentils – the woman running the kitchen found out she was a journalist and encouraged her to post online about the conditions families in the city were living in.
paras.zh: 当她从公共厨房为家人收集食物时（只有两勺小扁豆），负责厨房的女士发现她是一名记者，并鼓励她在网上发布有关该市家庭生活条件的信息。

paras.en: She soon became a volunteer at the kitchen herself and documented the impact of the war on women and children in videos that went viral online – in effect raising awareness and support for those in need in Sudan.
paras.zh: 她很快就成为了厨房的一名志愿者，并在网上疯传的视频中记录了战争对妇女和儿童的影响——实际上提高了人们对苏丹有需要的人的认识和支持。

paras.en: “I feel like I am a warrior on the frontlines,” she says.
paras.zh: “我觉得自己是前线的战士，”她说。

paras.en: Hundreds of miles away in the southwest of Khartoum, the city of El Fasher was also besieged by the RSF in October 2025.
paras.zh: 2025 年 10 月，距离喀土穆西南数百英里的法希尔市也遭到无国界部队的围困。

paras.en: Amna Mohamed*, the President of a women-led and UN-supported organization that provides meals and financial support to women in need in North Darfur, stayed in the city to continue helping her community.
paras.zh: 阿姆纳·穆罕默德*是一个由妇女领导、联合国支持的组织的主席，该组织为北达尔富尔州有需要的妇女提供膳食和财政支持，她留在该市继续帮助她的社区。

paras.en: Many were unable to flee – notably those who were caring for elderly relatives, persons with disabilities or other dependents who were unable to travel, and those who did not have the money to hire a donkey or other mode of transportation to leave.
paras.zh: 许多人无法逃离，特别是那些照顾年老亲戚、残疾人或其他无法出行的家属的人，以及那些没有钱租用驴子或其他交通工具离开的人。

paras.en: All endure severe food shortages, soaring prices, lack of healthcare and bombardments, but Mohamed stressed that “women were the first to suffer”.
paras.zh: 所有人都承受着严重的粮食短缺、物价飞涨、缺乏医疗保健和轰炸，但穆罕默德强调，“妇女是最先受苦的”。

paras.en: “They may beat or rape you, and sometimes they loot your belongings. Sometimes they demand that you leave your home; they may kill your husband or brothers right before your eyes, or they may take your daughters right in front of you and lead them away to unknown locations,” she said.
paras.zh: “他们可能会殴打或强奸你，有时他们会抢劫你的财物。有时他们会要求你离开家；他们可能会在你眼前杀死你的丈夫或兄弟，或者他们可能会在你面前带走你的女儿，并将她们带到不知名的地方，”她说。

paras.en: “Our relationship with women is direct and close, and as women-led organizations, we are best positioned to serve them; we understand their needs. However, when it comes to funding, projects sometimes go to organizations led by men,” she explained.
paras.zh: “我们与女性的关系是直接而密切的，作为女性领导的组织，我们最有能力为她们服务；我们了解她们的需求。然而，在资金方面，项目有时会流向男性领导的组织，”她解释道。

paras.en: Back in Khartoum, thousands of women are returning after being displaced for years across Sudan and in neighbouring countries.
paras.zh: 回到喀土穆，数千名在苏丹和邻国流离失所多年的妇女正在返回。

paras.en: Yet for many, while the end of one difficult chapter, coming home is only the start of another.
paras.zh: 然而对许多人来说，虽然一个艰难的篇章结束了，但回家只是另一篇章的开始。

paras.en: Many are dealing with trauma from the early stages of the war and from their displacement, and they have come back to looted houses, stripped of everything they owned – even doors and windows.
paras.zh: 许多人正在承受战争初期和流离失所带来的创伤，他们回到被抢劫的房屋，所拥有的一切都被剥夺了——甚至包括门窗。

paras.en: “After they returned home, women came back with nothing in their hands, they lost everything”, explains Israa Hamid Khalil, a psychological support officer at the UN Women-supported East Nile Women’s Empowerment Centre in the capital city.
paras.zh: 联合国妇女署支持的位于首都的东尼罗河妇女赋权中心的心理支持官员伊斯拉·哈米德·哈利勒 (Israa Hamid Khalil) 解释说：“妇女回家后，手里什么也没有，她们失去了一切。”

paras.en: The centre offers counselling and psychological care, as well as training and livelihood support to enable them to earn an income and support their families.
paras.zh: 该中心提供咨询和心理护理以及培训和生计支持，使他们能够赚取收入并养家糊口。

paras.en: “Women returned to the place where they had experienced those painful memories and traumas. They can’t just stay at home and keep reliving those things.
paras.zh: “女性回到了她们经历过那些痛苦记忆和创伤的地方。她们不能只待在家里，不断重温那些事情。

paras.en: “We now address this challenge: How can we help them overcome this stage and begin their journey of psychological recovery?” said Ms. Khalil.
paras.zh: “我们现在面临这个挑战：我们如何帮助他们克服这个阶段并开始他们的心理康复之旅？”卡里尔女士说。

articles.title: ‘Night and day different’ – why did Ferrari's pace evaporate again?

paras.en: Lewis Hamilton, Charles Leclerc discuss reasons why Ferrari went from US GP pole favourites to behind Kimi Antonelli, Red Bulls on grid
paras.zh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿 (Lewis Hamilton) 和查尔斯·勒克莱尔 (Charles Leclerc) 讨论了法拉利从美国大奖赛杆位热门球队变为落后于基米·安东内利 (Kimi Antonelli) 和红牛队的原因

paras.en: Ferrari had topped all three practice sessions but went on to qualify fourth and fifth; Both drivers hope race distance offers chance to battle at the front; watch the United States GP live on Sky Sports F1 and Sky Sports Main Event at 8pm on Sunday, build up from 6.30pm
paras.zh: 法拉利在所有三场练习赛中均名列前茅，但在排位赛中获得了第四和第五名；两位车手都希望比赛距离能提供在前线战斗的机会；周日晚上 8 点，从下午 6 点 30 分开始，观看天空体育 F1 和天空体育主赛事的美国大奖赛直播

paras.en: Ferrari's wait for a first Grand Prix pole position since August 2025 continued in the United States on Saturday as Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton qualified outside the top three in a session the team had appeared favourites for.
paras.zh: 周六，法拉利在美国继续等待自 2025 年 8 月以来的首个大奖赛杆位，查尔斯·勒克莱尔 (Charles Leclerc) 和刘易斯·汉密尔顿 (Lewis Hamilton) 在一场法拉利车队似乎最看好的比赛中，未能进入前三名。

paras.en: For the first time this season, Ferrari went into qualifying having topped all three practice sessions in Austin, on a weekend their car features the team's final significant upgrade of the season.
paras.zh: 法拉利本赛季首次进入排位赛，并在奥斯汀的所有三场练习赛中名列前茅，周末他们的赛车进行了车队本赛季最后一次重大升级。

paras.en: Leclerc finished second fastest to McLaren's Lando Norris in Q1, but only after the McLaren driver completed a second run to do so, and then was then back at the head of the field in Q2.
paras.zh: 勒克莱尔在第一季度的成绩仅次于迈凯伦车手兰多·诺里斯，但只有在迈凯伦车手完成第二次冲刺后才达到第二快，然后在第二季度重新回到领先地位。

paras.en: But the Scuderia found themselves on the back foot immediately from the start of Q3 with Leclerc holding a provisional fourth and Hamilton sixth after the first runs of the decisive final phase.
paras.zh: 但法拉利车队从第三季度开始就发现自己处于不利地位，在决定性的最后阶段的第一轮比赛后，勒克莱尔暂时获得第四名，汉密尔顿获得第六名。

paras.en: Hamilton improved one place to fifth on his final run, but Leclerc stayed where he was, to leave the Ferraris behind the two Red Bull drivers and Mercedes polesitter Kimi Antonelli for the start of Sunday's 56-lap race.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿在最后一场比赛中将名次提升一位至第五，但勒克莱尔仍保持原位，在周日 56 圈比赛的开始时将法拉利车队抛在了两位红牛车手和梅赛德斯杆位得主基米·安东内利的后面。

paras.en: Yet had Leclerc matched his benchmark time from the theoretically-slower Q2 session he would have qualified second.
paras.zh: 然而，如果勒克莱尔能够达到理论上较慢的第二季度的基准时间，他将获得第二名。

paras.en: Team principal Frederic Vasseur told Sky Sports F1: "Bit of mixed feelings for sure. The potential was there over the weekend. We had good pace in free practice.
paras.zh: 车队领队弗雷德里克·瓦瑟告诉天空体育F1：“肯定有点复杂的感觉。周末的潜力就在那里。我们在自由练习中节奏很好。

paras.en: "Until the last corner we are fighting for pole but it is like it is."
paras.zh: “直到最后一个弯道，我们都在为杆位而战，但事实就是如此。”

paras.en: On team radio after ending up fifth, 0.276s away from pole, a bemused Hamilton said: "These guys must be turning up [their engines] for that last Q3 because where did that time go?"
paras.zh: 在距离杆位仅差 0.276 秒，获得第五名后，汉密尔顿困惑地说道：“这些家伙肯定在最后一个第三季度开动了他们的引擎，因为时间都去哪儿了？”

paras.en: Speaking to Sky Sports F1 afterwards, Hamilton said that his car's handling had felt consistent through all three sessions, suspecting that the team's straight-line speed deficit had again played a central role in them being usurped.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿随后在接受天空体育F1采访时表示，他的赛车在所有三场比赛中的操控性都保持一致，他怀疑车队的直线速度缺陷再次在他们被篡夺的过程中发挥了核心作用。

paras.en: "We did a really good job overnight. The car felt really good in FP3 - competitive," said Hamilton, who had topped that final practice session.
paras.zh: “我们一夜之间做得非常好。这辆车在 FP3 中感觉非常好 - 有竞争力，”在最后的练习赛中获得冠军的汉密尔顿说道。

paras.en: "Q1 and Q2 both felt pretty strong. It felt like we were right there in the fight and the car was just as good as.. we didn't make any changes, the car didn't flip upside down in Q3. It was a really good lap.
paras.zh: “Q1和Q2都感觉相当强劲。感觉就像我们就在战斗中，赛车也一样好......我们没有做任何改变，赛车在Q3中没有翻过来。这是一个非常好的单圈。

paras.en: "Those guys just somehow took another step. I don't know what it is. Ultimately we do lose, I think we are a few tenths off on the straight as we usually are, but a great lap by Kimi and the power deficit to the Red Bull and Mercedes is still significant.
paras.zh: “那些家伙只是不知何故又迈出了一步。我不知道那是什么。最终我们确实输了，我认为我们在直道上像往常一样落后了零点几，但基米的出色单圈以及对红牛和梅赛德斯的动力赤字仍然很大。

paras.en: "Our car is clearly as good as theirs through the corners but we lose that down the straights."
paras.zh: “我们的车在弯道上显然和他们的一样好，但我们在直道上就输了。”

paras.en: Leclerc, though, offered an alternative suggestion, believing that a decrease in track temperature for the start of Q3 had made a pivotal difference to their competitiveness, causing tyre warm-up issues.
paras.zh: 不过，勒克莱尔提出了另一种建议，他认为第三季度开始时赛道温度的下降对他们的竞争力产生了关键影响，导致了轮胎预热问题。

paras.en: Asked if it was again a case of rivals finding something extra to them at the end of qualifying, Leclerc replied: "This time I think it's slightly different in that I don't think the others have changed anything from Q2 to Q3. Where we have lost is on ourselves and that is mostly the tyres.
paras.zh: 当被问及这是否又是对手在排位赛结束时为他们找到额外的东西时，勒克莱尔回答道：“这一次我认为略有不同，因为我认为其他人从第二季度到第三季度没有做出任何改变。我们输掉的地方在于我们自己，而这主要是轮胎。”

paras.en: "The out lap was extremely difficult. There was a bit more cloud in Q3. We lost one or two degrees of track temp and, for us, it was night and day different and already from the out lap I felt I was having lots of difficulties.
paras.zh: “外圈非常困难。第三季度有更多的云。我们失去了一两度的赛道温度，对我们来说，白天和黑夜都不同，从外圈开始我就觉得自己遇到了很多困难。

paras.en: "It's a shame that it happened in Q3 because I strongly believe that we had the pace to be fighting in front but unfortunately not today again."
paras.zh: “很遗憾这件事发生在第三季度，因为我坚信我们有足够的速度在前面战斗，但不幸的是今天不会再发生了。”

paras.en: Ferrari last started a Grand Prix from pole position in 2025 in Hungary.
paras.zh: 法拉利上一次以杆位开始大奖赛是在 2025 年匈牙利。

paras.en: Why Ferrari are not out of victory hunt yet
paras.zh: 为什么法拉利还没有摆脱胜利的追逐

paras.en: All is not yet lost, however, for Ferrari in terms of fighting at the front in Sunday's race on a track where overtaking is possible and tyre degradation is predicted to be high.
paras.zh: 然而，对于法拉利来说，在周日的比赛中，在一条可能超车且预计轮胎老化程度很高的赛道上奋力拼搏，一切还没有结束。

paras.en: Leclerc felt they could even still repeat his Austin victory from the same starting berth two years ago.
paras.zh: 勒克莱尔认为他们甚至仍然可以在两年前的同一个首发位置上重复他在奥斯汀的胜利。

paras.en: "Yeah [Ferrari can still win the race]. The last time I think I started from fourth here I won so I hope we can do the same," he said.
paras.zh: “是的，[法拉利仍然可以赢得比赛]。上次我认为我从第四位开始，我赢了，所以我希望我们也能这样做，”他说。

paras.en: "Just a good start and then where you position your car and trying to anticipate what is going to happen [is key] because there are many different scenarios that can happen in such a turn one with very wide entry.
paras.zh: “只要有一个好的开始，然后你把车放在哪里，并尝试预测将要发生的事情（是关键），因为在这样一个入口非常宽的转弯处，可能会发生许多不同的情况。

paras.en: "Then if you are doing the right choices you can get a lot more than any other track, so I'm looking forward to that."
paras.zh: “如果你做出正确的选择，你可以获得比任何其他赛道更多的东西，所以我很期待这一点。”

paras.en: Hamilton was staying cautious given the pace of the cars ahead, but expressed hope that Ferrari could still be a threat over the full race distance.
paras.zh: 考虑到前方赛车的速度，汉密尔顿保持谨慎，但表示希望法拉利在整场比赛中仍能构成威胁。

paras.en: "Starting position isn't everything. You have to have really good pace to overtake," he added.
paras.zh: “起步位置并不代表一切。你必须有非常好的速度才能超车，”他补充道。

paras.en: "It's a long race. There was more degradation than anticipated on Friday on the long runs. Our car will hopefully be decent and we will do the best job we can to apply pressure.
paras.zh: “这是一场漫长的比赛。周五的长距离比赛中，退化情况比预期的要多。我们的赛车有望表现良好，我们将尽最大努力施加压力。

paras.en: "To beat the Red Bulls and Mercedes will be challenging, for sure, but we will give it absolutely everything."
paras.zh: “击败红牛和梅赛德斯无疑是一项挑战，但我们绝对会全力以赴。”

paras.zh: 下午 6.30：周日大奖赛：美国大奖赛筹备*

articles.title: 'Not realistic' - Can Wolff's assessment of Antonelli's title chance be trusted?

paras.en: United States GP: How likely is pole-sitter Kimi Antonelli to win 2026 F1 Drivers' Championship on Sunday in Austin?
paras.zh: 美国大奖赛：杆位得主基米·安东内利周日在奥斯汀赢得 2026 年 F1 车手冠军的可能性有多大？

paras.en: Kimi Antonelli starts on pole position for Sunday's race in Austin from Max Verstappen, so what are his chances of winning the championship today? Watch the United States GP live on Sky Sports F1 & Sky Sports Main Event at 8pm on Sunday, with build up from 6.30pm
paras.zh: 周日在奥斯汀举行的比赛中，基米·安东内利 (Kimi Antonelli) 从马克斯·维斯塔潘 (Max Verstappen) 的杆位出发，那么他今天赢得冠军的机会有多大呢？周日晚上 8 点在天空体育 F1 和天空体育主赛事中观看美国大奖赛直播，从下午 6 点 30 分开始

paras.en: Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff believes it is "not realistic" for Kimi Antonelli to win the 2026 F1 Drivers' Championship on Sunday at the United States Grand Prix, despite the Italian starting on pole position.
paras.zh: 梅赛德斯车队领队托托·沃尔夫认为基米·安东内利周日在美国大奖赛上赢得 2026 年 F1 车手冠军“不现实”，尽管意大利人从杆位起步。

paras.en: Antonelli was not expected to claim top spot in qualifying but produced a superb lap in Q3 to beat Red Bull's Max Verstappen and take his first pole position since July's Belgian Grand Prix.
paras.zh: 安东内利预计不会在排位赛中获得第一，但在第三季度表现出色，击败了红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘，取得了自 7 月比利时大奖赛以来的首个杆位。

paras.en: Should Antonelli win Sunday's race in Austin with Lewis Hamilton finishing fifth or lower and George Russell ninth or lower, he will seal the title with five rounds remaining.
paras.zh: 如果安东内利赢得周日在奥斯汀举行的比赛，刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第五或更低，乔治·拉塞尔排名第九或更低，他将在还剩五轮的情况下锁定冠军。

paras.en: Hamilton will start fifth and Russell sixth when the lights go out at the Circuit of the Americas at 8pm (build-up from 6.30pm), live on Sky Sports F1 and Main Event.
paras.zh: 当美洲赛道晚上 8 点熄灯时（从下午 6 点 30 分开始），天空体育 F1 和主赛事现场直播，汉密尔顿将从第五位出发，拉塞尔将从第六位出发。

paras.en: However, Wolff has warned Mercedes will not have the pace to win as they did not have the pace in Friday practice's long runs.
paras.zh: 然而，沃尔夫警告梅赛德斯不会有获胜的速度，因为他们在周五的长跑练习中没有速度。

paras.en: "We are not talking about that [the championship]. It's not realistic," he told Sky Sports F1.
paras.zh: “我们不是在谈论这个[锦标赛]。这不现实，”他告诉天空体育F1。

paras.en: "I don't think we are quickest in the race, so it's about scoring points and eventually, hopefully, winning."
paras.zh: “我不认为我们在比赛中跑得最快，所以关键是得分，并希望最终获胜。”

paras.en: Antonelli is also wary of Red Bull's race pace and the possibility Verstappen in second and Isack Hadjar in third can also work together.
paras.zh: 安东内利还对红牛的比赛节奏持谨慎态度，第二名的维斯塔潘和第三名的伊萨克·哈贾尔也有可能合作。

paras.en: He admits this week has been "a bit different", knowing it is the first opportunity to become the sport's youngest world champion at 20 years old.
paras.zh: 他承认本周“有点不同”，因为他知道这是 20 岁时第一次有机会成为这项运动最年轻的世界冠军。

paras.en: "The goal stays the same. I just need to keep doing my job, and actually, I feel like I can enjoy the driving and everything more," said Antonelli.
paras.zh: “目标保持不变。我只需要继续做好我的工作，实际上，我觉得我可以享受驾驶和其他一切，”安东内利说。

paras.en: "But of course, we still have to do the race, still have to try and win, and then, of course, we'll see what happens. But, I feel like I can enjoy it a bit more because obviously I'm in a very good position. But still, the mindset is always the same."
paras.zh: “但是，当然，我们仍然必须参加比赛，仍然必须尝试获胜，然后，当然，我们会看看会发生什么。但是，我觉得我可以更享受它，因为显然我处于一个非常好的位置。但是，心态始终是一样的。”

paras.en: Verstappen plans to 'keep it respectful' against Antonelli
paras.zh: 维斯塔潘计划“尊重”安东内利

paras.en: The uphill run towards the wide Turn 1 at the start provides a good opportunity for the driver in second to steam up the inside of the pole-sitter, something Verstappen may look to do if he has a strong getaway.
paras.zh: 起步时朝向宽阔的 1 号弯的上坡路段为第二名车手提供了一个很好的机会，让杆位得主的内侧变得更加强劲，如果维斯塔潘有强劲的起步能力，他可能会这样做。

paras.en: Verstappen, who has won the last two races, effectively has nothing to lose but suggested he will not be excessively aggressive against championship leader Antonelli.
paras.zh: 赢得了过去两场比赛的维斯塔潘实际上没有什么可失去的，但他表示他不会对冠军领头羊安东内利过于激进。

paras.en: "Kimi wants to go for the win right? That helps his position in the championship," he told Sky Sports F1.
paras.zh: “基米想要赢得胜利，对吗？这有助于他在锦标赛中的地位，”他告诉天空体育F1。

paras.en: "We keep it respectful and try to win the race."
paras.zh: “我们保持尊重并努力赢得比赛。”

paras.en: Tyre degradation was high in Friday's practice sessions in Austin but that has been the case at several races this season, only for the Grand Prix to turn into a one-stop race as the teams have changed the setup on their cars and the track has gripped up over the weekend.
paras.zh: 周五在奥斯汀举行的练习赛中，轮胎退化程度很高，但本赛季的几场比赛都出现了这种情况，只是大奖赛变成了一场一站式比赛，因为车队改变了赛车的设置，并且赛道在周末变得紧张。

paras.en: Nevertheless, overtaking is possible and Verstappen cut a quietly confident figure to make it a hat-trick of wins and deny any chance Antonelli has of winning the title on Sunday.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，超车还是有可能的，维斯塔潘表现得平静而自信，上演了胜利的帽子戏法，并否认了安东内利周日赢得冠军的任何机会。

paras.en: "We have been happier in the long runs, and I hope that it will be the same tomorrow," he said.
paras.zh: “从长远来看，我们更加快乐，我希望明天也是如此，”他说。

paras.en: As for Russell, it has been another tricky weekend and he faces a big challenge to overtake Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc in front of him, who have both been quick in practice, to get into the podium fight.
paras.zh: 至于拉塞尔，这又是一个棘手的周末，他面临着超越前面的法拉利车手刘易斯·汉密尔顿和查尔斯·勒克莱尔的巨大挑战，他们在练习中都很快，进入领奖台之战。

paras.en: Russell has been unable to get to grips with Mercedes' new upgrade package but admits he simply just did "two bad laps in Q3".
paras.zh: 拉塞尔一直无法掌握梅赛德斯的新升级包，但承认他只是“在第三季度跑了两圈糟糕的圈子”。

paras.en: "I think I could have been in the top three. My Q2 lap was two and a half tenths quicker than what I achieved in Q3 but that obviously isn't good enough from my side," he told Sky Sports F1.
paras.zh: “我认为我本来可以进入前三名。我的第二季度圈速比第三季度快了十分之二半，但这显然对我来说还不够好，”他告诉天空体育F1。

paras.en: Asked about his race prospects, he said: "I think it's a long race, a lot happens here in Austin. Strategy plays a role so still opportunities."
paras.zh: 当被问及他的比赛前景时，他说：“我认为这是一场漫长的比赛，奥斯汀这里发生了很多事情。策略发挥着作用，所以机会仍然存在。”

articles.title: 'Dream come true!' - Britain's Palmowski becomes 2026 F1 Academy champion

paras.en: F1 Academy: Alisha Palmowski becomes 2026 champion with three races of season to spare in Austin
paras.zh: F1 学院：阿丽莎·帕莫夫斯基 (Alisha Palmowski) 凭借本赛季在奥斯汀举行的三场比赛成为 2026 年冠军

paras.en: Alisha Palmowski became the second Briton to win the F1 Academy title; Palmowski has dominated most of the season and will look to cap off a memorable weekend on Sunday when she starts on pole position for the main race at 5pm, live on Sky Sports F1
paras.zh: Alisha Palmowski 成为第二位赢得 F1 学院冠军的英国人；帕莫夫斯基在整个赛季的大部分时间里都占据主导地位，她将在周日下午 5 点在天空体育 F1 直播的主赛中以杆位出发，为这个难忘的周末画上圆满的句号

paras.en: Britain's Alisha Palmowski became the 2026 F1 Academy champion with three races to spare after building an unassailable lead in Austin.
paras.zh: 英国选手阿丽莎·帕莫夫斯基 (Alisha Palmowski) 在奥斯汀站确立无懈可击的领先优势后，在还剩三场比赛的情况下成为 2026 年 F1 学院冠军。

paras.en: Palmowski followed up victory in Friday's Opening Race at the Circuit of the Americas with second in the Reverse Grid Race behind Alba Larsen to take a 70-point lead over her closest championship challenger, Emma Felbermayr, with only a maximum if 67 points remaining.
paras.zh: 帕尔莫夫斯基在周五美洲赛道开幕赛中取得胜利后，在反向发车区比赛中获得第二名，落后于阿尔巴·拉森 (Alba Larsen)，领先最接近的冠军挑战者艾玛·费尔伯迈尔 (Emma Felbermayr) 70 分，积分差距仅剩 67 分。

paras.en: The Red Bull-backed driver has dominated this season by winning five of the 11 races so far with six pole positions to become the second Briton after Abbi Pulling in 2024 to win the F1 Academy title.
paras.zh: 这位红牛支持的车手在本赛季占据主导地位，迄今已赢得 11 场比赛中的 5 场，并获得 6 个杆位，成为继 2024 年阿比·拉林 (Abbi Pulling) 之后第二位赢得 F1 学院冠军的英国人。

paras.en: - How Kimi Antonelli can win F1 world title at US GP
paras.zh: - 基米·安东内利如何在美国大奖赛上赢得 F1 世界冠军

paras.zh: - F1 2026 日历 | F1 2026 积分榜 | F1八卦专栏

paras.en: - Not got Sky? Latest Sky Sports deals or stream F1 with no contract 📺
paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新天空体育优惠或无合同直播 F1 📺

paras.en: Palmowski, 20, is the youngest F1 Academy champion and praised the team and her family, who were in attendance in Austin.
paras.zh: 20 岁的帕莫夫斯基是最年轻的 F1 学院冠军，她对出席奥斯汀的车队和家人表示赞扬。

paras.en: "We did it guys! It's incredible. I don't know what to say. I'm trying not to cry!" she said.
paras.zh: “我们做到了，伙计们！这太不可思议了。我不知道该说什么。我努力不哭！”她说。

paras.en: "There's so much hard work gone on behind the scenes, not just from myself, but all the people you won't see. They have lived it day and night.
paras.zh: “幕后付出了如此多的艰苦努力，不仅仅是我自己，还有所有你看不到的人。他们日日夜夜地生活着。

paras.en: "We have worked so hard as a team, Campos Racing and Red Bull Racing. We have left no stone unturned. I don't want to name names but my engineer Diego has lived this with me every day and night."
paras.zh: “坎波斯车队和红牛车队作为一个团队，我们非常努力地工作。我们不遗余力。我不想透露姓名，但我的工程师迭戈每天每夜都和我一起生活。”

paras.en: Palmowski has won the title in her second full campaign after an impressive rookie season where she won the 2025 season-opener and took another four podiums.
paras.zh: 帕尔莫夫斯基在经历了令人印象深刻的新秀赛季后，在她的第二个完整赛季中赢得了冠军头衔，她赢得了 2025 年赛季揭幕战，并另外四次登上领奖台。

paras.en: She has been backed by Red Bull since the start of last year after finishing as runner-up in the 2024 GB4 Championship.
paras.zh: 在 2024 年 GB4 锦标赛中获得亚军后，她自去年年初以来一直受到红牛的支持。

paras.en: "I've learned so much in the last 18 months to two years being with Red Bull," she said.
paras.zh: “在过去的 18 个月到两年里，我在红牛工作中学到了很多东西，”她说。

paras.en: "I learned about things I didn't know. I've developed so much, not only as a driver but a person as well. I've matured so much in the last 12 months. It's a dream come true."
paras.zh: “我学到了一些我不知道的事情。我成长了很多，不仅作为一名车手，而且作为一个人。在过去 12 个月里我成熟了很多。这是梦想成真。”

paras.en: Previous F1 Academy champions Marta Garcia, Pulling and Doriane Pin have gone on to race in other motorsport categories in endurance racing and Formula Regional.
paras.zh: 前 F1 学院冠军玛塔·加西亚 (Marta Garcia)、普林 (Pulling) 和多丽安·平 (Doriane Pin) 继续参加耐力赛和地区方程式赛车等其他赛车运动类别的比赛。

paras.en: Palmowski, who starts on pole for Sunday's main race in Austin at 5pm, live on Sky Sports F1, may now look to make a similar move in 2027.
paras.zh: 周日下午 5 点在奥斯汀举行的主赛中，帕莫夫斯基在天空体育 F1 直播中获得杆位，现在他可能会在 2027 年做出类似的举动。

paras.en: "There are conversations happening in the background but I'm leaving that to my management team," she told Sky Sports F1.
paras.zh: “后台正在进行一些对话，但我将其留给我的管理团队，”她告诉天空体育 F1。

paras.en: "I want to go as far up the single-seater ladder as possible but I'm aware motorsport is a results-based business.
paras.zh: “我想在单座赛车的阶梯上尽可能走得更高，但我知道赛车运动是一项注重结果的行业。

paras.en: "I'm a big believer that when you go in a car, the helmet goes on, the car doesn't have a gender and we are fighting for the same thing."
paras.zh: “我坚信，当你坐上汽车时，头盔就会戴上，汽车没有性别之分，我们正在为同一件事而奋斗。”

articles.title: How Starlink slowdown hit Ukraine’s front line soldiers pushing Russia back
articles.author: Anastasiia Parafeniuk

paras.en: The drone unit he leads has been helping push back Russian troops on the front lines in southeastern Ukraine. Then, late last Tuesday, a drone launched toward Russian troops suddenly lost connection.
paras.zh: 他领导的无人机部队一直在帮助击退乌克兰东南部前线的俄罗斯军队。然后，上周二晚些时候，一架向俄罗斯军队发射的无人机突然失去了联系。

paras.en: “As it was picking up speed, contact with the drone was lost in an instant,” according to the commander, 47, who is serving on the border between the eastern Donetsk and southern Zaporizhzhia regions, and only wanted to be identified by his call sign Flint due to the sensitivity of his service.
paras.zh: 47 岁的指挥官表示，“随着无人机速度加快，瞬间失去了与无人机的联系。”他在顿涅茨克东部和扎波罗热地区南部边境服役，由于任务的敏感性，他只想通过呼号弗林特来识别身份。

paras.en: The drone fell to the ground, aborting the mission, Flint said in a series of messages on WhatsApp. He fears the technology inside “may have fallen into enemy hands.”
paras.zh: 弗林特在 WhatsApp 上发布的一系列消息中表示，无人机坠落地面，任务中止。他担心里面的技术“可能已经落入敌人手中”。

paras.en: “Only after analyzing the flight, it became clear that the issue was specifically related to the Starlink speed limit,” he added.
paras.zh: “只有在分析了这次飞行之后，才清楚地发现这个问题与星链速度限制特别相关，”他补充道。

paras.en: Ukraine said last week that limits were imposed without warning on its use of Starshield, the military variant of the Starlink internet service run by Elon Musk’s SpaceX, affecting battlefield missions reliant on it.
paras.zh: 乌克兰上周表示，在没有警告的情况下对其使用 Starshield 进行了限制，Starshield 是埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 SpaceX 运营的 Starlink 互联网服务的军事变体，影响了依赖它的战场任务。

paras.en: President Donald Trump said Thursday that Musk had restored the service in Ukraine, but Kyiv said Friday that it was not seeing any lifting of restrictions. Trump did not say why the limits were in place, though Musk had previously said that “any limits on speed or usage are decided by the U.S. military and ultimately POTUS.” Ukraine had also warned of gaps in intelligence sharing from the U.S., something the White House has denied.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统周四表示，马斯克已经恢复了乌克兰的服务，但基辅周五表示，限制措施并未解除。特朗普没有说明为什么要实行这些限制，尽管马斯克此前曾表示，“对速度或使用的任何限制都是由美国军方决定的，并最终由美国总统决定。”乌克兰还警告称，美国在情报共享方面存在漏洞，但白宫对此予以否认。

paras.en: A second drone pilot, serving in the eastern Kharkiv region, said that Ukraine does not have an alternative that’s as effective as Starlink for flying drones, but it also affects the unit’s movements — and ultimately survival chances out in the field.
paras.zh: 另一名在东部哈尔科夫地区服役的无人机飞行员表示，乌克兰没有像星链一样有效的无人机飞行替代方案，但它也会影响该部队的行动，并最终影响在野外的生存机会。

paras.en: “When we drive into a position, we have a Starlink Mini mounted on the vehicle, and we always try to get there as fast as possible, because if we drive slowly, the enemy will spot us and a drone will catch up with us,” said the pilot, who also only wanted to be identified by his call sign, Dovbush. “So we try to drive fast, but when we drive fast, the connection drops.”
paras.zh: “当我们驾驶到一个位置时，我们的车辆上安装了一个 Starlink Mini，我们总是试图尽快到达那里，因为如果我们开得很慢，敌人就会发现我们，无人机就会追上我们，”飞行员说，他也只想通过他的呼号 Dovbush 来识别身份。 “所以我们尝试开快车，但当我们开快车时，连接就会中断。”

paras.en: That leaves them with a radio as the only alternative for communication, Dovbush, 31, said, while a lack of reliable connection has impacted reconnaissance drones used to identify targets, he added.
paras.zh: 31 岁的多夫布什表示，这使得他们只能使用无线电作为通信的唯一选择，而缺乏可靠的连接已经影响了用于识别目标的侦察无人机。

paras.en: “It’s a knife in the back,” Flint, the drone unit commander, said of the apparent withdrawal of U.S. support.
paras.zh: “这是背后捅刀子，”无人机部队指挥官弗林特在谈到美国明显撤回的支持时说道。

paras.en: He said his unit relies on Starshield to fly attack and reconnaissance drones at anything from Russian troops to command posts to tanks. “Its primary role is maintaining the connection with the drone, so this is a very significant loss for us,” he added.
paras.zh: 他说，他的部队依靠“星盾”来驾驶攻击和侦察无人机，从俄罗斯军队到指挥所再到坦克。 “它的主要作用是保持与无人机的连接，因此这对我们来说是一个非常重大的损失，”他补充道。

paras.en: Should Starshield restrictions continue, a large portion of their drones will never even get off the ground, he said, while others will be highly vulnerable, flying at lower speeds. “They could practically be swatted out of the sky with a stick,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说，如果星盾限制继续下去，他们的大部分无人机将永远不会离开地面，而其他无人机将非常脆弱，飞行速度较低。 “他们几乎可以用棍子从天上拍下来，”他说。

paras.en: “And the scariest part is that all this is happening against the backdrop of offensive operations on many areas of the front line, including ours,” he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“最可怕的是，这一切都是在包括我们在内的前线许多地区进行进攻行动的背景下发生的。”

paras.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Friday that restrictions on Starlink were still in place, but that U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio had told him it would be fully back in about 48 to 72 hours.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基周五表示，对星链的限制仍然存在，但美国国务卿马可·卢比奥告诉他，星链将在大约 48 至 72 小时内完全恢复。

paras.en: Before the latest collapse in relations with Washington, Ukraine’s military had been chipping away at land seized by Russia in the eastern Donetsk region, part of the Donbas heartland that the Kremlin has been struggling to capture.
paras.zh: 在与华盛顿关系最近崩溃之前，乌克兰军方一直在蚕食俄罗斯在顿涅茨克东部地区夺取的土地，该地区是克里姆林宫一直在努力夺取的顿巴斯中心地带的一部分。

paras.en: In one major operation, more than 100 square miles of territory and 16 settlements have been reclaimed, Ukrainian officials have said, crediting methods like using bomber drones to fly robot vehicles behind enemy lines.
paras.zh: 乌克兰官员表示，在一次重大行动中，超过 100 平方英里的领土和 16 个定居点已被收复，这归功于使用轰炸机无人机在敌后驾驶机器人车辆等方法。

paras.en: The offensive — dubbed Operation Vivaldi — was made public several weeks before the drastic turn from the United States. Trump has agreed to a diesel deal with Russia, waived sweeping new sanctions and seen his peace envoy laud Russian President Vladimir Putin as a “humanitarian.” Ukraine accused the U.S. of briefly withholding intelligence warnings about Russian attacks, and has said the Starlink slowdown has affected battlefield missions.
paras.zh: 这次被称为“维瓦尔第行动”的攻势是在美国态度急剧转变的几周前公布的。特朗普已同意与俄罗斯达成柴油协议，放弃全面的新制裁，并看到他的和平特使称赞俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京是“人道主义者”。乌克兰指责美国短暂隐瞒有关俄罗斯袭击的情报警告，并表示星链速度放缓影响了战场任务。

paras.en: The U.S. has vehemently denied freezing Ukraine out, but the slew of dramatic developments have left Ukrainian troops disheartened. NBC News spoke with five soldiers, mostly drone operators, who said they felt betrayed by the U.S., and Trump in particular.
paras.zh: 美国强烈否认将乌克兰排除在外，但一系列戏剧性的事态发展让乌克兰军队感到沮丧。 NBC 新闻采访了五名士兵，其中大部分是无人机操作员，他们表示感觉被美国，尤其是特朗普背叛了。

paras.en: Ukrainian officials say that the offensive has disrupted Russia’s assault on Sloviansk and Kramatorsk, key Ukrainian strongholds in the Donbas region.
paras.zh: 乌克兰官员表示，此次攻势扰乱了俄罗斯对斯洛维安斯克和克拉马托尔斯克这两个乌克兰在顿巴斯地区的重要据点的进攻。

paras.en: “We prevented the enemy from flanking the Sloviansk-Kramatorsk agglomeration and trapping it in a pincer movement,” said Brig. Gen. Andrii Biletskyi, commander of the Third Army Corps, which led the operation. The offensive, in which Biletskyi said some 8.000 Russian troops were killed, saw Ukraine use bomber drones to deliver robot vehicles deep behind enemy lines and convert Soviet-era armored personnel carriers into exploding units to “blow up the enemy’s most heavily fortified positions,” he added.
paras.zh: “我们阻止了敌人从侧翼包围斯洛维尼亚斯克-克拉马托尔斯克集结区并将其困于夹击之中，”准将说。领导这次行动的第三军团司令安德里·比列茨基将军。比列茨基称，在这次攻势中，大约有 8000 名俄罗斯士兵被杀，乌克兰使用轰炸机无人机将机器人车辆运送到敌后深处，并将苏联时代的装甲运兵车改装成爆炸装置，以“炸毁敌方戒备最森严的阵地”，他补充道。

paras.en: “That was us,” a Ukrainian drone pilot told NBC News as he said his unit was redeploying elsewhere. “Our reconnaissance drone positions moved forward every three weeks,” the soldier, 24, who only wanted to be identified by his call sign Lucky because of the sensitive nature of his service, said in a series of audio messages on WhatsApp.
paras.zh: “那就是我们，”一名乌克兰无人机飞行员告诉 NBC 新闻，他说他的部队正在重新部署到其他地方。 “我们的侦察无人机阵地每三周就会向前移动一次，”这名 24 岁的士兵在 WhatsApp 上发布的一系列音频消息中说道，由于其服务的敏感性，他只希望用自己的呼号“Lucky”来识别身份。

paras.en: During a meeting with his army chiefs last week, Putin said Russian forces were on the offensive along the entire front line. “The pace of advancement has increased significantly,” he added.
paras.zh: 普京上周在与陆军参谋长会面时表示，俄罗斯军队正在整条前线发起进攻。 “进步的步伐显着加快，”他补充道。

paras.en: But George Barros, a senior Russia analyst with the Washington-based Institute for the Study of War, which has provided daily analysis of the battlefield situation in Ukraine, said they assess that Russia has seized a net of only about 40 square miles across all of Ukraine since the beginning of the year. “That means that the daily average Russian rate of advance is far below 0.4 square miles per day. This is a literal foot-pace advance,” he said. “In the month of September, we observed evidence to assess that the Ukrainians actually liberated and took back more territory than the Russians did.”
paras.zh: 但华盛顿战争研究所的高级俄罗斯分析师乔治·巴罗斯(George Barros)每天对乌克兰战场局势进行分析，他表示，他们评估称，自今年年初以来，俄罗斯在乌克兰全境仅占领了一张约40平方英里的网。 “这意味着俄罗斯日均推进速度远低于每天 0.4 平方英里。这实际上是脚步式的推进，”他说。 “九月份，我们观察到的证据表明，乌克兰人实际上解放并夺回了比俄罗斯人更多的领土。”

paras.en: Putin’s army chief, Gen. Valery Gerasimov, told the Russian leader that the Ukrainian offensive was a series of “PR stunts” that achieved nothing and cost Ukraine 3,500 troops who had been either killed or wounded.
paras.zh: 普京的陆军总司令瓦列里·格拉西莫夫 (Valery Gerasimov) 将军告诉俄罗斯领导人，乌克兰的攻势是一系列“公关噱头”，毫无结果，并导致乌克兰 3,500 名士兵死伤。

paras.en: But Barros said the offensive allowed Ukraine to push forward with tanks and armored personnel carriers into the drone-dominated battlefield, negate Russian drone defenses and find ways to push its forces forward and make gains.
paras.zh: 但巴罗斯表示，此次攻势使乌克兰能够将坦克和装甲运兵车推进到无人机主导的战场，抵消俄罗斯无人机的防御，并找到推动其部队前进并取得进展的方法。

paras.en: Critically, it stopped the northern encirclement of the stronghold cities in Donetsk, putting a wrench in Putin’s plans to complete the capture of Donbas this year, military experts said.
paras.zh: 军事专家表示，至关重要的是，它阻止了对顿涅茨克据点城市的北方包围，从而给普京今年完成攻占顿巴斯的计划带来了麻烦。

paras.en: “Ukraine’s Operation Vivaldi was unquestionably a major success,” said Rajan Menon, senior research scholar at Columbia University’s Saltzman Institute of War and Peace Studies.
paras.zh: 哥伦比亚大学萨尔兹曼战争与和平研究所高级研究学者拉詹·梅农说：“乌克兰的维瓦尔第行动无疑取得了重大成功。”

paras.en: But the Starshield slowdown is a “severe problem for Ukraine,” Menon said, “and a godsend for Putin.”
paras.zh: 但星盾计划的放缓“对乌克兰来说是一个严重问题”，梅农说，“对普京来说也是天赐之物。”

paras.en: If the restrictions continue for the medium- to long-term, Russian forces will be able to restore their logistics in the regions close to the front line that they control and that Ukraine has been pummeling with middle-range strikes this year, Barros said. As a result, Russia could regain resources to push forward with greater operational tempo, he added, increasing the likelihood of a breakthrough.
paras.zh: 巴罗斯表示，如果这些限制在中长期持续下去，俄罗斯军队将能够恢复其控制的前线附近地区的后勤保障，而乌克兰今年一直在对这些地区进行中程打击。他补充说，因此，俄罗斯可以重新获得资源，以更快的行动节奏推进，从而增加取得突破的可能性。

paras.en: But at least two of the soldiers interviewed told NBC News that Starlink was not slowed down universally across the front lines.
paras.zh: 但至少两名接受采访的士兵告诉 NBC 新闻，星链并没有在前线普遍放缓。

paras.en: A drone technician serving in Donetsk, who also asked not to be named due to the sensitive nature of his service, said his unit hasn’t seen any major drops in performance. “Given the recent weather, the speed dips and service seemed normal,” the soldier, 31, said, adding that he was aware that other units were experiencing difficulties.
paras.zh: 一名在顿涅茨克服役的无人机技术人员由于其服务的敏感性而要求不透露姓名，他表示，他的部门的性能没有出现任何重大下降。这名 31 岁的士兵说：“考虑到最近的天气，速度下降，服务似乎很正常。”他补充说，他知道其他部队也遇到了困难。

paras.en: The Pentagon responded to NBC News’ request for comment on the soldiers’ criticisms by referring to Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth’s remarks Wednesday in which he reiterated that the U.S. has not changed its posture toward Ukraine in any way, calling its fight against Russia “a heroic effort.”
paras.zh: 五角大楼在回应 NBC 新闻就士兵们的批评发表评论的请求时，提到了国防部长皮特·赫格斯周三的讲话，他在讲话中重申，美国没有以任何方式改变对乌克兰的立场，称其与俄罗斯的斗争是“英勇的努力”。

articles.title: Personalized mRNA vaccine for melanoma cut risk of cancer’s return in late-stage trial
articles.author: David Cox

paras.en: A new personalized mRNA vaccine for melanoma is being hailed by some oncologists as a major breakthrough after it reduced the risk of cancer recurrence and death by 42% compared with standard treatment in a late-stage clinical trial.
paras.zh: 一种针对黑色素瘤的新型个性化 mRNA 疫苗被一些肿瘤学家誉为一项重大突破，因为在一项后期临床试验中，与标准治疗相比，该疫苗将癌症复发和死亡的风险降低了 42%。

paras.en: Dr. Robert Vonderheide, director of Penn Medicine’s Abramson Cancer Center and president-elect of the American Association for Cancer Research, said the results are a “game changer.”
paras.zh: 宾夕法尼亚大学医学院艾布拉姆森癌症中心主任、美国癌症研究协会候任主席罗伯特·冯德海德博士表示，这一结果“改变了游戏规则”。

paras.en: “It will be seen as the first step toward using cancer vaccines to their full potential,” said Vonderheide, who was not involved in the trial.
paras.zh: “这将被视为充分利用癌症疫苗潜力的第一步，”未参与该试验的冯德海德说。

paras.en: The experimental vaccine, called intismeran, was developed by drugmakers Moderna and Merck. Intismeran is personalized to each patient, using genomic data from the patient’s tumor. The new results will be presented Saturday at the annual meeting of the European Society for Medical Oncology in Madrid.
paras.zh: 这种实验性疫苗名为 intismeran，由制药商 Moderna 和默克公司开发。 Intismeran 利用患者肿瘤的基因组数据针对每位患者进行个性化治疗。新结果将于周六在马德里举行的欧洲肿瘤内科学会年会上公布。

paras.en: The trial included 1,137 Stage 3 melanoma patients. All of the participants had undergone surgery to remove their tumors and were being treated with Merck’s immunotherapy drug Keytruda.
paras.zh: 该试验纳入了 1,137 名 3 期黑色素瘤患者。所有参与者都接受了肿瘤切除手术，并接受默克公司的免疫治疗药物 Keytruda 治疗。

paras.en: In addition to Keytruda, 757 of the participants also got the personalized vaccine; the remaining 380 got a placebo. Two years later, 82% of the patients who received both the new vaccine and the immunotherapy hadn’t had a recurrence, compared with 70% in the immunotherapy plus placebo group.
paras.zh: 除了Keytruda之外，757名参与者还接种了个性化疫苗；其余 380 人服用安慰剂。两年后，接受新疫苗和免疫疗法的患者中有 82% 没有复发，而免疫疗法加安慰剂组的这一比例为 70%。

paras.en: In Stage 3 melanoma, the cancer has spread to nearby lymph nodes or other sites on the skin, but it hasn’t spread to distant organs. Cancer recurrence is the “dreaded event” for these patients, Vonderheide said. If it does return, spread to distant organs is more likely.
paras.zh: 在第三阶段黑色素瘤中，癌症已扩散到附近的淋巴结或皮肤上的其他部位，但尚未扩散到远处的器官。冯德海德说，癌症复发对这些患者来说是“可怕的事件”。如果它确实复发，则更有可能扩散到远处的器官。

paras.en: Dr. Georgina Long, co-medical director of the Melanoma Institute Australia who led the clinical trial, said that while scans might suggest that melanoma has been completely removed by surgery, invisible cancer cells may still be lurking.
paras.zh: 领导这项临床试验的澳大利亚黑色素瘤研究所联合医学主任乔治娜·朗博士表示，虽然扫描可能表明黑色素瘤已通过手术完全切除，但看不见的癌细胞可能仍然潜伏着。

paras.en: “This treatment is about mopping up the cancer cells we can’t see,” Long said. “We know with [Keytruda] alone, that works really well, but not in everyone.”
paras.zh: “这种治疗是为了清除我们看不到的癌细胞，”朗说。 “我们知道单独使用 [Keytruda] 效果非常好，但并不是对所有人都有效。”

paras.en: Keytruda works by mobilizing immune cells called T cells to spot and destroy cancer. The vaccine also helps the immune system fight cancer. Each vaccine is created by taking the excised tumor, sequencing its genome and identifying a tell-tale fingerprint of abnormal proteins known as neoantigens, Long said. The vaccine trains the immune system to recognize and target these neoantigens, similar to how a standard vaccine is trained to recognize and target a virus or bacteria.
paras.zh: Keytruda 的工作原理是动员称为 T 细胞的免疫细胞来发现和消灭癌症。该疫苗还可以帮助免疫系统对抗癌症。朗说，每种疫苗都是通过切除肿瘤、对其基因组进行测序并识别被称为新抗原的异常蛋白质的指纹来制造的。该疫苗训练免疫系统识别和瞄准这些新抗原，类似于训练标准疫苗识别和瞄准病毒或细菌的方式。

paras.en: Intismeran uses messenger RNA technology, the same platform pioneered in the development of Covid vaccines that’s hailed for how quickly it can be rolled out. Each patient received their personalized vaccine in a little over nine weeks on average.
paras.zh: Intismeran 使用信使 RNA 技术，该技术是新冠疫苗开发中首创的平台，因其推出速度快而备受赞誉。每个患者平均在九周多一点的时间内接种了个性化疫苗。

paras.en: “They’re not on the shelf,” Vonderheide said. “They have to be made for that patient. Can that be done in a few weeks in order to have a timely treatment? Turns out, the answer to that is yes.”
paras.zh: “它们不在架子上，”冯德海德说。 “必须为那个病人制作它们。可以在几周内完成以便得到及时治疗吗？事实证明，答案是肯定的。”

paras.en: Dr. Shirin Bajaj, incoming director of hHead and nNeck mMelanoma at Mount Sinai in New York, said that while Keytruda works by taking the brakes off the immune system and enabling it to recognize cancer cells, the new vaccine is likely enhancing its abilities by mobilizing additional immune cells called killer T cells.
paras.zh: 纽约西奈山 hHead 和 nNeck mMelanoma 即将上任的主任 Shirin Bajaj 博士表示，虽然 Keytruda 的作用是解除免疫系统的制动并使其识别癌细胞，但新疫苗可能通过动员额外的免疫细胞（称为杀伤性 T 细胞）来增强其能力。

paras.en: “It essentially creates an army of killer T cells that are meant to recognize the tumor,” said Bajaj, who was not involved in the trial.
paras.zh: “它本质上是创建了一支杀伤性 T 细胞大军，旨在识别肿瘤，”未参与该试验的 Bajaj 说。

paras.en: Side effects of the vaccine included pain around the injection site and a mild fever — similar to those seen with Covid vaccines.
paras.zh: 疫苗的副作用包括注射部位周围疼痛和轻微发烧——与新冠疫苗的副作用类似。

paras.en: For Dr. Gino In, an associate professor at the USC Keck School of Medicine Norris Comprehensive Cancer Center in Los Angeles, that is a major selling point. In some cases, Keytruda can result in serious organ inflammation, and previous attempts to combine the immunotherapies with other drugs have not only failed to improve cancer recurrence outcomes, but resulted in worse side effects.
paras.zh: 对于洛杉矶南加州大学凯克医学院诺里斯综合癌症中心的副教授 Gino In 博士来说，这是一个主要卖点。在某些情况下，Keytruda 可能会导致严重的器官炎症，而之前将免疫疗法与其他药物相结合的尝试不仅未能改善癌症复发结果，反而导致了更严重的副作用。

paras.en: “In prior trials, other drugs that were studied in combination with [this class of immunotherapies] led to significant, and eventually potentially permanent side effects, particularly side effects that triggered the immune system to attack our own body,” In, who wasn’t involved with the trial, wrote in an email.
paras.zh: “在之前的试验中，与[此类免疫疗法]联合研究的其他药物导致了显着的、最终可能是永久性的副作用，特别是触发免疫系统攻击我们自己身体的副作用，”未参与该试验的 In 在一封电子邮件中写道。

paras.en: Despite the positive results, investors reacted poorly when the findings were leaked on Thursday, causing Moderna’s stock price to fall. Bajaj said that this may be because while the trial’s results are a significant breakthrough for the field of cancer vaccines, the difference between taking Keytruda and the vaccine compared with Keytruda alone is still relatively modest.
paras.zh: 尽管取得了积极的结果，但周四调查结果泄露后，投资者反应不佳，导致 Moderna 股价下跌。 Bajaj 表示，这可能是因为虽然试验结果是癌症疫苗领域的重大突破，但服用 Keytruda 和疫苗与单独使用 Keytruda 相比，差异仍然相对较小。

paras.en: “The reality is that on one hand, any difference you see is amazing because it’s one more option for a patient,” she said. “Is this likely helpful for a handful of patients? I would say yes, but it’s hard to say whether at this point we have data to suggest that this is actually the next blockbuster.”
paras.zh: “现实是，一方面，你看到的任何差异都是惊人的，因为这对患者来说是多一种选择，”她说。 “这可能对少数患者有帮助吗？我会说是的，但很难说目前我们是否有数据表明这实际上是下一个重磅炸弹。”

paras.en: The full data is yet to be published in a peer-reviewed journal, and Bajaj said that the patients in the trial still need to be followed for several more years to see whether the vaccine continues to offer additional benefits in terms of preventing the return and spread of melanoma as well as its effects on survival.
paras.zh: 完整的数据尚未在同行评审的期刊上发表，巴贾吉表示，仍需要对试验中的患者进行几年的跟踪，以了解该疫苗是否继续在预防黑色素瘤的复发和扩散及其对生存的影响方面提供额外的益处。

paras.en: In addition, Bajaj said she had questions over the scalability of the treatment. She noted that of the 1,749 melanoma patients who were initially screened for participation in the trial, 17% did not have tumor samples that were big enough for a vaccine to be created.
paras.zh: 此外，巴贾吉表示她对治疗的可扩展性存有疑问。她指出，在最初筛选参与试验的 1,749 名黑色素瘤患者中，17% 的肿瘤样本不足以制造疫苗。

paras.en: “It’s amazing, but I think some of the logistics are going to need to be worked out,” she said. “But nothing that I saw from this study made me think that the logistics are infeasible. It’s just that it will be a hurdle to actually do this at a wide scale.”
paras.zh: “这太棒了，但我认为一些后勤工作需要解决，”她说。 “但我从这项研究中看到的一切并没有让我认为物流是不可行的。只是这将成为实际大规模实施的障碍。”

paras.en: However, Vonderheide described the results as a very welcome boost for the field of cancer vaccines. In recent months, the German company BioNTech announced clinical trial failures for experimental vaccines for colorectal and head and neck cancers.
paras.zh: 然而，冯德海德将这一结果描述为对癌症疫苗领域的一个非常受欢迎的推动。近几个月来，德国公司 BioNTech 宣布结直肠癌和头颈癌实验疫苗的临床试验失败。

paras.en: He suggested that intismeran’s success may be because the Merck and Moderna trial focused on preventing melanoma recurrence rather than prolonging survival in later stage patients.
paras.zh: 他认为 intismeran 的成功可能是因为默克和 Moderna 的试验重点是预防黑色素瘤复发，而不是延长晚期患者的生存期。

paras.en: “The field of cancer vaccines has been filled with disappointments in treating patients with advanced disease,” Vonderheide said. “Some people look at those results and say, ‘cancer vaccines will never work.’ These results show that cancer vaccines are incredibly powerful when deployed in the right clinical setting. Vaccines work to prevent.”
paras.zh: 冯德海德说：“癌症疫苗领域在治疗晚期疾病患者方面充满了失望。” “有些人看到这些结果后会说，‘癌症疫苗永远不会起作用。’这些结果表明，在正确的临床环境中部署癌症疫苗会非常强大。疫苗可以起到预防作用。”

paras.en: Still, intismeran is being studied in a separate clinical trial in patients with advanced melanoma that has already spread to distant organs.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，一项单独的临床试验仍在对已经扩散到远处器官的晚期黑色素瘤患者进行 Intismeran 的研究。

paras.en: “This is just the proof of concept,” Long said. “We’re going into advanced melanoma, but we’re also doing work in many other cancers — bladder cancer, kidney cancer, lung cancer, using this concept.”
paras.zh: “这只是概念验证，”朗说。 “我们正在研究晚期黑色素瘤，但我们也在利用这个概念对许多其他癌症进行研究——膀胱癌、肾癌、肺癌。”

paras.en: She said that researchers will also be actively working to understand more about why the vaccine worked to see if that can lead to further clues.
paras.zh: 她说，研究人员还将积极努力更多地了解疫苗为何有效，看看是否能找到更多线索。

paras.en: Vonderheide described the future possibilities for preventing cancer recurrence as being myriad. “One day, we might be able to think of how to use a cancer vaccine to prevent cancer in the first place,” he said. “That’s a very ambitious, far-off goal. But these results bring that goal even closer to reality than we might think.”
paras.zh: 冯德海德描述了未来预防癌症复发的可能性是无数的。 “有一天，我们也许能够首先考虑如何使用癌症疫苗来预防癌症，”他说。 “这是一个非常雄心勃勃、遥远的目标。但这些结果使这个目标比我们想象的更接近现实。”

articles.title: Bulldozers tear down home as Israel cracks down in the West Bank
articles.author: Freddie Clayton

paras.en: Bulldozers tore down Palestinian businessman Riyad Mureish’s home in Hebron in the occupied West Bank on Friday, as Israeli officials launched a fresh crackdown on residents there.
paras.zh: 周五，推土机推倒了巴勒斯坦商人里亚德·穆雷什 (Riyad Mureish) 在被占领的约旦河西岸希伯伦的家，以色列官员对那里的居民发起了新的镇压。

paras.en: Mureish, 49, who put his life savings into the house, told NBC News that Israeli soldiers gave his family just minutes to collect their valuables and identity documents before ordering them out.
paras.zh: 49 岁的穆雷什 (Mureish) 将毕生积蓄都投入了这座房子，他告诉 NBC 新闻，以色列士兵只给了他家人几分钟的时间来收集他们的贵重物品和身份证件，然后就命令他们离开。

paras.en: He said the house had been subject to a long-running dispute with Israeli authorities, who retain significant power over construction permits in the area. A court decree was in place that should have prevented any demolition, Mureish added, but the soldiers were unswayed by his pleas.
paras.zh: 他说，这所房子与以色列当局存在长期争议，以色列当局对该地区的建筑许可拥有重大权力。穆雷什补充说，法院已经颁布了一项法令，本应阻止任何拆除活动，但士兵们并没有被他的请求所动摇。

paras.en: “They demolished and took me out by force,” he said.
paras.zh: “他们强行拆毁并把我带走，”他说。

paras.en: Now sheltering in a small room at a neighbor’s house with his wife and children, Mureish says he is still struggling to comprehend what has happened. He said: “No house, no land, no money, what can I do?”
paras.zh: 穆雷什现在与妻子和孩子一起躲在邻居家的一个小房间里，他说他仍然很难理解发生了什么。他说：“没有房子，没有土地，没有钱，我能做什么？”

paras.en: Videos captured the moment that bulldozers began to rip through the property. The scenes unfolded the same day that Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu stood in another part of Hebron, wearing a military-style vest, and vowed to intensify operations across the occupied West Bank.
paras.zh: 视频捕捉到了推土机开始推土机的那一刻。这一幕发生的同一天，以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡穿着军装背心站在希伯伦的另一个地方，并发誓要在被占领的约旦河西岸加强行动。

paras.en: After a shooting attack that left two Israeli soldiers and two gunmen dead, Netanyahu said the military would enter neighborhoods from which attackers had emerged, evacuate residents and go “house to house” to tackle any threat.
paras.zh: 枪击事件造成两名以色列士兵和两名枪手死亡后，内塔尼亚胡表示，军队将进入袭击者出现的社区，疏散居民，并“挨家挨户”应对任何威胁。

paras.en: IDF helmet cam shows gunfight with Palestinian gunmen
paras.zh: 以色列国防军头盔摄像头显示与巴勒斯坦枪手的枪战

paras.en: “We are going to destroy terrorist infrastructure, and we are going to build the infrastructure for settlement,” he told cameras, speaking days before Israel’s pivotal Oct. 27 election that will decide whether he stays in power.
paras.zh: “我们将摧毁恐怖分子的基础设施，我们将建造定居点的基础设施，”他在以色列 10 月 27 日关键选举的几天前对摄像机说，这次选举将决定他是否继续掌权。

paras.en: Israeli forces have since “sealed off all the entrances” to the city, “making it impossible for anyone to enter or leave,” according to Yousef al-Jabari, the Palestinian mayor of Hebron.
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦希伯伦市市长优素福·贾巴里表示，以色列军队此后“封锁了该市的所有入口”，“使任何人都无法进出”。

paras.en: He told NBC News a key mosque had been forced to close and residents in some areas were being removed from their homes, adding that soldiers have “effectively besieged an entire densely populated area and are demanding that its residents leave.”
paras.zh: 他告诉 NBC 新闻，一座重要的清真寺被迫关闭，一些地区的居民被赶出家园，并补充说，士兵“有效地包围了整个人口稠密的地区，并要求居民离开。”

paras.en: Hebron is the largest city in the West Bank, home to approximately 320,000 people.
paras.zh: 希伯伦是西岸最大的城市，拥有约 32 万人口。

paras.en: Israeli human rights organization B’Tselem said approximately 240 Palestinian families were forced from their homes in the Jildah and ‘Ein Deir Bahah neighborhoods of Hebron on Friday and Saturday.
paras.zh: 以色列人权组织 B’Tselem 表示，周五和周六，大约 240 个巴勒斯坦家庭被迫离开希伯伦 Jildah 和“Ein Deir Bahah”社区的家园。

paras.en: “Soldiers have taken over numerous homes and remain inside them, raising Israeli flags over several buildings. Arrests and interrogations are also continuing,” the group said in a statement.
paras.zh: 该组织在一份声明中表示，“士兵们占领了许多房屋并留在里面，在几栋建筑物上升起了以色列国旗。逮捕和审讯也在继续。”

paras.en: Tensions have soared in the West Bank in the weeks before the Israeli election, with a spate of settler violence and military activity centered on the start of the olive harvesting season. Palestinians, activists and American journalists have been among those attacked and detained.
paras.zh: 在以色列大选前几周，约旦河西岸的紧张局势急剧加剧，在橄榄收获季节开始时发生了一系列定居者暴力和军事活动。巴勒斯坦人、活动人士和美国记者都受到袭击和拘留。

paras.en: Al-Jabari called the latest lockdown a “form of collective punishment” and suggested Netanyahu’s intervention was motivated by politics.
paras.zh: 贾巴里称最新的封锁是“集体惩罚的形式”，并暗示内塔尼亚胡的干预是出于政治动机。

paras.en: “With the Israeli elections only days away, Netanyahu is seeking to secure as many votes as possible by appeasing the settlers,” he said.
paras.zh: “距离以色列选举只有几天了，内塔尼亚胡正在寻求通过安抚定居者来获得尽可能多的选票，”他说。

paras.en: Netanyahu has long faced pressure from his far-right allies to embrace harder stances in the West Bank. In his comments Friday, he praised settlers as “heroic,” saying they were “an example to the people of Israel and to the state of Israel.”
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡长期以来一直面临来自极右翼盟友的压力，要求其在约旦河西岸采取更强硬的立场。他在周五的评论中称赞定居者是“英雄”，称他们是“以色列人民和以色列国的榜样”。

paras.en: The leader, facing a tough re-election battle, has focused much of his campaign ahead of Tuesday’s vote on security. His government has repeatedly warned of potential attacks by the country’s “enemies” in the lead-up to the election, without providing evidence.
paras.zh: 这位领导人面临着一场艰难的连任之战，在周二的安全投票之前，他的大部分竞选活动都集中在安全问题上。他的政府在选举前多次警告该国“敌人”可能发动袭击，但没有提供证据。

paras.en: In the wake of Friday’s attack, he said that he had “warned several weeks ago about our enemies’ attempts to harm us, our civilians and our soldiers ahead of the elections. That is what they tried to here.”
paras.zh: 周五袭击事件发生后，他表示，他“几周前就曾警告我们的敌人试图在选举前伤害我们、我们的平民和士兵。这就是他们在这里试图做的事。”

paras.en: U.N. spokesperson Stéphane Dujarric said at a press briefing Friday that “closures severely restrict Palestinians’ freedom of movement, access to basic services and livelihoods.”
paras.zh: 联合国发言人斯特凡·杜雅里克在周五的新闻发布会上表示，“封锁严重限制了巴勒斯坦人的行动自由、获得基本服务和生计的机会。”

paras.en: Mayy El Sheikh, a spokesperson for the Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights in the Occupied Palestinian Territory, said in a statement Friday that the lockdown was “yet another episode in a never-ending stream of suffocating measures making life more and more unbearable for Palestinians.”
paras.zh: 联合国驻巴勒斯坦被占领土人权事务高级专员办事处发言人梅伊·谢赫周五在一份声明中表示，封锁是“一系列永无休止的令人窒息的措施中的又一插曲，使巴勒斯坦人的生活变得越来越难以忍受。”

paras.en: “It follows a pattern of collective punishment whenever Palestinians commit acts of violence against Israeli settlers or soldiers,” she said.
paras.zh: “每当巴勒斯坦人对以色列定居者或士兵实施暴力行为时，都会遵循集体惩罚的模式，”她说。

paras.en: H.A. Hellyer, a senior associate fellow at the Royal United Services Institute in London, told NBC News that Netanyahu could be showing a “strong arm” ahead of the elections by locking down the West Bank, but he said the link was not clear, noting that the main candidates in the election were broadly aligned.
paras.zh: 哈。伦敦皇家联合三军研究所高级副研究员赫勒告诉美国全国广播公司新闻，内塔尼亚胡可能会通过封锁约旦河西岸来在选举前展示出“强有力的手段”，但他表示这种联系尚不清楚，并指出选举中的主要候选人大致上是一致的。

paras.en: Even if Netanyahu loses, he said, “I don’t expect there to be change on the West Bank.”
paras.zh: 他说，即使内塔尼亚胡失败，“我也不认为约旦河西岸会发生变化。”

paras.en: Israeli officials did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
paras.zh: 以色列官员没有立即回应置评请求。

articles.title: Man dies after being crushed by ramp in northern Victoria
articles.author: Andrew Mangelsdorf

paras.en: A man has died in a workplace incident on a rural property near Shepparton in Victoria's north-east.
paras.zh: 一名男子在维多利亚州东北部谢珀顿附近一处农村地产的工作场所事故中死亡。

paras.en: Emergency services were called to Evans Road, Waggarandall, about 40 kilometres north-east of Shepparton, to reports a man was trapped under a loading ramp about 10:20am on Sunday.
paras.zh: 周日上午 10 点 20 分左右，紧急服务人员接到电话称，谢珀顿东北约 40 公里处的瓦加兰德尔 (Waggarandall) 埃文斯路 (Evans Road) 发现一名男子被困在装货坡道下。

paras.en: Advanced life support paramedics attended the property, but the man died at the scene.
paras.zh: 先进的生命支持护理人员赶到了现场，但该男子当场死亡。

paras.en: The death is not being treat as suspicious and WorkSafe has been notified.
paras.zh: 死亡事件并未被视为可疑，工作安全局已收到通知。

paras.en: Police will prepare a report for the coroner.
paras.zh: 警方将为验尸官准备一份报告。

articles.title: Live: Diamonds play Constellation Cup on home soil
articles.author: Brittany Carter

paras.en: Constellation Cup live: Australia vs New Zealand game three
paras.zh: 星座杯直播：澳大利亚对阵新西兰第三场比赛

paras.en: Australia is trailing New Zealand in the Constellation Cup 2-0 and fighting to keep hold of the coveted trophy in game three in Sydney.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚队在星座杯中以 2-0 落后新西兰队，并在悉尼举行的第三场比赛中为保住梦寐以求的奖杯而奋斗。

paras.en: Choose what information you see below by using filters
paras.zh: 使用过滤器选择您在下面看到的信息

paras.en: Oh no. You know those wonderful changes to the line-up we spoke about? With players returning to their favoured positions? That's been thrown out with the first centre pass. Moloney came off the court with a busted hand. It appears her stitches may have re-opened.
paras.zh: 哦不。你知道我们谈到的阵容的那些奇妙变化吗？球员们回到了他们喜欢的位置？第一个中路传球就被淘汰了。莫洛尼下场时手受伤了。看来她的缝线可能又重新裂开了。

paras.en: As a result, Watson shifts to centre, Horjus to wing attack and Sophie Dwyer comes off the bench to grabs the goal attack bib.
paras.zh: 结果，沃森转移到中锋，霍尔尤斯转移到边路进攻，索菲·德怀尔替补上场抢夺球门进攻号码布。

paras.en: New Zealand have the first centre pass. Although Australia got a couple of tips on the ball but it doesn't stop them converting.
paras.zh: 新西兰拥有第一张中线通行证。尽管澳大利亚得到了一些建议，但这并不能阻止他们转变。

paras.en: In my coaching experience , lopsided penalty counts can often come when a team under pressure ‘tries that bit harder’. Players lose track of the ball play because they are determined to ‘get there first’ resulting in early or late interventions meaning increased penalties. Coach’s job to keep player mindset correct.
paras.zh: 根据我的执教经验，当一支球队在压力下“更加努力”时，往往会出现不平衡的点球计数。球员会失去对球的跟踪，因为他们决心“首先到达那里”，从而导致过早或过晚的干预，这意味着增加处罚。教练的工作就是保持球员心态正确。

paras.en: This can be true Phil! But the biggest issue for the Diamonds were the offensive penalties called against their goal shooters in the final quarter. There was at least five called against Donnell Wallam, Kiera Austin and Sophie Garbin as they tried to push off the body of Kelly Jackson and get free. It lead to a lot of turnover.
paras.zh: 这可能是真的菲尔！但钻石队面临的最大问题是最后一节对射手的进攻处罚。至少有五个人对唐纳·沃勒姆、基拉·奥斯汀和索菲·加尔宾进行了处罚，因为他们试图推开凯利·杰克逊的尸体并获得自由。这导致了大量的营业额。

paras.en: With the series on the line, the Diamonds have made five changes to their starting line-up.
paras.zh: 随着系列赛的临近，钻石队对首发阵容进行了五次调整。

paras.en: SUBS: Kiera Austin, Sophie Dwyer, Sarah Klau, Cara Koenen, Donnell Wallam
paras.zh: 替补：基拉·奥斯汀、索菲·德怀尔、莎拉·克劳、卡拉·科南、唐纳尔·沃勒姆

paras.en: Captain Liz Watson has been under some pressure for her performances but she has been playing at centre to cover injuries. Today she takes back hold of the wing attack bib and her apprentice Georgie Horjus gets a start IN THE CIRCLE!
paras.zh: 队长莉兹·沃森（Liz Watson）的表现承受着一些压力，但她一直在中锋位置上以弥补伤病。今天，她夺回了侧翼攻击号码布，她的学徒乔治·霍尤斯 (Georgie Horjus) 在圈子里开始了！

paras.en: Horjus is an excellent WA / GA swing and yet she is the only shooting option the Diamonds haven't tried this series. Horjus is the smallest player in the team at 172cm. She is 20cm shorter than Silver Ferns goal keeper Kelly Jackson and 12cm shorter than goal defence Karin Burger — but it doesn't seem to trouble her in Super Netball, where she's won three titles with the Adelaide Thunderbirds. That means Kiera Austin heads to the bench.
paras.zh: 霍尤斯是一名出色的西澳/乔治亚挥杆球员，但她是钻石队在本系列赛中唯一没有尝试过的投篮选择。霍尔尤斯是队中个子最小的球员，身高172厘米。她比银蕨队守门员凯利·杰克逊 (Kelly Jackson) 矮 20 厘米，比守门员卡琳·伯格 (Karin Burger) 矮 12 厘米，但这似乎并没有对她在超级无板篮球比赛中造成困扰，她在阿德莱德雷鸟队 (Adelaide Thunderbirds) 中赢得了三个冠军。这意味着基拉·奥斯汀将坐在替补席上。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Kate Moloney returns to her best position at centre, making room for Amy Parmenter to get her first start of the series at wing defence. And lastly, new centurion Courtney Bruce — who has typically started in goal keeper for most of her prior 101 caps —starts in goal defence.
paras.zh: 与此同时，凯特·莫洛尼回到了她在中锋的最佳位置，为艾米·帕门特腾出空间，让她在边路防守中首次首发。最后，新百夫长考特尼·布鲁斯（Courtney Bruce）在之前 101 场国家队比赛中大部分时间都是作为守门员首发，而他则在守门员位置上首发。

paras.en: SUBS: Parris Mason, Kimiora Poi, Ta Paea Selby-Rickit, Carys Stythe, Amelia Walmsley
paras.zh: 替补：帕里斯·梅森、基米奥拉·波伊、塔·佩亚·塞尔比-里基特、卡里斯·斯蒂斯、阿米莉亚·沃尔姆斯利

paras.en: Maddy Gordon is into wing attack, Kate Heffernan is into centre and Mila Reuelu-Buchanan gets her first start of the series at wing defence. She was excellent there throughout the Commonwealth Games.
paras.zh: 麦迪·戈登（Maddy Gordon）负责侧翼进攻，凯特·赫夫南（Kate Heffernan）担任中锋，米拉·鲁埃卢·布坎南（Mila Reuelu-Buchanan）在侧翼防守中首次首发。她在整个英联邦运动会上表现出色。

paras.en: Speaking on Friday in Sydney, Marinkovich told ABC Sport reporter Amanda Shalala that the biggest lesson the team has taken from the opening matches is to get the start of the match right.
paras.zh: 周五在悉尼发表讲话时，马林科维奇告诉美国广播公司体育记者阿曼达·沙拉拉，球队从揭幕战中得到的最大教训就是要正确开局。

paras.en: "For us, we've really got to be able to take the first five minutes of the quarters," she said.
paras.zh: “对我们来说，我们真的必须能够拿下本节的前五分钟，”她说。

paras.en: "I think they've got little jumps on us in those moments. We've got to really solidify ball that we do get and make sure that we do put it on the scoreboard to pass some of that pressure back to New Zealand."
paras.zh: “我认为他们在那些时刻对我们的影响很小。我们必须真正巩固我们确实得到的球，并确保我们确实将其放在记分牌上，以将一些压力传递回新西兰。”

paras.en: Australia has been heavily penalised throughout the series and Stacey Marinkovich said her team would be looking for clarification from the umpires as to why that is.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚队在整个系列赛中受到了严重处罚，史黛西·马林科维奇表示，她的球队将寻求裁判的澄清，以解释原因。

paras.en: New Zealand has conceded 100 penalties so far, while the Diamonds have conceded 145. That's a lot of time standing beside your player, unable to contribute to play.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，新西兰队已经丢了 100 个点球，而钻石队则丢了 145 个点球。你需要花很多时间站在球员身边，无法为比赛做出贡献。

paras.en: The same two umpires will officiate all four games of the series: Gary Burgess (English) and Alison Harrison (Welsh).
paras.zh: 同样的两名裁判将执法该系列赛的所有四场比赛：加里·伯吉斯（英格兰）和艾莉森·哈里森（威尔士）。

paras.en: But Marinkovich told the media that she felt the Diamonds were umpired differently on home soil. Whether the coach agrees or not, they definitely need to be more disciplined today.
paras.zh: 但马林科维奇告诉媒体，她觉得钻石队在本土受到的裁判有所不同。不管教练同意与否，他们今天肯定需要更加遵守纪律。

paras.en: "In history, for the last four years, we've been penalised in New Zealand and it kind of shifts when we're in Australia … But I don't think our game plan changes too differently."
paras.zh: “历史上，过去四年，我们在新西兰受到了惩罚，而当我们在澳大利亚时，情况就会发生变化……但我认为我们的比赛计划不会有太大不同。”

paras.en: Australia has two players out with Jamie-Lee Price nursing a calf injury and Matilda Garrett scratched from the game with concussion so this 12 is literally the only 12 players left in their Constellation Cup squad.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚有两名球员缺席，杰米-李·普莱斯 (Jamie-Lee Price) 小腿受伤，玛蒂尔达·加勒特 (Matilda Garrett) 因脑震荡缺席比赛，因此这 12 名球员实际上是星座杯阵容中仅剩的 12 名球员。

paras.en: One of the Diamonds' strengths is the squad's depth, so that's taken a hit. As has its confidence. It'll be interesting to see how they fare without this pair.
paras.zh: 钻石队的优势之一是球队的深度，所以这受到了打击。正如它的信心一样。如果没有这对，看看他们的表现会很有趣。

paras.en: Thankfully there is some good news and that is that Kate Moloney is back fighting fight after suffering a nasty finger laceration at training. She missed the first outing but was stitched up and appeared on Wednesday night.
paras.zh: 值得庆幸的是，有一些好消息，那就是凯特·莫洛尼在训练中手指严重割伤后，已经回归战斗。她错过了第一次外出，但被缝合后于周三晚上出现。

paras.en: "The finger is fine. I had a few more stitches put in after the game, but the finger is good to go," Moloney told the ABC.
paras.zh: “手指没事。赛后我又缝了几针，但手指已经可以走了，”莫洛尼告诉美国广播公司。

paras.en: Head coach Noeline Taurua has made a single change to her team for game three and it's caught us by surprise.
paras.zh: 主教练诺埃琳·陶鲁亚（Noeline Taurua）在第三场比赛中对她的球队做出了一个改变，这让我们感到惊讶。

paras.en: In Auckland, Kimiora Poi started the match in WA and put on a solid performance.
paras.zh: 在奥克兰，Kimiora Poi在西澳首发出场并表现出色。

paras.en: She was replaced in the team by Peta Toeava for the Christchurch game, who went from outside the side into the starting line-up, taking hold of that WA bib.
paras.zh: 在基督城的比赛中，佩塔·托阿瓦 (Peta Toeava) 取代了她的位置，后者从边路进入首发阵容，并拿到了西澳的号码布。

paras.en: She was phenomenal and really hard to shut down. Now there's been a direct swap again. Poi in for Toeava.
paras.zh: 她非常出色，很难让人停下来。现在又出现了直接交换。 Poi 替补 Toeava。

paras.en: Keeping us on our toes! Both offer such different styles of wing attack. Maybe this is their trial for the sport for next year's World Cup?
paras.zh: 让我们保持警惕！两者都提供不同风格的侧翼攻击。也许这是他们为明年世界杯进行的试训？

paras.en: If you missed Wednesday night's game in Christchurch where the Diamonds suffered a heavy defeat to the Silver Ferns 62-50 you can find our blog from game two here.
paras.zh: 如果您错过了周三晚上在基督城举行的比赛，那场钻石队以 62-50 惨败给银蕨队，您可以在这里找到我们第二场比赛的博客。

paras.en: Hello! Thanks for joining our live blog for the Constellation Cup. Brittany Carter at the Sydney SuperDome ready for game three. It's so nice to be in-person for this one. I cannot think of a better way to end the week than some international netball.
paras.zh: 你好！感谢您加入我们的星座杯直播博客。布列塔尼·卡特在悉尼超级圆顶体育场准备第三场比赛。能够亲临现场真是太好了。我想不出比国际无板篮球更好的方式来结束这一周了。

paras.en: A reminder, we've already had two games played in this series for the New Zealand leg, with the Diamonds trailing 2-0 as they try to get back on track on home soil. If the Aussies win today, the series will still be alive ahead of the final match in Melbourne. However, if they lose this match the Constellation Cup will be the Silver Ferns for just the fourth time in history. There is also thought that three games might be enough for New Zealand to dethrone the Aussies from the world number one ranking spot, but the way the rankings are worked out is confusing... We do know for sure that a 4-0 cleansweep would see a change at the top.
paras.zh: 提醒一下，新西兰站系列赛我们已经打了两场比赛，钻石队试图在主场重回正轨，但以 2-0 落后。如果澳大利亚队今天获胜，那么该系列赛在墨尔本的决赛之前仍然存在。然而，如果他们输掉这场比赛，星座杯将在历史上第四次成为银蕨队。还有人认为，三场比赛可能足以让新西兰队将澳大利亚队从世界排名第一的位置上夺走，但排名的计算方式令人困惑……我们确实知道，4-0 横扫将导致排名发生变化。

paras.en: Game 1: Sunday 18 October, 5:40pm AEDT — Auckland
paras.zh: 第 1 场比赛：10 月 18 日星期日下午 5:40（澳大利亚东部时间）——奥克兰

paras.en: Game 2: Wednesday 21 October, 5:40pm AEDT — Christchurch
paras.zh: 第 2 场比赛：10 月 21 日星期三，澳大利亚东部时间下午 5:40 — 基督城

paras.en: Game 3: Sunday 25 October, 4:00pm AEDT — Sydney
paras.zh: 第 3 场比赛：10 月 25 日星期日下午 4:00（澳大利亚东部夏令时间）— 悉尼

paras.en: Game 4: Wednesday 28 October, 7:30pm AEDT — Melbourne
paras.zh: 第 4 场比赛：10 月 28 日星期三，澳大利亚东部时间晚上 7:30 — 墨尔本

articles.title: Measles-stricken Amish hit hard amid US vaccine misinformation fight
articles.author: Luke Cooper

paras.en: The US state of Pennsylvania is grappling with its worst measles outbreak in three decades, with more than 1,300 cases reported since April.
paras.zh: 美国宾夕法尼亚州正在应对三十年来最严重的麻疹疫情，自 4 月份以来已报告了 1,300 多例病例。

paras.en: Amish communities have been directly impacted due to low vaccination rates, leading to the deaths of six people.
paras.zh: 阿米什社区因疫苗接种率低而受到直接影响，导致六人死亡。

paras.en: The outbreak is the largest of multiple outbreaks across the US, happening amid an uproar over Health Secretary Robert F Kennedy Jr's controversial vaccine stance.
paras.zh: 这次疫情是美国多起疫情中规模最大的一次，发生在卫生部长小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪(Robert F Kennedy Jr)颇具争议的疫苗立场引发轩然大波之际。

paras.en: In a rural corner of the US state of Pennsylvania, crop fields, maple trees and colonial-era barn farmhouses dot a patchwork landscape of rolling grassy hills.
paras.zh: 在美国宾夕法尼亚州的一个乡村角落，农田、枫树和殖民时代的谷仓农舍点缀在连绵起伏的青草山丘上。

paras.en: At the foot of the Appalachian Mountains, Lancaster County is less than 300 kilometres from New York City and home to the country's oldest and largest Amish community.
paras.zh: 兰开斯特县位于阿巴拉契亚山脉脚下，距离纽约市不到 300 公里，是美国最古老、最大的阿米什社区的所在地。

paras.en: But it has also become the focus of a heated political row amid a scramble to contain one of the US's worst measles outbreaks in recent history.
paras.zh: 但在遏制美国近代历史上最严重的麻疹疫情之一的斗争中，它也成为激烈政治争论的焦点。

paras.en: Measles is a highly contagious illness that can lead to the hospitalisation or death of a person, with up to nine out of 10 people who are not vaccinated likely to fall sick, the Australian Centre for Disease Control says.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚疾病控制中心表示，麻疹是一种高度传染性的疾病，可能导致一个人住院或死亡，未接种疫苗的人中多达十分之九可能会生病。

paras.en: Authorities in Pennsylvania say the outbreak there began in late April, west of one of the state's largest cities, Philadelphia.
paras.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州当局表示，该州最大城市之一费城以西的疫情于四月下旬开始爆发。

paras.en: Cases have since ballooned above 1,300 in what has become Pennsylvania's largest spread of the disease in more than three decades.
paras.zh: 此后，病例数激增至 1,300 多例，成为宾夕法尼亚州三十多年来最大规模的疾病传播。

paras.en: At least six people have died, including two infants — one of which was a newborn — and a 20-year-old from Lancaster County, an 18-year-old resident of Mifflin County, a 40-year-old woman from Jefferson County and a 39-year-old female from Franklin County.
paras.zh: 至少有六人死亡，其中包括两名婴儿（其中一名是新生儿）、一名来自兰开斯特县的 20 岁男子、一名来自米夫林县的 18 岁居民、一名来自杰斐逊县的 40 岁女性和一名来自富兰克林县的 39 岁女性。

paras.en: The Pennsylvania Health Department said none of the victims was vaccinated, and Franklin County officials reported the 39-year-old had a previous measles diagnosis and "several underlying conditions".
paras.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州卫生部门表示，没有一名受害者接种了疫苗，富兰克林县官员报告称，这名 39 岁的患者之前曾被诊断出患有麻疹，并且患有“几种潜在疾病”。

paras.en: Authorities say the disease has mostly impacted people aged between 18 and 49, who account for about 800 of the state's cases, and at least 251 people — or about one in every five — have been hospitalised.
paras.zh: 当局表示，这种疾病主要影响 18 岁至 49 岁之间的人群，该人群约占该州病例的 800 例，至少有 251 人（约五分之一）住院治疗。

paras.en: Low vaccination rates, mostly in vulnerable Amish communities, remain the biggest challenge according to officials.
paras.zh: 官员们表示，疫苗接种率低（主要是在脆弱的阿米什社区）仍然是最大的挑战。

paras.en: At least five who died were from Amish communities, local media reported.
paras.zh: 据当地媒体报道，至少有五人死亡来自阿米什社区。

paras.en: The Amish are insular, religious people who associate piety with surrendering to strict rules for the greater good of their community, and reject modern-day technologies.
paras.zh: 阿米什人是与世隔绝的宗教民族，他们将虔诚与为了社区的更大利益而服从严格的规则联系在一起，并且拒绝现代技术。

paras.en: They came to the US from Europe in the 1700s, and more than 410,000 still live across the country, including at least 40,000 in Lancaster County.
paras.zh: 他们于 1700 年代从欧洲来到美国，目前仍有超过 410,000 人居住在全国各地，其中至少有 40,000 人居住在兰开斯特县。

paras.en: Braxton Mitchell, co-director of the University of Maryland's Amish research program, says their communal way of life creates a unique risk of rapid virus spread.
paras.zh: 马里兰大学阿米什研究项目联合主任布拉克斯顿·米切尔表示，他们的集体生活方式造成了病毒快速传播的独特风险。

paras.en: "Amish are very social. The Amish families have a lot of kids — the average [has] seven or eight, so a lot of people in the household," he said.
paras.zh: “阿米什人非常善于交际。阿米什人的家庭有很多孩子——平均有七八个，所以家里有很多人，”他说。

paras.en: "The Amish get together with their neighbours, with their relatives; they have church services on Sundays which tend to be at somebody's house and the whole church district shows up."
paras.zh: “阿米什人与他们的邻居和亲戚聚会；他们在周日举行教堂礼拜，通常是在某人的家里，整个教堂区都会出现。”

paras.en: He said they were sceptical of government intervention and do not see the need to engage with modern medicine.
paras.zh: 他说，他们对政府干预持怀疑态度，并且认为没有必要接触现代医学。

paras.en: "With some diseases, the Amish [believe] 'if we get sick, if God's will is that we're meant to survive, we'll survive'."
paras.zh: “对于某些疾病，阿米什人[相信]‘如果我们生病了，如果上帝的旨意是我们要活下去，我们就会活下来’。”

paras.en: Steve Nolt, a professor at Elizabethtown College, has lived in Lancaster County for most of his life and said he loves the area's reputation for diversity, manufacturing, picturesque nature and pleasantness of local life.
paras.zh: 伊丽莎白敦学院 (Elizabethtown College) 教授史蒂夫·诺尔特 (Steve Nolt) 在兰开斯特县生活了大半生，他表示，他喜欢该地区多样性、制造业、风景如画的自然风光和宜人的当地生活的声誉。

paras.en: "There's a strong sense of Lancaster heritage and Lancaster identity … [The county] is special, especially in the minds of people with deep roots here," he said.
paras.zh: “兰卡斯特遗产和兰卡斯特身份有强烈的感觉……[这个县]很特别，尤其是在根深蒂固的人们的心中，”他说。

paras.en: But he said while the majority of the non-Amish population live with them harmoniously, there is still concern about the spread of measles.
paras.zh: 但他表示，虽然大多数非阿米什人与他们和谐相处，但仍然担心麻疹的传播。
