articles.title: Protests roil France once again as police seek to quell violence
articles.author: Eleanor Beardsley

paras.en: Protests roil France once again as police seek to quell violence
paras.zh: 警察试图平息暴力，抗议活动再次席卷法国

paras.en: Hundreds of thousands turned out across France to protest everything from the lack of school funding to economic inequality. Police also were out in force to prevent a repeat of last week's violence.
paras.zh: 法国各地数十万人走上街头，抗议从学校经费缺乏到经济不平等等各种问题。警方也出动了力量，防止上周的暴力事件重演。

paras.en: In France today, about 400,000 people came out in cities across the country to demonstrate. The movement began last month with students demanding better facilities. It's now morphed into a broader protest over the high cost of living and social inequality. In response, the French government put in place a massive security operation with more than 70,000 police. NPR's Eleanor Beardsley reports.
paras.zh: 今天在法国，全国各地城市约有40万人上街示威。该运动于上个月开始，学生要求更好的设施。现在它演变成一场针对高生活成本和社会不平等的更广泛的抗议。作为回应，法国政府采取了大规模的安全行动，出动了 7 万多名警察。 NPR 的埃莉诺·比尔兹利报道。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED PROTESTERS: (Chanting in non-English language).
paras.zh: 身份不明的抗议者：（用非英语口号）。

paras.en: ELEANOR BEARDSLEY, BYLINE: Protesters of all ages and backgrounds coursed down a Paris boulevard - students, workers, parents, retirees, and yellow vests, the largely white working-class movement that bedeviled French president Emmanuel Macron in his first term. These left-wing demonstrators held placards calling to tax the rich and for Macron to resign. Dimitry Knoll explains why there is such anger.
paras.zh: 埃莉诺·比尔兹利连线：各个年龄段和背景的抗议者沿着巴黎大道走上——学生、工人、家长、退休人员和黄背心，黄背心运动主要是白人工人阶级运动，在法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙的第一个任期内困扰了他。这些左翼示威者举着标语牌，呼吁对富人征税并要求马克龙辞职。迪米特里·诺尔解释了为什么会有如此愤怒。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: "We hate Macron," he says, "because he's been leading these ultra-capitalist policies for 10 years that are just widening inequalities, and young people have less hope for the future." Knoll doesn't buy the government's line that France's public debt prevents it from doing more for its people. There's money, he says. It's just in the hands of the rich.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：“我们讨厌马克龙，”他说，“因为他十年来一直在领导这些极端资本主义政策，这些政策只会扩大不平等，而年轻人对未来的希望更小。”诺尔并不相信政府的说法，即法国的公共债务阻碍了法国为人民做更多的事情。有钱，他说。只在有钱人手里。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: "We pay our taxes, yet everything is declining, and we're giving massive payouts to multinational companies," says Sandrine Delorie. Fellow protester Sarah Meloul says they all deplore the violence, but police aggression fueled it. And sometimes violence is necessary.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：“我们缴纳了税款，但一切都在下降，我们正在向跨国公司提供大量支出，”桑德琳·德洛里说。抗议者萨拉·梅卢尔 (Sarah Meloul) 表示，他们都对暴力行为表示谴责，但警察的侵略行为助长了暴力行为。有时暴力是必要的。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: "How did they take the bastille? With violence," she says. The student protests of May '68 succeeded because of violence. Meloul says, the government is finally listening.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：“他们是如何占领巴士底狱的？用暴力，”她说。 68年5月的学生抗议活动因暴力而成功。梅卢尔说，政府终于开始倾听了。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: A different France gathered today 100 miles south of Paris in the town of Orleans, where the far right was holding its annual party Congress.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：今天，一个不同的法国聚集在巴黎以南 100 英里的奥尔良镇，极右翼正在那里举行年度党代表大会。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: Polls show far-right leader Marine Le Pen in the lead in next spring's presidential election. That's another reason it's so important to protest, says nurse Jenny Barthelemy.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：民意调查显示极右翼领导人马琳·勒庞在明年春天的总统选举中领先。护士珍妮·巴泰勒米说，这是抗议如此重要的另一个原因。

paras.en: JENNY BARTHELEMY: Well, now it's more dangerous because we've got the national front coming. There's two different Frances. I don't know. I don't know how to explain it. But we're so divided now. I don't know if there's anything to do anymore.
paras.zh: 珍妮·巴泰勒米：嗯，现在更危险了，因为我们的国家阵线即将到来。有两个不同的弗朗西斯。我不知道。我不知道该如何解释。但现在我们的分歧如此之大。我不知道还有什么事情可以做吗？

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: There were clashes between small groups of far-left activists and law enforcement in some cities, like Marseilles and Lyon. But with 70,000 police on the streets of France, the government largely avoided a repeat of last week's violence. But tensions are high across the country, and curfews for minors remain in place in many cities. Eleanor Beardsley, NPR News, Paris.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：在马赛和里昂等一些城市，极左活动人士小团体与执法部门之间发生了冲突。但由于法国街头部署了 7 万名警察，政府基本上避免了上周暴力事件的重演。但全国各地局势高度紧张，许多城市仍对未成年人实行宵禁。埃莉诺·比尔兹利 (Eleanor Beardsley)，NPR 新闻，巴黎。

articles.title: 49ers may have fewer than 48 players available against Falcons amid injury wave, coach Kyle Shanahan says

paras.en: Every NFL team deals with injuries. It's an unfortunate part of the game. But few have been more defined by them in recent seasons than the San Francisco 49ers, whose injury report has seemed to become a weekly storyline.
paras.zh: 每支 NFL 球队都会遇到伤病问题。这是游戏中不幸的部分。但最近几个赛季，很少有球队比旧金山 49 人队更受他们的定义，他们的伤病报告似乎已成为每周的故事情节。

paras.en: The undefeated 49ers made a cross-country trip this week for a matchup with the Atlanta Falcons. San Francisco will again be without several key players Sunday, including receiver Mike Evans, who is dealing with a sore Achilles, and defensive end Nick Bosa, who has a calf injury. The team’s receiver corps was already thin, with Ricky Pearsall, Deebo Samuel Sr., De’Zhaun Stribling and Demarcus Robinson unable to go Sunday.
paras.zh: 不败的 49 人队本周进行了一次越野旅行，与亚特兰大猎鹰队对决。周日，旧金山队将再次缺席几名关键球员，其中包括正在处理跟腱酸痛的接球手迈克·埃文斯(Mike Evans)，以及小腿受伤的防守端锋尼克·博萨(Nick Bosa)。球队的接球手队伍已经很薄弱，瑞奇·皮尔索尔（Ricky Pearsall）、老迪博·塞缪尔（Deebo Samuel Sr.）、德扎恩·斯特里布林（De'Zhaun Stribling）和德马库斯·罗宾逊（Demarcus Robinson）无法在周日上场。

paras.en: The 49ers also ruled out safety Marques Sigle and linebackers Garret Wallow and Luke Gifford for Week 7. Niners head coach Kyle Shanahan acknowledged the lengthy list of unavailable players and said the 49ers may not be able to reach the maximum 48 players on the game-day roster.
paras.zh: 49人队还排除了安全卫马克斯·西格尔（Marques Sigle）、线卫加勒特·瓦洛（Garret Wallow）和卢克·吉福德（Luke Gifford）参加第7周的比赛。9人队主教练凯尔·沙纳汉（Kyle Shanahan）承认缺席球员名单很长，并表示49人队可能无法达到比赛日名单上最多48名球员。

paras.en: Teams can elevate players from the practice squad when injuries leave them thin at a position, but Shanahan does not expect those moves to get San Francisco to 48 players Sunday.
paras.zh: 当伤病导致某个位置的球员人数减少时，球队可以从训练阵容中提拔球员，但沙纳汉并不认为这些举措会让旧金山周日的球员数量达到 48 人。

paras.en: Instead, the former Falcons offensive coordinator said the 49ers have discussed preparing some players to line up outside their usual positions because of the injuries.
paras.zh: 相反，这位前猎鹰队进攻协调员表示，49人队已经讨论了让一些球员因为伤病而在他们通常的位置之外排队的问题。

paras.en: Shanahan said the situation was a first in his coaching career. "I don't think ever in my career [has that happened]," he said. "It's a unique situation."
paras.zh: 沙纳汉表示，这种情况在他的教练生涯中还是第一次。 “我认为在我的职业生涯中从未发生过这种情况，”他说。 “这是一个独特的情况。”

paras.en: Veteran receiver Christian Kirk is in line to make his season debut Sunday, Shanahan confirmed. His return from injured reserve would provide a welcome boost for the 49ers.
paras.zh: 沙纳汉证实，经验丰富的接球手克里斯蒂安·柯克将于周日首次亮相。他从伤病预备队回归将为49人队带来可喜的推动力。

paras.en: Bosa recently shared an optimistic view about being able to return for Week 5 or 6, but the 49ers kept him out of practice to give him extra recovery time. That optimism seems caught Shanahan off guard, given how carefully Bosa usually assesses his own status.
paras.zh: 博萨最近对第五周或第六周的回归持乐观态度，但 49 人队让他缺席训练，以便给他额外的恢复时间。考虑到博萨通常非常谨慎地评估自己的地位，这种乐观情绪似乎让沙纳汉措手不及。

paras.en: "I just think he was a little too optimistic, especially for Bosa because he's pretty accurate," Shanahan said.
paras.zh: “我只是认为他有点过于乐观，尤其是对博萨来说，因为他相当准确，”沙纳汉说。

paras.en: "He doesn't say stuff like that unless it's accurate. I just think it surprised him. He worked out after he said that to you guys and the next day was just a little sore, which surprised all of us, and that wasn't a great sign, especially going to playing turf and stuff this week."
paras.zh: “除非准确，否则他不会说这样的话。我只是觉得这让他感到惊讶。他对你们说了这句话后就去锻炼了，第二天就有点酸痛，这让我们所有人都感到惊讶，这不是一个好兆头，尤其是这周要去打草皮之类的东西。”

paras.en: San Francisco will enter its bye week after Sunday’s matchup with the Falcons.
paras.zh: 在周日与猎鹰队的比赛后，旧金山队将进入轮空周。

articles.title: Arch Manning, Texas survive Ole Miss after another second-half meltdown creates Austin anxiety

paras.en: There are two faces to Texas, and I still don’t know which one we saw Saturday night against No. 7 Ole Miss as the Longhorns pulled off a thrilling 34-27 upset that came down to the final play.
paras.zh: 德克萨斯州有两张面孔，我仍然不知道周六晚上对阵排名第七的密西西比大学时我们看到的是哪一张，当时长角牛队以 34-27 惊心动魄地爆冷，进入了最后一场比赛。

paras.en: A week of buildup around a different version of Arch Manning and the pressure Steve Sarkisian was facing in regard to this offense showing up for all four quarters was nearing a combustable stage against Pete Golding's Rebels on Saturday night.
paras.zh: 围绕着不同版本的阿奇·曼宁的一周积累以及史蒂夫·萨基西安在所有四个季度的进攻中所面临的压力在周六晚上对阵皮特·戈尔丁的叛军时已接近燃烧阶段。

paras.en: Just when you thought this Texas team had shown us every possible way to blow a lead, it found a new one Saturday night in Austin.
paras.zh: 正当你以为这支德克萨斯队已经向我们展示了一切可能的方法来打破领先优势时，周六晚上他们在奥斯汀找到了新的方法。

paras.en: Racing out to a 24-3 lead, thanks to Arch Manning looking like the quarterback NFL scouts were drooling over in the preseason, this game felt like a blowout waiting to happen.
paras.zh: 比赛以 24-3 领先，得益于阿奇·曼宁（Arch Manning），看起来就像季前赛四分卫 NFL 球探都流口水一样，这场比赛感觉就像是一场即将发生的井喷。

paras.en: For the folks at home, we had seen this movie numerous times over the 2026 season. Texas gets a lead, and then throws it away in the second half. We had seen it against Oklahoma and Florida over the past three weeks.
paras.zh: 对于家里的人来说，我们在 2026 年的季节里已经多次看过这部电影。德克萨斯州取得领先，但在下半场失去了领先优势。在过去的三周里，我们在对阵俄克拉荷马州和佛罗里达州的比赛中看到了这一点。

paras.en: A wild second half leads to thrilling finish in the SEC, with a lot of lingering questions
paras.zh: 疯狂的下半场导致了 SEC 激动人心的结局，但也有很多挥之不去的问题

paras.en: If worried Longhorn fans thought they were going to catch a break in the second half, they were sorely mistaken. Texas managed just 19 yards in the third quarter while Ole Miss scored 14 points.
paras.zh: 如果担心的长角牛队球迷认为他们会在下半场休息一下，那么他们就大错特错了。德克萨斯队第三节仅推进 19 码，而密西西比大学则拿下 14 分。

paras.en: It was the Rebels scoring 21 unanswered points that had Texas fans going through another anxiety-filled evening, waiting for the other shoe to drop that it had seen too many times this season. When Arch Manning went cold, Trinidad Chambliss heated up.
paras.zh: 叛军拿下 21 分，却没有得到回应，这让得克萨斯球迷又经历了一个充满焦虑的夜晚，等待着另一只鞋掉下来，这种情况本赛季已经发生过太多次了。当阿奇·曼宁（Arch Manning）冷淡时，特立尼达·钱布利斯（Trinidad Chambliss）却热了起来。

paras.en: By now, the Longhorns should come with a disclaimer warning that any lead could turn into a tie at any moment. And you can’t blame the Will Muschamp-coached defense, considering how much time it spends on the field every week.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，长角牛应该附带一份免责声明，警告任何线索都可能随时变成平局。考虑到威尔·马斯尚（ Will Muschamp ）每周在场上花费的时间，你不能责怪他执教的防守。

paras.en: A tale of two halves was once again rearing its ugly head when the Ole Miss defense forced a fumble after sacking Arch Manning, returning it for the touchdown that sparked the second half comeback.
paras.zh: 两半场的故事再次浮出水面，密西西比大学的防守队员在解雇了阿奇·曼宁后被迫掉球，达阵得分，引发了下半场的逆转。

paras.en: What we witnessed once again was the Texas offense tightening up like a vice grip, with Manning having thrown his second interception with 13:24 remaining in the fourth quarter. Just as we witnessed against Oklahoma, Arch started throwing ducks, and this time it was Ole Miss ready to pounce on the mistakes.
paras.zh: 我们再次见证了德克萨斯队的进攻像虎钳一样收紧，曼宁在第四节还剩 13 分 24 秒时完成了第二次拦截。正如我们在对阵俄克拉荷马州时所看到的那样，阿奇开始扔鸭子，而这一次是奥莱小姐准备好扑向错误。

paras.en: But then we watched the Longhorns flip a switch in the fourth quarter, as if everything that had taken place before Arch Manning strolled into the end zone for a Texas touchdown had simply been a case of the yips.
paras.zh: 但随后我们看到长角牛队在第四节发生了转变，仿佛在阿奇·曼宁（Arch Manning）走进达阵区达阵之前发生的一切都只是一场大喊大叫。

paras.en: "We say every week, 'whatever it takes,' and I think we did that in the fourth quarter," Manning mentioned after the game.
paras.zh: “我们每周都会说，‘不惜一切代价’，我想我们在第四节就做到了，”曼宁赛后说道。

paras.en: Just when you thought it was over, though, Ole Miss put together a frenzied finish that saw them connect on a field goal, then recover an onside kick that gave the Rebels one last chance to tie this game up.
paras.zh: 然而，就在你以为比赛已经结束的时候，密西西比大学打出了一记疯狂的射门，他们射门得分，然后又踢出一记越位球，为叛军队提供了最后一次扳平比分的机会。

paras.en: A Trinidad Chambliss heave to the end zone wound up in the hands of a Texas defender, and the frenzy came to an end with the Longhorns holding off this fierce Ole Miss team that gave us a thrilling second half.
paras.zh: 特立尼达·钱布利斯 (Trinidad Chamblis) 向达阵区的传球最终落到了一名德克萨斯州后卫手中，随着长角牛队 (Longhorns) 击退了这支凶猛的密西西比大学 (Ole Miss) 队，这场疯狂的比赛结束了，这给我们带来了激动人心的下半场。

paras.en: "I was pacing, saying a few prayers," Arch Manning said about the final Ole Miss drive. "Our defense came up clutch, that's what it's all about."
paras.zh: “我一边踱步，一边祈祷，”阿奇·曼宁谈到最后一场密西西比的比赛时说道。 “我们的防守非常关键，这就是重点。”

paras.en: Where do Ole Miss and Texas go from here? Who knows right now in SEC
paras.zh: 奥莱密西西比和德克萨斯州将何去何从？谁知道现在在 SEC

paras.en: The problem with this game is that we witnessed two SEC perceived heavyweights trading haymakers for two halves.
paras.zh: 这场比赛的问题在于，我们目睹了两位 SEC 认为的重量级人物用干草机交换了两个半场。

paras.en: If you haven’t noticed, we are all struggling to decide on who is good enough to be called "elite" in college football.
paras.zh: 如果你没有注意到，我们都在努力决定谁足够优秀，可以被称为大学橄榄球中的“精英”。

paras.en: Coming out of Saturday's showdown in Austin, those questions are going to linger over the next five to six weeks. In the third quarter, we witnessed the Rebels playing with ferocity on defense while Trinidad Chambliss opened up the offense by throwing multiple touchdowns like we witnessed against Missouri last week.
paras.zh: 周六在奥斯汀的对决结束后，这些问题将在接下来的五到六周内持续存在。在第三节，我们见证了叛军在防守上的凶猛，而特立尼达·钱布利斯通过多次达阵开启进攻，就像我们上周对阵密苏里州的比赛一样。

paras.en: By the time Texas fans were done celebrating the drone show at DKR Stadium to start the fourth quarter, it was if another switch had flipped in the head of this Texas offense. The problem that will continue to fester for Arch Manning and Steve Sarkisian over the rest of this season centers around this offense struggling to play consistent football.
paras.zh: 当德州球迷在 DKR 体育场庆祝第四节开始的无人机表演时，德州进攻的头脑中似乎又发生了转变。在本赛季余下的时间里，阿奇·曼宁和史蒂夫·萨尔基相面临的问题将继续恶化，那就是进攻组难以打出稳定的足球。

paras.en: Now, moving forward, Texas will face Missouri and LSU over the next three weeks, and the challenges will only get tougher.
paras.zh: 现在，展望未来，德克萨斯州将在接下来的三周内面对密苏里州和路易斯安那州立大学，挑战只会变得更加严峻。

paras.en: Which Longhorns football team will show up? I don't think any of us know the answer to that question.
paras.zh: 哪支长角牛足球队会出现？我认为我们中没有人知道这个问题的答案。

articles.title: Brewers complete wild Game 2 comeback after controversial call puts them up 2-0 in World Series vs Rays

paras.en: An old saying goes that a postseason series doesn’t truly start until the road team wins a game, so the Tampa Bay Rays better hope the Fall Classic doesn’t end anytime soon.
paras.zh: 有句老话说，只有客场球队赢得一场比赛，季后赛系列赛才真正开始，因此坦帕湾光芒队最好希望秋季经典赛不要很快结束。

paras.en: That's because the Milwaukee Brewers are two wins away from their first World Series title after a wild comeback in Game 2 in their home stadium.
paras.zh: 这是因为密尔沃基酿酒人队在主场第二场比赛中疯狂逆转后，距离他们的第一个世界大赛冠军还差两场胜利。

paras.en: The Rays got jumping early after their Game 1 loss on Friday, scoring four runs in the first with RBI singles by Chandler Simpson and Junior Caminero and then a two-run jack by Liam Hicks. The Brewers chipped away to cut the deficit in half in the bottom of the first, as William Contreras and Garrett Mitchell each had an RBI single.
paras.zh: 周五第一场比赛失利后，光芒队很快就开始跃跃欲试，在第一场比赛中，钱德勒·辛普森和朱尼尔·卡米内罗的打点单打拿下四分，然后利亚姆·希克斯打出两分。酿酒人队在第一节下半段将比分差距缩小了一半，威廉·孔特雷拉斯和加勒特·米切尔各打一打点。

paras.en: The starting pitchers in Logan Henderson and Drew Rasmussen combined to throw just 6.2 innings — Rasmussen was taken out in the fourth after loading the bases and allowing another run, but Christian Yelich grounded out to end the threat. The Brewers bullpen continued to stand on its head, though, keeping the Rays off the scoreboard.
paras.zh: 先发投手洛根·亨德森 (Logan Henderson) 和德鲁·拉斯穆森 (Drew Rasmussen) 总共只投了 6.2 局——拉斯穆森在第四局上垒并失分后被淘汰，但克里斯蒂安·耶利奇 (Christian Yelich) 滚地球结束了威胁。不过，酿酒人牛棚继续倒立，让光芒队远离记分牌。

paras.en: In the bottom of the sixth, Sal Frelick led off the inning with a lefty-on-lefty solo homer off Ian Seymour in a nine-pitch at-bat, completely erasing the deficit. Cooper Pratt drove in Brice Turang to give Milwaukee a 5-4 lead an inning later.
paras.zh: 在第六局下半，萨尔·弗里利克（Sal Frelick）在伊恩·西摩（Ian Seymour）的九个击球中打出了左撇子独奏本垒打，彻底消除了落后。库珀·普拉特 (Cooper Pratt) 在布赖斯·图朗 (Brice Turang) 上垒，一局后密尔沃基队以 5-4 领先。

paras.en: The Brewers put runners on second and third with the four-hitter in Contreras at the plate in the eighth but were unable to add insurance, and Johnny DeLuca promptly started the top of the ninth with a double to put the tying run in scoring position.
paras.zh: 酿酒人队在第八局本垒板中孔特雷拉斯的四支击球手将跑垒者分列第二和第三位，但未能增加保险，约翰尼·德卢卡迅速在第九局上半段打出两垒安打，将追平比分置于得分位置。

paras.en: Yandy Diaz came to the dish with two outs and DeLuca on third, but Aaron Ashby's postseason scoreless streak is now at 15.2 innings, as the first-base umpire ruled that Diaz didn't check his swing on a 3-2 count, controversially ending the game.
paras.zh: 扬迪·迪亚兹 (Yandy Diaz) 出局两次，德卢卡 (DeLuca) 出局第三，但亚伦·阿什比 (Aaron Ashby) 季后赛连续无得分的记录现在已达到 15.2 局，因为一垒裁判裁定迪亚兹在 3-2 计数时没有检查他的挥杆，从而有争议地结束了比赛。

paras.en: For certain, the call could have went either way. Jonathan Aranda, who is hitting .310 this postseason, was on deck, with Simpson and Caminero following.
paras.zh: 可以肯定的是，通话可能会以任何一种方式进行。乔纳森·阿兰达 (Jonathan Aranda) 在本次季后赛中打出了 0.310 的成绩，紧随其后的是辛普森 (Simpson) 和卡米内罗 (Caminero)。

paras.en: Milwaukee tacked on 11 total hits to Tampa Bay's seven — three of which came in the first inning. The Rays were left scoreless after the first inning.
paras.zh: 密尔沃基队总共击出 11 支安打，而坦帕湾队总共击出 7 支安打，其中 3 支是在第一局发生的。第一局结束后，光芒队一分未得。

paras.en: The 1996 New York Yankees are the last team to win the World Series after losing the first two games. Both losses came at home before the Yankees won four straight. Teams that take the first two games of a best-of-seven postseason series are 79-16 all time.
paras.zh: 1996年的纽约洋基队是最后一支在输掉前两场比赛后赢得世界大赛的球队。两场失利都发生在主场，之后洋基队取得了四连胜。在季后赛七战四胜系列赛中，拿下前两场比赛的球队战绩为 79 胜 16 负。

articles.title: Andy Burnham says he wants ‘honest discussion’ about freedom of movement with EU
articles.author: Patrick Daly

paras.en: Andy Burnham says he wants an “honest discussion” with the British public about the possibility of a return to free movement between the UK and the EU as part of his plans for a new relationship with the bloc.
paras.zh: 安迪·伯纳姆表示，他希望与英国公众就英国和欧盟之间恢复自由流动的可能性进行“诚实的讨论”，作为他与欧盟建立新关系计划的一部分。

paras.en: The prime minister has been open about his desire to revisit the relationship between Britain and Brussels. He has said a new deal could mean the UK goes “all the way” and rejoins the EU.
paras.zh: 首相公开表示希望重新审视英国与布鲁塞尔之间的关系。他表示，新协议可能意味着英国“一路走好”并重新加入欧盟。

paras.en: Other options discussed by Burnham include joining the single market, which would require signing up to free movement, or being part of the customs union. Both would require an element of agreeing to rules set by the EU.
paras.zh: 伯纳姆讨论的其他选择包括加入单一市场，这需要签署自由流动协议，或者成为关税同盟的一部分。两者都需要同意欧盟制定的规则。

paras.en: In an interview with the Sunday Times, he said: “I think you have to have a very factual, quite evidence-based debate about this.”
paras.zh: 在接受《星期日泰晤士报》采访时，他说：“我认为你必须对此进行非常真实、基于证据的辩论。”

paras.en: The prime minister has previously committed to the red lines in Labour’s 2024 election manifesto, which ruled out the return of free movement, single market membership or a customs union.
paras.zh: 首相此前曾承诺遵守工党 2024 年选举宣言中的红线，其中排除了恢复自由流动、单一市场成员资格或关税同盟的可能性。

paras.en: It means any fundamental change in the relationship is likely to have to wait until after a general election, expected by 2029.
paras.zh: 这意味着两国关系的任何根本性变化可能要等到大选之后（预计 2029 年）。

paras.en: The prime minister acknowledged freedom of movement “had very significant challenges associated with it”, but suggested that European migration had changed in the past decade.
paras.zh: 首相承认迁徙自由“面临着与之相关的非常重大的挑战”，但他表示欧洲移民在过去十年中发生了变化。

paras.en: “It was a type of immigration that perhaps wasn’t as difficult [as now],” he told the Sunday Times.
paras.zh: “这种移民也许不像现在那么困难，”他告诉《星期日泰晤士报》。

paras.en: “Revolving door migration where people would come and then go back is different.
paras.zh: “人们来来去去的旋转门移民是不同的。

paras.en: “The balance of migration has changed, hasn’t it, since then? I think we’ve just got to have an honest discussion about those things.”
paras.zh: “从那时起，移民的平衡已经发生了变化，不是吗？我认为我们必须就这些事情进行诚实的讨论。”

paras.en: Burnham will meet EU chiefs at a summit in Brussels on 20 November.
paras.zh: 伯纳姆将于 11 月 20 日在布鲁塞尔举行的峰会上会见欧盟领导人。

paras.en: He argued that there had been reciprocal benefits of free movement for Britons, particularly for young members of the population wanting to experience living in Europe.
paras.zh: 他认为，自由流动对英国人来说是互惠互利的，特别是对于那些想要体验欧洲生活的年轻人来说。

paras.en: The issue of migration was one of the dominant debates during the 2016 Brexit referendum campaign.
paras.zh: 移民问题是 2016 年英国脱欧公投期间的主要争论之一。

paras.en: In the 12 months to June 2016 – the month of the Brexit leave vote – net migration was at a near-record high of 335,000, according to the Office for National Statistics.
paras.zh: 根据英国国家统计局的数据，截至 2016 年 6 月（英国脱欧脱欧公投当月）的 12 个月里，净移民人数达到 335,000 人，接近历史新高。

paras.en: Decisions made after the Brexit result would lead to higher levels of migration, however.
paras.zh: 然而，英国脱欧结果后做出的决定将导致更高水平的移民。

paras.en: Net migration peaked at a record 944,000 in the year to March 2023 due to a surge of foreign workers encouraged to come to the UK by Boris Johnson’s Conservative government as the UK emerged from the Covid pandemic.
paras.zh: 截至 2023 年 3 月，净移民人数达到创纪录的 944,000 人，原因是随着英国摆脱新冠疫情，鲍里斯·约翰逊的保守党政府鼓励外国工人来到英国。

paras.en: It has fallen sharply since then, with net migration dropping to well below pre-Brexit levels. It stood at 171,000 last year, almost half of what it was in 2016.
paras.zh: 此后，这一数字急剧下降，净移民人数降至远低于英国脱欧前的水平。去年这一数字为 171,000，几乎是 2016 年的一半。

paras.en: Burnham has said he will take the opportunity around the summit with EU leaders in November to lay out to the British public different options for the future relationship with the bloc.
paras.zh: 伯纳姆表示，他将利用11月与欧盟领导人举行峰会的机会，向英国公众提出未来与欧盟关系的不同选择。

paras.en: But Burnham added that he could not imagine recommending that the UK join the Schengen Area, in which border controls have been abolished, or ditching the pound to adopt the euro.
paras.zh: 但伯纳姆补充说，他无法想象建议英国加入已废除边境管制的申根区，或放弃英镑而采用欧元。

paras.en: Nigel Farage said the prime minister’s comments were a “total betrayal” of voters who backed Brexit, including in Burnham’s Makerfield constituency.
paras.zh: 奈杰尔·法拉奇表示，首相的言论是对支持英国脱欧的选民的“彻底背叛”，其中包括伯纳姆的马克菲尔德选区。

paras.en: The Reform UK leader added: “He is also deluded to say immigration was different when we were members of the EU. We will fight this dishonesty.”
paras.zh: 这位改革英国领导人补充道：“他说当我们还是欧盟成员国时移民情况有所不同，这也是他的欺骗行为。我们将打击这种不诚实行为。”

paras.en: Chris Philp, the Conservative shadow home secretary, said: “Andy Burnham knows full well that a return to EU free movement would mean handing back control of our borders and allowing uncontrolled migration from across Europe.
paras.zh: 保守党影子内政大臣克里斯·菲尔普 (Chris Philp) 表示：“安迪·伯纳姆 (Andy Burnham) 非常清楚，回归欧盟自由流动意味着交还我们的边境控制权，并允许来自欧洲各地的不受控制的移民。

paras.en: “The British people voted to end free movement, and there can be no return to it.”
paras.zh: “英国人民投票决定结束自由流动，而且再也回不去了。”

articles.title: ‘Horrific’: woman, 19, shot in head in drive-by shooting outside boxing event near Brisbane
articles.author: Australian Associated Press

paras.en: Four people have been injured after a drive-by shooting outside a venue hosting a boxing event, including a 19-year-old woman who was shot in the head.
paras.zh: 拳击比赛场馆外发生一起驾车枪击事件，造成四人受伤，其中一名 19 岁女子头部中弹。

paras.en: Queensland police Detective Inspector Ian Galpin said a group of people were gathered at the passenger drop-off zone outside Fitzy’s Loganholme, south of Brisbane, about 8.18pm on Saturday when a Mitsubishi pulled up.
paras.zh: 昆士兰州警探伊恩·加尔平 (Ian Galpin) 表示，周六晚上 8 点 18 分左右，一群人聚集在布里斯班南部 Fitzy’s Loganholme 外的乘客下客区，当时一辆三菱汽车停了下来。

paras.en: Galpin said police would allege a “number of shots” were fired from the front window of the pub where two males wearing balaclavas and gloves were sitting, striking four people.
paras.zh: 加尔平表示，警方称，酒吧前窗发射了“多枪”，酒吧里坐着两名戴着巴拉克拉瓦帽和手套的男子，击中了四人。

paras.en: A Jimboomba woman, 19, was shot in the neck and head. She has undergone surgery and remains in a critical condition.
paras.zh: 一名 19 岁的 Jimboomba 妇女颈部和头部中弹。她已经接受了手术，目前仍处于危急状态。

paras.en: Speaking on Sunday, Galpin described her as an “innocent bystander”.
paras.zh: 加尔平在周日的讲话中将她描述为“无辜的旁观者”。

paras.en: “It’s horrific. It’s something that her family should never have to go through.”
paras.zh: “这太可怕了。这是她的家人永远不应该经历的事情。”

paras.en: Three others were injured and remained in serious but stable conditions: a Browns Plains man, 38, shot in the abdomen and arm, a Salisbury man, 37, shot in the abdomen, and a Cornubia man, 27, shot in the abdomen.
paras.zh: 另外三人受伤，伤势严重但情况稳定：一名 38 岁的 Browns Plains 男子腹部和手臂中弹，一名 37 岁的索尔兹伯里男子腹部中弹，以及一名 27 岁的 Cornubia 男子腹部中弹。

paras.en: Galpin alleged the Mitsubishi was set alight on Maloney Road at Waterford West, which was declared a crime scene, while a second car collected the occupants of the Mitsubishi and departed.
paras.zh: 加尔平声称，三菱汽车在沃特福德西的马洛尼路被纵火，该路被宣布为犯罪现场，而另一辆车接走了三菱汽车的乘客并离开。

paras.en: “It is possible one of these persons from the Mitsubishi was injured or burnt during this process,” Galpin said.
paras.zh: 加尔平说：“三菱车上的其中一名人员可能在此过程中受伤或烧伤。”

paras.en: Galpin said it was too soon to say whether it was related to organised crime.
paras.zh: 加尔平表示，现在判断这是否与有组织犯罪有关还为时过早。

paras.en: “This is a horrific event in a public space where adults and children were simply trying to enjoy a sporting event and this incident, it’s clearly not acceptable. We will not tolerate it.”
paras.zh: “这是在公共场所发生的可怕事件，成人和儿童只是想享受体育赛事，而这起事件显然是不可接受的。我们不会容忍它。”

paras.en: Speaking on Sunday morning, Logan’s mayor, Jon Raven, described residents in the area as frightened.
paras.zh: 周日上午，洛根市市长乔恩·雷文 (Jon Raven) 表示该地区的居民感到害怕。

paras.en: “This has sent a shock wave through Logan. We’ve never seen something like this in Logan before,” Raven told the Today show.
paras.zh: “这给洛根带来了冲击。我们以前从未在洛根身上见过这样的事情，”雷文告诉《今日秀》。

paras.en: “Our hearts go out obviously to the victims and the staff and the people at this boxing event.
paras.zh: “我们的心显然与这次拳击比赛中的受害者、工作人员和人们同在。

paras.en: “I’ve been to one of these events before, they’re [a] really family friendly environment, and I know there’s lots of children who were there, and this will impact them for the rest of their lives.”
paras.zh: “我以前参加过其中一次活动，那里的环境非常适合家庭，我知道有很多孩子在那里，这将影响他们的余生。”

paras.en: The deputy commander of Queensland police, Chris Stream, described the scene as “confronting”.
paras.zh: 昆士兰州警察局副局长克里斯·斯特里姆（Chris Stream）将这一场景描述为“对峙”。

paras.en: “A number of people had suffered gunshot wounds,” he told Today.
paras.zh: “许多人受了枪伤，”他告诉《今日报》。

paras.en: Raven said the event had been organised to help children steer clear of violence.
paras.zh: 雷文说，组织这次活动是为了帮助儿童远离暴力。

paras.en: “[The organiser] will be devastated this has happened because he loves boxing and uses it as a tool to empower and reconnect young people who might be going off the rails, and this is the opposite of what he’ll want to see,” Raven said.
paras.zh: 雷文说：“（组织者）将会对发生的事情感到震惊，因为他热爱拳击，并将其作为一种工具来帮助那些可能出轨的年轻人并重新建立联系，而这与他希望看到的相反。”

paras.en: Logan City Titles shared a statement on social media on Sunday morning.
paras.zh: 周日上午，洛根市标题公司在社交媒体上分享了一份声明。

paras.en: “We are heartbroken about the incident that occurred at the fight night,” it read.
paras.zh: “我们对战斗之夜发生的事件感到心碎，”它写道。

paras.en: “Logan City Titles was a family event, an event for our community, showcasing local talent, hard work and everyone’s skills inside the ring.
paras.zh: “洛根市冠军赛是一项家庭活动，也是我们社区的一项活动，展示了当地的才华、辛勤工作以及每个人在擂台上的技能。

paras.en: “These types of incidents have no place in the boxing community or any part of the broader community.”
paras.zh: “此类事件在拳击界或更广泛的社区的任何部分都没有立足之地。”

paras.en: The offenders were still at large on Sunday but police said they did not believe there was an ongoing threat to the public.
paras.zh: 周日，罪犯仍然在逃，但警方表示，他们不认为公众面临持续的威胁。

paras.en: Police were urging anyone with information to contact them.
paras.zh: 警方敦促任何有信息的人与他们联系。

articles.title: AFP boss says politicians’ heated rhetoric is fuelling threats against MPs
articles.author: Australian Associated Press

paras.en: Australia’s top federal law enforcement official has drawn a direct link between politicians’ rhetoric and threats and abuse being directed at leaders.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚最高联邦执法官员将政客的言论与针对领导人的威胁和辱骂直接联系起来。

paras.en: The safety of elected representatives at all levels has been thrown into the spotlight after independent MP Helen Haines was allegedly deliberate attacked outside her Wangaratta electoral office.
paras.zh: 独立议员海伦·海恩斯据称在旺加拉塔选举办公室外遭到蓄意袭击后，各级民选代表的安全成为人们关注的焦点。

paras.en: Haines remains in a serious but stable condition at the Alfred hospital in Melbourne, following her double leg amputation.
paras.zh: 海恩斯双腿截肢后，仍在墨尔本阿尔弗雷德医院，情况严重但稳定。

paras.en: The Australian federal police commissioner, Krissy Barrett, said there was no doubt the threat environment had changed for politicians.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚联邦警察局长克里斯·巴雷特 (Krissy Barrett) 表示，毫无疑问，对政客来说，威胁环境已经发生了变化。

paras.en: “When I start work every morning, one of the first things I do is read a report … [that] summarises all of the threats that have been reported to the AFP over the last 24 hours,” she told the ABC’s Insiders program.
paras.zh: “每天早上开始工作时，我做的第一件事就是阅读一份报告……该报告总结了过去 24 小时内向法新社报告的所有威胁，”她告诉 ABC 的 Insiders 节目。

paras.en: “Now, some days that report is pages and pages long.”
paras.zh: “现在，有时这份报告会一页又一页长。”

paras.en: The commissioner said she wasn’t interested in policing free speech or intervening in political discourse.
paras.zh: 该专员表示，她对监管言论自由或干预政治话语不感兴趣。

paras.en: “But I would challenge any Australian to read some of these threats and some of the abuse that is reported to us from federal parliamentarians and for anyone to argue that that is free speech or political discourse,” she added.
paras.zh: “但我会要求所有澳大利亚人阅读联邦议员向我们报告的一些威胁和滥用行为，并要求任何人都认为这是言论自由或政治言论，”她补充道。

paras.en: The move from the sending of physical hate mail to online threats had played a significant role in the increasing volume of worrying material, while also highlighting the influence of inflammatory political imagery and language.
paras.zh: 从发送物理仇恨邮件到发送在线威胁的转变，在令人担忧的材料数量不断增加方面发挥了重要作用，同时也凸显了煽动性政治图像和语言的影响。

paras.en: “We do see where there is particular political conflict or discourse occurring … it does have a direct correlation to what we see in terms of threats and abuse, and sometimes it’s very immediate,” Barrett said.
paras.zh: 巴雷特说：“我们确实看到哪里发生了特定的政治冲突或言论……它确实与我们所看到的威胁和虐待有直接关系，有时是非常直接的。”

paras.en: Past One Nation cartoons depicting political figures, including the prime minister, Anthony Albanese, being hit by cars or buses have resurfaced in the days since the alleged attack on Haines.
paras.zh: 自所谓的海恩斯袭击事件发生以来，描绘总理安东尼·阿尔巴内斯等政治人物被汽车或公共汽车撞倒的“过去一国”漫画再次出现。

paras.en: The AFP commissioner said there was “a reaction amongst the community” to material such as the cartoons.
paras.zh: 法新社专员表示，“社区对漫画等材料做出了反应”。

paras.en: The policing agency, which is responsible for protecting federal politicians and office-holders, has held a number of emergency safety briefings with parliamentarians since Monday.
paras.zh: 负责保护联邦政客和公职人员的警察机构自周一以来已与议员举行了多次紧急安全简报会。

paras.en: Male and female MPs were targeted equally with threats and abuse, Barrett said, but women were more often singled out individually, often with threats of sexual violence.
paras.zh: 巴雷特说，男性和女性议员同样受到威胁和虐待，但女性更经常受到单独攻击，往往受到性暴力威胁。

paras.en: “My hope is that this really causes people to pause and have a think about what’s happening in this country and the impact of that,” she said.
paras.zh: “我希望这确实能让人们停下来思考这个国家正在发生的事情及其影响，”她说。

paras.en: “And if this is not the incident, then what is?”
paras.zh: “如果这不是事件，那是什么？”

paras.en: Federal MPs from across the political spectrum have acknowledged the difficulty in balancing their personal security and access to voters.
paras.zh: 来自各个政治派别的联邦议员都承认，在个人安全和接触选民之间取得平衡是很困难的。

paras.en: “As a local MP, I don’t want to stop going to community events,” Liberal frontbencher Ted O’Brien told News24 on Sunday.
paras.zh: “作为一名当地议员，我不想停止参加社区活动，”自由党前座议员泰德·奥布莱恩周日告诉 News24。

paras.en: “That open access is a cornerstone of democracy. We’re particularly good at it in Australia. We can’t take away grassroots politics.”
paras.zh: “开放准入是民主的基石。我们在澳大利亚尤其擅长这一点。我们不能剥夺草根政治。”

paras.en: Labor minister Catherine King said she has been contending with the deteriorating safety for some time.
paras.zh: 劳工部长凯瑟琳·金表示，一段时间以来，她一直在应对不断恶化的安全状况。

paras.en: “It is when, not if, that something will happen to one of us and we’ve been saying that certainly for the last five years or so,” she said.
paras.zh: “当我们中的一个人发生某事时，而不是是否发生，我们在过去五年左右的时间里一直在这么说，”她说。

paras.en: “I had a mobile caravan for almost 25 years. I don’t use that now because it doesn’t have a second exit point.
paras.zh: “我拥有一辆移动大篷车已经将近 25 年了。我现在不使用它了，因为它没有第二个出口。

paras.en: “If someone did kick off and I’m trapped in the van, it’s very hard to deal with that.”
paras.zh: “如果有人真的发动了进攻，而我被困在货车里，那就很难处理了。”

articles.title: Who are the candidates in Brazil's presidential election?

paras.en: Who are the candidates in Brazil's presidential election?
paras.zh: 巴西总统选举的候选人有哪些？

paras.en: Brazilians will head to the polls on Sunday to vote for their next president.
paras.zh: 巴西人将于周日前往投票站投票选出下一任总统。

paras.en: They are choosing between Brazil's current left-wing President Luiz InÃ¡cio Lula da Silva and the right-wing Senator FlÃ¡vio Bolsonaro.
paras.zh: 他们在巴西现任左翼总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦和右翼参议员弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗之间做出选择。

paras.en: Bolsonaro, the son of imprisoned former president Jair Bolsonaro, beat Lula in the first round of voting on 4 October by a narrow margin.
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗是被监禁的前总统雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗的儿子，他在 10 月 4 日的第一轮投票中以微弱优势击败了卢拉。

paras.en: As Americas correspondent Ione Wells reports from Rio de Janeiro, voters are choosing between two very different candidates.
paras.zh: 正如美国记者艾奥内·威尔斯在里约热内卢报道的那样，选民正在两位截然不同的候选人之间进行选择。

articles.title: Palestinian families displaced as Israeli forces demolish Hebron homes

paras.en: The Israeli military has launched a sweeping crackdown in the occupied West Bank, demolishing homes and businesses in the city of Hebron and displacing hundreds of families, according to local officials.
paras.zh: 据当地官员称，以色列军方在被占领的约旦河西岸发起了全面镇压，拆除了希伯伦市的房屋和企业，使数百户家庭流离失所。

paras.en: Footage shared online showed destruction caused by Israeli bulldozers, with at least one whole street appearing to have been flattened. The military has also cordoned off the city, heavily restricting the movement of its 200,000 residents.
paras.zh: 网上分享的视频显示以色列推土机造成的破坏，至少一整条街道似乎被夷为平地。军方还封锁了这座城市，严格限制 20 万居民的行动。

paras.en: The operation was announced by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Friday, in response to the killing of two Israeli soldiers by two Palestinian gunmen in an attack on a checkpoint. Three other Israeli soldiers were injured, and the gunmen were also killed.
paras.zh: 以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡周五宣布了这一行动，以回应两名巴勒斯坦枪手在检查站袭击中杀害两名以色列士兵的事件。另外三名以色列士兵受伤，枪手也被打死。

paras.en: Netanyahu said on Friday that buildings around the site of the attack and the neighbourhoods that the two gunmen were from would be "destroyed".
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡周五表示，袭击地点周围的建筑物以及两名枪手所在的社区将被“摧毁”。

paras.en: Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz said about 2,000 residents had been displaced by the operation, which centred on the Ein Deir Baha and Farsh al-Hawa neighbourhoods, and targeted homes, businesses, industrial sites and infrastructure.
paras.zh: 以色列国防部长伊斯雷尔·卡茨表示，此次行动导致约 2000 名居民流离失所，行动主要集中在艾因代尔巴哈 (Ein Deir Baha) 和法什哈瓦 (Farsh al-Hawa) 社区，目标是住宅、企业、工业场地和基础设施。

paras.en: He said dozens of families had been forced to spend the night outside, with some told to leave without taking their vehicles, while homes were marked for demolition with spray paint.
paras.zh: 他说，数十个家庭被迫在外面过夜，一些人被告知不要带上车辆离开，而房屋也被喷漆标记为待拆除。

paras.en: He added that he believed the military planned to displace a total of 2,500 people from about 0.35 sq km of urban land. The city's governor and deputy mayor meanwhile said at least 200 families had been displaced.
paras.zh: 他补充说，他相信军方计划从约 0.35 平方公里的城市土地上迁移总共 2,500 人。该市州长和副市长同时表示，至少有 200 个家庭流离失所。

paras.en: The Israel Defense Forces (IDF) did not respond immediately to the BBC's request for comment. It said in a statement on social media that it had dozens of targets across the West Bank and that its operations would last for several days.
paras.zh: 以色列国防军（IDF）没有立即回应 BBC 的置评请求。它在社交媒体上的一份声明中表示，它在西岸有数十个目标，其行动将持续数天。

paras.en: It is common practice for Israeli forces to demolish the homes of Palestinians who are suspected of carrying out attacks on Israelis in the West Bank - a practice Israeli rights groups have criticised as collective punishment.
paras.zh: 以色列军队拆除涉嫌在西岸袭击以色列人的巴勒斯坦人的房屋是常见做法，以色列人权组织批评这种做法是集体惩罚。

paras.en: Netanyahu likened the operation to previous operations in Palestinian refugee camps in the north of the territory, when the Israeli military demolished hundreds of homes and displaced tens of thousands in 2025.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡将这次行动与之前在该领土北部巴勒斯坦难民营的行动相比较，当时以色列军队在 2025 年拆除了数百座房屋，导致数万人流离失所。

paras.en: Friday's shooting came during a tense time for the region, with Israel's general election taking place in four days' time.
paras.zh: 周五的枪击事件发生在该地区的紧张时期，四天后以色列大选即将举行。

paras.en: Netanyahu - who has built his campaign on the promise of security - cancelled his party's campaign events for Friday morning and headed to Hebron, wearing protective armour and posting a video on social media from the scene.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡的竞选活动建立在安全承诺的基础上，他取消了周五上午的政党竞选活动，并穿着防护盔甲前往希伯伦，并在社交媒体上发布了现场视频。

paras.en: "We will evacuate the residents, go house to house, remove the weapons we find there, and deal with and destroy all terrorist infrastructure," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们将疏散居民，挨家挨户地移走我们发现的武器，并处理和摧毁所有恐怖分子的基础设施。”

paras.en: He also announced he had reviewed plans for the largest military operation in the West Bank since 1967 - though did not say when it could be carried out. It is not clear whether the ongoing Hebron operation forms part of that.
paras.zh: 他还宣布，他已经审查了自 1967 年以来西岸最大规模军事行动的计划，但没有透露何时实施。目前尚不清楚正在进行的希伯伦行动是否属于其中的一部分。

paras.en: In an interview with Israel's i24 television channel released on Saturday, he threatened "a very big surprise" for the Palestinian Authority (PA), which governs parts of the territory.
paras.zh: 在周六发布的以色列 i24 电视频道采访中，他威胁称，将给管理该领土部分地区的巴勒斯坦权力机构（PA）带来“非常大的惊喜”。

paras.en: In a statement, the PA called for "urgent international action that went beyond condemnation" to prevent further forced displacement.
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦权力机构在一份声明中呼吁“国际社会采取超越谴责的紧急行动”，以防止进一步被迫流离失所。

paras.en: Meanwhile, his far-right Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich called for Israel to launch a campaign in the West Bank "exactly like in Gaza or Lebanon," while far-right National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir called for Israel to dismantle the PA.
paras.zh: 与此同时，他的极右翼财政部长贝扎莱尔·斯莫特里奇呼吁以色列“就像在加沙或黎巴嫩一样”在约旦河西岸发起一场运动，而极右翼国家安全部长伊塔马尔·本·格维尔则呼吁以色列解散巴勒斯坦权力机构。

paras.en: Speaking to journalists, Hebron Mayor Youssef al-Jaabari said the operation was "driven by the elections," and that Netanyahu and his ministers were attempting to secure the votes of the far-right and the settlers.
paras.zh: 希伯伦市长优素福·贾巴里对记者表示，这次行动是“由选举驱动的”，内塔尼亚胡和他的部长们正试图确保极右翼和定居者的选票。

articles.title: Almost 1,000 arrested as clashes follow another day of mass protests across France

paras.en: Nearly 1,000 arrests were made as hundreds of thousands of people took part in another day of protests across France which were followed by some clashes late on Saturday, officials have said.
paras.zh: 官员称，法国各地又一天有数十万人参加抗议活动，周六晚间又发生了一些冲突，近千人被捕。

paras.en: After a day of largely peaceful demonstrations, police fired tear gas and water cannon to disperse protesters in a number of cities including Paris, while barricades were set alight in Marseille and people ripped boards from a shop in Bordeaux.
paras.zh: 经过一天基本和平的示威活动后，警察在巴黎等多个城市发射催泪瓦斯和水枪驱散抗议者，马赛的路障被点燃，波尔多一家商店的木板被人们撕扯。

paras.en: But officials have so far managed to avoid rioting and looting on the scale seen last weekend, which resulted in some of the worst scenes of disorder in France's modern history.
paras.zh: 但到目前为止，官员们设法避免了上周末出现的大规模骚乱和抢劫，这导致了法国现代历史上最严重的骚乱场面。

paras.en: The interior ministry said an estimated 410,000 people protested on Saturday, while the unions put the number at about 800,000.
paras.zh: 内政部表示，周六估计有 41 万人抗议，而工会估计人数约为 80 万人。

paras.en: Some 70,000 police officers were deployed and restrictions imposed in several cities to prevent the latest protests over the cost of living and poor school conditions from descending into the kind of chaos which saw officers outnumbered, hundreds of businesses looted and buildings torched.
paras.zh: 一些城市部署了约 7 万名警察，并实施了限制措施，以防止最近因生活成本和学校条件恶劣而引发的抗议活动演变成警察人数过多、数百家企业被抢劫、建筑物被纵火的混乱局面。

paras.en: President Emmanuel Macron had decreed earlier this week that only demonstrations organised by a recognised trade unions would be permitted. Hundreds of people have been jailed for vandalism, arson and looting after fast-track court hearings in recent days.
paras.zh: 总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙本周早些时候颁布法令，只允许由公认的工会组织的示威活动。最近几天的快速法庭听证会后，数百人因故意破坏、纵火和抢劫而被判入狱。

paras.en: Clashes between protesters and riot police in Paris erupted at the end of a peaceful march from the city's Porte d'Italie towards Porte de Vincennes on Saturday, where the police operation included an elite unit that usually deals with organised crime and counter-terrorism.
paras.zh: 周六，巴黎从意大利门向文森门和平游行结束时，抗议者与防暴警察之间爆发了冲突。在那里，警察行动包括一支通常处理有组织犯罪和反恐的精锐部队。

paras.en: Some protesters were seen erecting makeshift barricades and pelting officers with projectiles, while police baton-charged groups of masked youths who were smashing the windows of a car dealership.
paras.zh: 有人看到一些抗议者竖起临时路障，并向警察投掷弹丸，而警察则用警棍指挥一群蒙面青年，他们正在砸碎一家汽车经销店的窗户。

paras.en: French Interior Minister Laurent NuÃ±ez said that "several thousand radical activists gathered at the rear of the march, including around 500 individuals identified as rioters", the AFP news agency reported.
paras.zh: 据法新社报道，法国内政部长洛朗·努涅斯表示，“数千名激进分子聚集在游行队伍的后方，其中包括约 500 名骚乱者”。

paras.en: In the southern port of Marseille, rubbish bins were set ablaze and metal sheets used to block streets. A law enforcement vehicle was seen driving through a burning barricade in France's second-largest city.
paras.zh: 在马赛南部港口，垃圾箱被点燃，金属板被用来封锁街道。有人看到一辆执法车驶过法国第二大城市燃烧的路障。

paras.en: Meanwhile, some protesters in dark clothing and face coverings were seen taking boards off a building to build a street barricade in the southern city of Bordeaux.
paras.zh: 与此同时，有人看到一些身穿深色衣服、戴着面罩的抗议者从一座建筑物上拆下木板，在南部城市波尔多建造街道路障。

paras.en: In Lyon, police used tear gas grenades to disperse a crowd which had reportedly gathered in an area deemed off-limits by the local prefecture.
paras.zh: 在里昂，警方使用催泪瓦斯手榴弹驱散了据报道聚集在当地政府视为禁区的人群。

paras.en: "There were around 150 of us, mostly secondary school and university students. Then the tear gas came almost immediately. You could barely see anything in the street," said one protester in France's third-largest city.
paras.zh: “我们大约有 150 人，大部分是中学生和大学生。然后催泪瓦斯几乎立刻就来了。街上几乎看不到任何东西，”法国第三大城市的一名抗议者说。

paras.en: NuÃ±ez said late in the day that nearly 1,000 people had been arrested, a number he said would increase.
paras.zh: 努涅斯当天晚些时候表示，已有近 1,000 人被捕，他表示这一数字还会增加。

paras.en: The minister also said two people had been "seriously injured": one in the south-western city of Toulouse, and another one in Clermont-Ferrand, central France.
paras.zh: 这位部长还表示，两人“重伤”：一人在西南部城市图卢兹，另一人在法国中部克莱蒙费朗。

paras.en: Earlier, a peaceful protester in Paris who gave her name as Zelie told the BBC people had taken to the streets because they were "really frustrated" and had been "suffering a lot" since Macron came to office.
paras.zh: 早些时候，巴黎一名自称泽莉的和平抗议者告诉英国广播公司，他们之所以走上街头，是因为他们“非常沮丧”，并且自马克龙上任以来一直“遭受了很多痛苦”。

paras.en: "They keep us quiet. They take our money, they tax us a lot and we can't say anything. Today we are in the streets because it's been too long, it's been too much," the 26-year-old said.
paras.zh: “他们让我们保持安静。他们拿走了我们的钱，向我们征收了很多税，我们什么也不能说。今天我们走上街头，因为时间太长了，承受的压力太大了，”这位 26 岁的年轻人说。

paras.en: Two masked teenage protesters, who did not want to give their names, also said their generation was in despair and felt abandoned by the government.
paras.zh: 两名不愿透露姓名的蒙面青少年抗议者也表示，他们这一代人处于绝望之中，感觉被政府抛弃了。

paras.en: "I think looting is really not good," one of the demonstrators said of last Saturday's disorder. "But it's because of poverty and the violence of the police."
paras.zh: “我认为抢劫确实不好，”一名示威者谈到上周六的骚乱时说道。 “但这是因为贫穷和警察的暴力。”

paras.en: He added that the protests would end "when we have a response to our demands. We really want a change in France".
paras.zh: 他补充说，“当我们的要求得到回应时，抗议活动就会结束。我们真的希望法国发生改变”。

paras.en: Meanwhile, some 13,000 people joined a rally against the hard-right National Rally party in the north-central city of OrlÃ©ans which proceeded peacefully.
paras.zh: 与此同时，约有 13,000 人参加了中北部城市奥尔良举行的反对极右翼全国集会的集会，集会和平进行。

paras.en: Mass protests triggered by similar issues as in France also rocked several other European cities on Saturday.
paras.zh: 周六，与法国类似的问题引发的大规模抗议活动也震撼了其他几个欧洲城市。

paras.en: In Barcelona, more than 100 people were arrested after a student protest descended into what local authorities described as "gratuitous violence".
paras.zh: 在巴塞罗那，学生抗议活动升级为地方当局所说的“无端暴力”，导致 100 多人被捕。

paras.en: In Albania's capital Tirana, riot police fired tear gas to disperse thousands of anti-government demonstrators, while clashes were also reported in Belgium's capital Brussels.
paras.zh: 在阿尔巴尼亚首都地拉那，防暴警察发射催泪瓦斯驱散数千名反政府示威者，而比利时首都布鲁塞尔也发生了冲突。

paras.en: In Milan, northern Italy, a major security operation including hundreds of soldiers alongside police prevented protesters gathering in the city. Many had feared a repeat of violent scenes last week when some started fires, smashed windows and looted shops.
paras.zh: 在意大利北部的米兰，包括数百名士兵和警察在内的大规模安全行动阻止了抗议者在该市聚集。许多人担心上周的暴力场面会重演，一些人放火、砸碎窗户、抢劫商店。

paras.en: Around 550,000 people took part in last weekend's demonstrations against rising fuel prices and the cost of living, with frustrations escalating after weeks of student protests. The chaos which followed resulted in more than 2,500 arrests.
paras.zh: 上周末约有 55 万人参加了抗议燃油价格和生活成本上涨的示威活动，经过数周的学生抗议后，不满情绪不断升级。随后发生的混乱导致 2,500 多人被捕。

paras.en: Marches were initially largely peaceful but became marred by scenes of violence, looting and destruction, with more than 2,000 shops and other businesses across France said to have been directly impacted. The damage was estimated "at hundreds of millions euros", France's Chambers of Commerce and Industry (CCI) said.
paras.zh: 游行最初基本上是和平的，但后来出现了暴力、抢劫和破坏的场景，据说法国各地有 2000 多家商店和其他企业受到直接影响。法国工商会（CCI）表示，损失估计“达数亿欧元”。

paras.en: One demonstrator's hand was blown off by a police crowd-control grenade, according to the AFP news agency, while about 1,000 police officers were injured.
paras.zh: 据法新社报道，一名示威者的手被警察的人群控制手榴弹炸飞，约 1000 名警察受伤。

paras.en: The French authorities later said they were forced to impose overnight curfews in Paris and other cities.
paras.zh: 法国当局后来表示，他们被迫在巴黎和其他城市实施夜间宵禁。

paras.en: The continuing protests come ahead of France's presidential elections in six months' time, and leading contenders have levelled the blame at Macron and his ministers.
paras.zh: 持续的抗议活动发生在六个月后的法国总统选举之前，主要竞争者将责任归咎于马克龙和他的部长们。

articles.title: CONEXPO-CON/AGG 2026 recap

paras.en: CONEXPO-CON/AGG 2026 in Las Vegas, Nevada, reaffirmed its position as the largest construction trade show in North America, drawing more than 140,000 construction professionals from 128 countries across the globe. For Carlisle Brake & Friction, a CentroMotion brand, the week was an incredible opportunity to showcase innovation, strengthen partnerships and gain valuable insights into the future of the construction, mining and aggregate industries. Throughout the busy week, attendees had the chance to speak with our experts and watch live demonstrations of our brake systems, along with our advanced brake and transmission friction solutions for the construction industry.
paras.zh: 在内华达州拉斯维加斯举行的 CONEXPO-CON/AGG 2026 重申了其作为北美最大的建筑贸易展的地位，吸引了来自全球 128 个国家的超过 140,000 名建筑专业人士。对于 CentroMotion 品牌 Carlisle Brake & Friction 来说，本周是展示创新、加强合作伙伴关系以及获得对建筑、采矿和骨料行业未来的宝贵见解的绝佳机会。在忙碌的一周中，与会者有机会与我们的专家交谈并观看我们制动系统的现场演示，以及我们为建筑行业提供的先进制动和传动摩擦解决方案。

paras.en: CONEXPO-CON/AGG is more than a trade show, it’s a barometer for where the industry is headed. Top trends included integrating autonomous equipment, advanced digital tools and sustainable technologies. The exhibition footprint spanned more than 3 million square feet with greater than 2,000 exhibitors, and attendees covered miles of exhibits sprawled across indoor and outdoor spaces.
paras.zh: CONEXPO-CON/AGG 不仅仅是一个贸易展，它还是行业发展方向的晴雨表。主要趋势包括集成自主设备、先进的数字工具和可持续技术。展览面积超过 300 万平方英尺，参展商超过 2,000 家，与会者覆盖了遍布室内和室外空间的数英里展品。

paras.en: At the show, Carlisle Brake & Friction highlighted its advanced brake systems and friction technologies designed to withstand extreme duty cycles and demanding off‑highway applications. Attendees experienced firsthand the performance, quality, and engineering expertise that define the CarlisleCBF brand. The CentroMotion booth was a hub of activity, and the team welcomed OEM leaders and aftermarket specialists. These interactions went beyond showcasing our products, they enhanced relationships and increased our team’s understanding of the industry’s evolving needs. Check out this video https://youtu.be/C_IaFtvWBY8 for more detail about our booth and featured products serving the market.
paras.zh: 在展会上，卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司重点介绍了其先进的制动系统和摩擦技术，旨在承受极端的工作循环和苛刻的非公路应用。与会者亲身体验了 CarlisleCBF 品牌的性能、质量和工程专业知识。 CentroMotion 展位是活动中心，团队欢迎 OEM 领导者和售后市场专家。这些互动不仅仅是展示我们的产品，它们还增强了关系并增加了我们团队对行业不断变化的需求的了解。请观看此视频 https://youtu.be/C_IaFtvWBY8，了解有关我们的展位和服务于市场的特色产品的更多详细信息。

paras.en: The show floor was packed with the latest advancements across construction, aggregate, concrete and lifting. Attendees explored:
paras.zh: 展厅里充满了建筑、骨料、混凝土和起重方面的最新进展。与会者探讨：

paras.en: • New and upgraded equipment and machinery in action
paras.zh: • 新的和升级的设备和机械投入使用

paras.en: • Advances in automation, electrification and equipment intelligence
paras.zh: • 自动化、电气化和设备智能化的进步

paras.en: • Digital tools focused on productivity, fleet management and jobsite visibility
paras.zh: • 专注于生产力、车队管理和作业现场可视性的数字工具

paras.en: • Solutions designed to improve safety, efficiency and sustainability
paras.zh: • 旨在提高安全性、效率和可持续性的解决方案

paras.en: Hands on demos and a live equipment showcase gave attendees the opportunity to see innovations in action and understand how they can be applied on real jobsites.

paras.en: Technology continued to be a major focus at CONEXPO-CON/AGG 2026. Exhibitors and education sessions highlighted these key updates as transformational in construction operations:

paras.zh: • 可持续发展和减排

paras.en: Looking ahead: The future of construction

articles.title: New Facility Brings Off-Highway Wet Friction Production to India

paras.en: New Facility Brings Off-Highway Wet Friction Production to India
paras.zh: 新工厂将非公路湿式摩擦摩擦片生产带至印度

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction has broken ground to expand its Chennai, India manufacturing operations in one of the world’s fastest-growing industrial regions. Having produced mechatronic products in the region for more than 15 years, Carlisle CBF will relocate to add production at a larger site for off-highway paper wet friction discs and steel separator plates. The new facility is scheduled to open in 2027.
paras.zh: 卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司 (Carlisle Brake & Friction) 已破土动工，以扩大其位于印度钦奈的制造业务，该工厂位于世界上增长最快的工业地区之一。 Carlisle CBF 在该地区生产机电一体化产品已超过 15 年，将搬迁至更大的工厂，增加非公路用纸湿式摩擦片和钢制隔板的生产。新设施计划于 2027 年开业。

paras.en: The move to expanded space is designed to accommodate manufacturing capabilities needed to serve the growing demand across the agriculture, construction and especially mining industries in India and Southeast Asia. Local production will improve supply chain responsiveness while supporting original equipment and aftermarket requirements in cost-sensitive markets.
paras.zh: 扩大空间的目的是为了满足印度和东南亚农业、建筑业、特别是采矿业不断增长的需求所需的制造能力。本地生产将提高供应链响应能力，同时支持成本敏感市场的原始设备和售后市场需求。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction is establishing a state-of-the-art wet friction manufacturing facility on par with proven global manufacturing processes in the new Chennai plant, to build a more resilient regional platform. This expansion strengthens our ability to deliver durable wet friction products that help keep critical off-highway equipment productive.
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 正在钦奈新工厂建立最先进的湿式摩擦制造设施，与成熟的全球制造工艺相媲美，以打造更具弹性的区域平台。此次扩张增强了我们提供耐用湿式摩擦产品的能力，有助于保持关键非公路设备的生产力。

articles.title: Imitations Have Limitations. Your Reputation Shouldn’t.
articles.author: Litens Aftermarket

paras.en: You’ve been in the bay long enough to know how this plays out. A customer comes back three weeks after a belt job — cabin full of noise, belt shredded, tensioner shot. They’re not thinking about where the parts came from. They’re thinking about who put them in. That’s you.
paras.zh: 你在海湾待了足够长的时间，知道事情会如何发展。一位客户在完成皮带工作三周后回来——机舱里充满了噪音、皮带碎裂、张紧器射击。他们没有考虑零件来自哪里。他们在想是谁把他们放进去的。那就是你。

paras.en: This scenario is playing out more often as imitation overrunning alternator decouplers (OADs) flood the aftermarket. These knockoffs might look the part on the shelf, but under the hood is a completely different story — and the difference shows up fast, in the worst possible way.
paras.zh: 随着仿制超越交流发电机解耦器 (OAD) 充斥售后市场，这种情况越来越频繁地发生。这些仿制品在货架上看起来可能是一样的，但在幕后却是完全不同的故事——而且差异很快就会以最糟糕的方式显现出来。

paras.en: Here’s the bottom line: Litens invented the OAD and holds the original patent on the torsion spring decoupler design — the specific engineering that makes a genuine OAD function the way it’s supposed to.
paras.zh: 底线是这样的：Litens 发明了 OAD，并拥有扭力弹簧解耦器设计的原始专利——使真正的 OAD 发挥应有功能的特定工程。

paras.en: When imitation manufacturers copy a Litens OAD, they’re working from the outside in. They can match the shape, nail the dimensions, and price it to move — but they cannot replicate the patented internal design. The result is a component that might pass a visual inspection but fails the only test that actually counts: in the field, on a customer’s car.
paras.zh: 当仿制品制造商复制 Litens OAD 时，他们是从外到内进行工作的。他们可以匹配形状、确定尺寸并为其移动定价，但他们无法复制获得专利的内部设计。结果是一个组件可能通过了目视检查，但未能通过唯一真正重要的测试：在现场，在客户的汽车上。

paras.en: Every time an engine accelerates, decelerates and even at idle, it generates torsional pulses — constant vibrations that ripple through the serpentine belt and into every component connected to it. Left unchecked, those pulses create NVH complaints and chew through belts, tensioners, and entire alternators ahead of schedule.
paras.zh: 每当发动机加速、减速，甚至怠速时，它都会产生扭转脉冲——持续的振动，通过蛇形皮带传递到与之相连的每个部件。如果不加以控制，这些脉冲会导致 NVH 投诉，并提前磨损皮带、张紧器和整个交流发电机。

paras.en: The patented Litens torsion spring design absorbs those pulses before they become a problem. By decoupling the alternator rotor from the pulley during decel and cushioning the transition to acceleration, it smooths the load on the belt and tensioner at every revolution. The results are straightforward: quieter operation from the first cold start, and belt and tensioner life that can last up to twice as long as systems without a properly functioning decoupler.
paras.zh: 获得专利的莱顿扭转弹簧设计可以在这些脉冲成为问题之前吸收它们。通过在减速期间将交流发电机转子与皮带轮分离并缓冲加速过渡，它可以在每次旋转时平滑皮带和张紧器上的负载。结果很简单：第一次冷启动时运行更安静，皮带和张紧器的使用寿命比没有正常工作的解耦器的系统长两倍。

paras.en: That’s a repair that holds up long after the customer stops thinking about it.
paras.zh: 这种修复在客户不再考虑它之后仍能持续很长时间。

paras.en: A cheap OAD might save a few bucks at the counter. But when it fails — and imitation units do fail — the math turns ugly fast. You’re looking at a comeback repair, a lost afternoon, and a customer telling everyone at their workplace to go somewhere else next time.
paras.zh: 在柜台购买便宜的 OAD 可能会节省几美元。但当它失败时——而且仿制品确实失败了——数学很快就会变得丑陋。你看到的是一次修复、一个失落的下午，以及一位顾客告诉工作场所的每个人下次去其他地方。

paras.en: In a trade built on word-of-mouth, your name is your most valuable tool. Every part you install either backs that up or puts it on the line.
paras.zh: 在建立在口碑之上的行业中，您的名字是您最有价值的工具。您安装的每个部件要么支持该功能，要么将其投入使用。

paras.en: Drop-In Fit. Original Design. Original Manufacturer.
paras.zh: 插入式贴合。原创设计。原始制造商。

paras.en: Litens OADs install as direct replacements for the standard alternator pulley — no modifications, no adapter, no guesswork. You’re bolting in the component the system was engineered around, built by the same company that holds the patent on it.
paras.zh: Litens OAD 安装后可直接替代标准交流发电机皮带轮 — 无需修改、无需适配器、无需猜测。你用螺栓固定系统设计的组件，该组件是由拥有该系统专利的同一家公司制造的。

paras.en: Knockoffs will keep showing up at the counter, priced to move. But they’re not built to the same spec, and when they fail, it’s your name that takes the hit — not theirs.
paras.zh: 仿冒品将不断出现在柜台上，价格也会变动。但它们并不是按照相同的规格构建的，当它们失败时，受到打击的是您的名字，而不是他们的名字。

paras.en: The comeback is never worth it. The genuine part always is.
paras.zh: 卷土重来永远不值得。真正的部分总是如此。
